izzyondroid:de.bahnhoefe.deutschlands.ba.summary: Collect photos of railway stations for https://railway-stations.org
izzyondroid:de.bahnhoefe.deutschlands.ba.description:
Support the https://railway-stations.org OpenData project with the Railway stations photo app. Select a country and find a station without a photo. Over 20 countries are already in our database, more to be added step by step.
 Create an account under "My Data". You can contribute photos anonymously or with your nicknamen. If you like you can define a link to a social media profile of yours, e.g. Twitter, then we add it to all of your uploaded photos.

fdroid:ai.agent1c.hitomi.open.name: Open Hitomi
fdroid:ai.agent1c.hitomi.open.summary: Floating hedgehog assistant with local chat and browser tools
fdroid:ai.agent1c.hitomi.open.description:
Open Hitomi is a floating Android hedgehog assistant built around a local overlay interface.
 Current features include:
 a movable floating assistant overlay
 an in-app browser window for visible browsing and readback
 optional Termux integration for local shell-style commands
 local Solana wallet display tools
 local Ollama-compatible endpoint support
 optional xAI bring-your-own-key chat setup directly on the device
 For local setups, paste an Ollama endpoint such as http://127.0.0.1:11434 into the app. Open Hitomi will query the local server for installed models and use the first available one.
 If you prefer a hosted provider, you can also paste an xAI API key into the same field. Entered connection details stay stored locally on-device.
 Open Hitomi is intended to stay open, configurable, and suitable for local and self-hosted model routes first, with optional external providers second.

fdroid:app.xcy7e.contextium.name: Contextium
fdroid:app.xcy7e.contextium.description:
Contextium extends Android's native text-selection context menu with configurable actions for web searches.
 Select text in an app, choose Contextium , and open the selected text with one of your configured search URLs.
 Features 
 Add unlimited context-menu items.
 Configure a name, label, target URL, and URL parameter for each item.
 Reorder entries with drag and drop.
 Enable or disable entries individually.
 Export and import your configuration as a backup.
 How it works 
 Add a menu entry.
 Configure its name, URL, and parameter.
 Select text and choose Contextium.
 Choose an action to start the web search.
 The target website must support search terms passed as a URL parameter.
 For example, use https://www.google.com/search with the parameter q . Contextium then creates a URL such as https://www.google.com/search?q=foobar .

fdroid:com.bearinmind.launcher314.name: Launcher314
fdroid:com.bearinmind.launcher314.summary: Launcher with deep customization on a single screen
fdroid:com.bearinmind.launcher314.description:
I built this launcher for people to be able to easily access settings and customization all from one screen without having to go on a scavenger hunt to change something simple like row count or font size. I built this app to help me move to a more secure OS and thought oh, other people can use this too!
All your data is stored locally on the device, no exuberant permissions required such as internet connection or any data collection libraries (you can check with apps like TrackerControl or apps that will scan libraries for trackers).
One screen customization with preview windows to view your changes prior to even going into the launcher. Just like most launchers, icons, folders, and everything in the preview areas use bitmaps; while widgets are the only item using Live AndroidView. In the preview section you will see we have multiple ways to customize the launcher with columns & rows being independent of each-other in the Home Screen / App Drawer sections but only being bound by a universal icon size indicator making sure apps and text don't go out of bounds on each-other. In the app drawer you will also see a square check mark box next to the app drawer rows; this selection will switch you between the scroll mode & paged mode drawers and if you scroll further down to the scroll bar/ navigation drop down, you can customize both navigation indicators to you liking. Just above that you will notice an icon text dropdown where you can choose rom various fonts (most popular ones from other Launcher3 forks) & a way to adjust the text size.
Using this app is pretty straight forward and everything is contained in a few screens or less so you spend less time trying to figure out what a selection does or where to find a specific setting and instead just jump right in to customization and setting up the launcher; a feature I felt that most other launchers didn't do well.
Anyways who reads these descriptions anyways. Get in there buddy.
This app is free and open source software (FOSS) licensed under the GPL-3.0 License.

fdroid:com.calcitem.sanmill.name: Mill
fdroid:com.calcitem.sanmill.summary: A Mill Game which supports many rule variants, written in Flutter
fdroid:com.calcitem.sanmill.description:
A Classic Nine Men's Morris Experience
Rediscover the strategy of Nine Men's Morris, also known as the Mill game, with this digital version. Whether you are an experienced player or new to the game, this app offers a way to learn and enjoy this timeless board game.
Explore the game's features, which are designed for learning, practice, and customization. You can play the game your way, track your progress, and sharpen your skills with the help of an analysis engine.
KEY FEATURES
CLASSIC & VARIANT GAMEPLAY
Enjoy the experience of this traditional board game.
* Multiple Game Modes: Play Classic Nine Men’s Morris, along with variants like Twelve Men’s Morris, Lasker Morris, and the South African variant, Morabaraba.
* Capable AI Opponent: Challenge a computer opponent with 30 different difficulty levels, designed to provide a suitable match for players of various skill levels.
* Play with a Friend: Challenge a friend locally on a single device, or connect two devices over the same WLAN.
CUSTOMIZATION OPTIONS
Adjust the game to your preferences with a range of settings.
* Flexible Rules: You can enable or disable the "flying" endgame rule or toggle other common house rules to match the version you are familiar with.
* Visual Themes: Personalize your playing area with a selection of board backgrounds and piece designs.
* Custom Color Picker: Adjust the colors of the pieces and the board for better contrast and visibility.
* Sound Packs: Choose from different audio themes, for audio feedback during your game.
* Dark Mode & Haptics: A dark mode is available for comfortable play in low light. You can also adjust the haptic feedback for moves.
TRAINING & ANALYSIS SUITE
Improve your gameplay with some helpful tools.
* AI-Powered Positional Analysis: Use the AI to get feedback on your game. The engine provides positional evaluations to help you identify opportunities and understand mistakes.
* Unlimited Undo/Redo & Move List: You can take back moves to explore different scenarios. A clear, scrollable move list allows you to review the entire game sequence.
* Import, Export & Share Games: Share your matches using flexible import and export options. Copy games to and from your clipboard, or use the standard PGN file format. The app can directly open PGN files from your device. You can also share a quick visual by taking a screenshot and adding tactical annotations to the board.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Monitor your improvement with the statistics module.
* Detailed Game Statistics: Keep a record of your games, including your win/loss/draw record against each AI difficulty level, to see your skills develop over time.
MULTILINGUAL SUPPORT
Experience the app in your preferred language.
* Supports 60+ Languages: The app is localized in 60+ languages, including English, Persian, German, Hungarian, Chinese, Portuguese, Arabic, French, Spanish, Turkish, and many more, ensuring accessibility for a global audience.
ACCESSIBILITY & QUALITY OF LIFE
* Built for Everyone: The app is designed with accessibility in mind, featuring clear screen-reader labels, large-print board options, and multilingual support.
* In-App Feedback: You can use the built-in feedback system to send suggestions or report issues to the development team.
STRATEGY TIPS FOR NEW PLAYERS
* Playing on the cross points because they offer more way mobility to the pieces.
* Corners are weak as the player can only move in fewer directions.
* Giving the piece space to move.
* Do not make mills straight away. Usually, the first player to make a mill in the placement phase will easily get blocked.
* Black has an advantage because it gets to place the last piece strategically.
* Double attacks - be aware that players can attack two points at the same time.
Whether you are revisiting a familiar game, looking for a strategic challenge, or discovering Morris games for the first time, this app offers an enjoyable experience with flexible rules, a capable AI, and a customizable interface.

fdroid:com.filestech.notes_tech.name: Notes Tech
fdroid:com.filestech.notes_tech.summary: Encrypted Markdown notes, 100% local. No Internet permission.
fdroid:com.filestech.notes_tech.description:
Notes Tech: 100% local Markdown note-taking, encrypted at rest. Written in Kotlin.
 Radical privacy 
• No INTERNET permission — verifiable with aapt dump permissions app.apk 
• No account, no telemetry, no tracker, no advertising
• SQLCipher AES-256 database, key sealed by the Android Keystore
• Multi-step panic mode: wipes keys, database and dictation model in seconds
• Optional app lock: a PIN, plus strong biometrics if you wish
 Per-folder vaults 
• Argon2id passphrase (m=64MB, t=3) or Keystore-bound PIN (Android 9+)
• AES-256-GCM per note, bound to its note (anti-swap)
• PIN auto-wipe after 5 failures
• Configurable auto-lock (5 min to never)
 On-device voice dictation 
• whisper.cpp built into the app; Whisper model imported manually
• SHA-256 verified at import and before loading
• Recordings deleted after transcription
 Editing 
• Notes open to be read (Markdown: headings, lists, links); “Edit” to write, autosave
• Long press to select notes, then archive, move, trash with Undo, pin, color or delete them at once
• An Archive for the notes you keep out of your lists
• Notes that erase themselves: after 1 hour, 24 hours, 7 or 30 days, or after reading
• Share a note sealed: an encrypted file that only its code opens, sent by any app
• Quick drop: write a note without unlocking the app, from a quick settings tile or the icon's shortcuts
• The keyboard is asked not to learn what you type
• A pastel colour per note in the lists (a vault note's only while its vault is open)
• [[Title]] backlinks with autocomplete + "notes linking here" panel
• Instant FTS5 search, find in note with highlighted matches, configurable sort
• Markdown export, one note or a ZIP (YAML frontmatter, Obsidian/Logseq compatible)
• Import of Markdown, text and ZIP files; share text or files from other apps
• Encrypted backup of your notes and vaults, restored without overwriting anything
 Five languages 
• English, French, German, Italian, Spanish — chosen in Settings
• Light / dark / system theme
• Privacy policy and terms in the five languages
 Permissions 
• Microphone: dictation only, asked when you turn it on
• Biometrics: app lock only, gives access to no data
 Open source Apache 2.0 
Full and verifiable source code on GitHub: gitubpatrice/notes_tech
For thinkers, therapists, students, researchers, writers and journalists who want to take sensitive or dense notes without them ever leaving their phone.

fdroid:com.io7m.exfilac.main.name: Exfilac
fdroid:com.io7m.exfilac.main.summary: Simple, reliable, automated S3 uploads for Android.
fdroid:com.io7m.exfilac.main.description:
The exfilac application is a simple application that aims to do one thing well:
Get data out of Android devices and into S3 buckets.
Features:
- The application can work with any S3-compatible storage provider. This
 includes Amazon AWS, Vultr Object Storage, IDrive®, and many other commercial
 offerings. Additionally, the application can work with self-hosted S3 storage
 solutions such as MinIO.
- The application can (recursively) upload the contents of any directory on an
 Android device to which it has been granted access. The set of directories
 is configurable.
- The application conserves precious bandwidth by avoiding uploading files that
 already exist on the remote storage. The cryptographic hashes of files are
 computed locally and files are only uploaded if the hashes of
 the files on the remote server do not match.
- The application can be configured to upload files on a timed schedule,
 and/or in response to various events occurring on the device such as a photo
 being taken, or the network becoming available.
- The application vigorously respects the privacy of users: The application
 contains no telemetry or analytics of any kind, and never collects any user data.
- Development of the application is performed in the open. The complete source code is made available under
 an extremely liberal ISC license, and development and bug tracking is handled
 in a public GitHub repository.
- The application rejects bug-prone Android programming practices and libraries
 and instead strives for correctness and stability using battle-hardened,
 well-tested components designed outside the traditional Android ecosystem.
- The application adopts a cautious development approach and does not pursue
 huge sets of complex features. The application attempts to adhere to the Unix
 philosophy and provide a simple, sharp tool that does one thing well.
- The application attempts to respect the intelligence of users. Technical
 details of many aspects of the system are clearly displayed onscreen, and
 important information is not hidden in the misguided pursuit of
 "user-friendliness".
- The application is comprehensively documented.

fdroid:com.nvllz.piggsy.name: Piggsy
fdroid:com.nvllz.piggsy.summary: Piggy banks for tracking your goals
fdroid:com.nvllz.piggsy.description:
Create multiple piggy banks for anything you’re saving for, whether it’s a trip, a new gadget, or a rainy-day fund. Each piggy bank can have its own currency, optional deadline, and short description.
The biggest advantage is that the app isn't tied to your actual balance. Think of it as a detailed visualization of your goals, not a friction making it difficult to transfer money between accounts when you need to change your plans. You just get to know how much money you can spend, everything else is up to you.
Add or subtract money as needed and keep a record of all your transactions. You can also add short notes to transactions to keep track of details. Automatic backups will keep your data safe behind the scenes.

fdroid:com.philkes.notallyx.name: NotallyX - Quick Notes/Tasks
fdroid:com.philkes.notallyx.summary: A simple and minimalistic open source notes app
fdroid:com.philkes.notallyx.description:
NotallyX is a minimalistic note taking app with a simple design and powerful features.
 Organization 
• Create rich text notes with support for bold, italics, mono space and more
• Create task lists and order them with subtasks
• Set reminders with notifications for important notes
• Complement your notes with any type of file such as pictures, PDFs, etc.
• Sort notes by title, last modified date, creation date
• Display the notes either in a List or Grid
• Color, pin and label your notes for quick organisation
• Add clickable links to notes with support for phone numbers, email addresses and web urls
• Actions to quickly remove checked tasks
• Undo/Redo actions
• Extensive preferences to adjust views to your liking
• Quickly share notes by text
• Lock your notes via Biometric/PIN
• Configurable auto-backups
• Create audio notes
• Adaptive android app icon
• Support for Lollipop devices and up
 Convenience 
• Dark mode
• Completely free (+ no Ads!)
• Adjustable text size
• Auto save and auto-backups (optionally password-protected)
• Add notes and lists to your home screen with widgets
• Import from other Notes apps such as Evernote, Google Keep or plain text files
 Privacy 
There are no ads, trackers or analytics of any kind. All your notes are stored completely on and never leave your device.
 Optional Permissions 
• Show Notifications, Run Foreground Service: To display a notification if a backup fails or if reminders are triggered
• Schedule exact Alarms: To schedule reminder notifications at exact date-times
• Prevent Phone from Sleeping, Run at Startup: Used by the auto backup feature to ensure backups keep happening even if your phone is restarted
• Record audio: when recording an audio note
• Use Biometrics: if Biometric/PIN app lock setting is enabled, to unlock the app
 Note 
Due to a bug on Xiaomi's part, some MiUI devices might not be able to access the text formatting options.
https://github.com/Crustack/NotallyX

fdroid:com.tharunbirla.librecuts.name: LibreCuts Beta
fdroid:com.tharunbirla.librecuts.summary: LibreCuts is a free, open-source privacy friendly video editor for Android.

LibreCuts is a free and open-source video editor for Android focused on simplicity, performance, and privacy. Edit and export watermark free videos entirely on your device.

 Features

 Audio: Import audio, boost volume up to 200%, or mute the original audio.
 Crop: Crop videos to custom aspect ratios.

 Speed: Speed up or slow down videos.
 Adjust & Filters: Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, and apply filters.

 Timeline Tools: Snap clips, duplicate overlays, and create freeze frames.

fdroid:contact.emergency.codes.name: Contact
fdroid:contact.emergency.codes.summary: Calling and messaging with built-in emergency tools
fdroid:contact.emergency.codes.description:
Contact enhances everyday calling and messaging with built-in emergency tools, including silent text-to-911, live video dispatch, real-time location sharing, medical-profile relay, and routing to 988, 311, and 211.
The 911, 988, 311, and 211 integrations are designed for services in the United States. Availability and emergency numbers differ in other countries.
The application provides familiar calls, messages, contacts, a keypad, and recent activity without requiring a separate emergency workflow.
Contact is not a certified emergency service. Its emergency integrations are experimental and educational, and availability depends on device, carrier, location, and public-safety infrastructure.

fdroid:de.computerelite.shockalarm.description:
ShockAlarm is a powerful tool for controlling and managing your Shockers with OpenShock. It allows you to fully manage your shockers, logs, shares, hubs, share links, api tokens and more.
There is advanced functionaity like setting alarms, controling multiple shockers at the same time and specifying a random interval for intensity, duration or a delay (if you're into that).
It's fully material you themed just like the standard Android apps you're already used to and provides a responsive ui with a nice design.
Furthermore it fixes some layout flaws of the official OpenShock Frontend like having shared and own shockers in seperate tabs (which is annoying). On top it also has lots of info buttons you can press to get more insight on what something does.
ShockAlarm aims to be a feature complete client supporting all features supported by OpenShock and expanding on them
This app uses https://openshock.app/ by default however self hosted instances can be used as well.

fdroid:de.pascalstier.fossyprotokoll.name: Fossy Protokoll
fdroid:de.pascalstier.fossyprotokoll.summary: Document rental defects and build protocols — offline, no tracking.
fdroid:de.pascalstier.fossyprotokoll.description:
Fossy Protokoll helps tenants in Germany keep a verifiable record of defects in
their flat: noise disturbance, mould, heating failures and more.
From the recorded occurrences it builds a protocol covering a chosen period, and
a factual defect notification addressed to the landlord. Both can be saved and
shared as PDF or Markdown.
 Note: the app is in German 
The interface and all generated documents are written in German, because they
follow German residential tenancy practice.
 Not legal advice 
The app documents, it does not advise. The generated texts cite no statutes,
claim no rent reduction and set no deadline of their own. A response date only
appears when you enter one yourself.
 Everything stays on the device 
Data lives in a local database, photos in the app's private directory. The app
requests no permission that touches your data or the device, never accesses
the network, and contains no
tracking or analytics. When you export something, you choose the destination
yourself.
Android's automatic backup is switched off as well, so your defects and photos
never reach a cloud account. Instead you can create a full backup as a ZIP file
at any time and restore it later, for instance when moving to a new phone.
Without such a backup the data is lost if the device is.
 Features 
* Manage tenant profile, rental units and landlords
* Record defects by category: noise, mould, heating, hot water, damp, sanitary,
 electrics, windows and doors, pests, other
* Document individual occurrences with period, category, affected room,
 severity, impact, witnesses and notes
* Attach photos to defects and to individual occurrences, with captions
* Assemble protocols over a period and refresh them later
* Generate a defect notification for the landlord
* Export as PDF with embedded photos, or as Markdown
* Full backup and restore as a ZIP file
 Free and open source 
The source code is available under GPL-3.0-or-later. The app uses no proprietary
libraries.

fdroid:de.singular.crystalball.name: Crystal Ball
fdroid:de.singular.crystalball.summary: Detects guitar chords and combines them into song sheets.
fdroid:de.singular.crystalball.description:
Crystal Ball listens to your guitar and tells you what chord you just played. Press Detect single chord, strum, and it names the chord and draws how to fret it — with the chords it nearly picked instead one tap away, and other ways to play the same one further up the neck. Capture a whole part and it becomes a song sheet you can keep, correct and share.
Early-stage release — expect rough edges. Feedback and bug reports welcome via Issues.
Features:
* Detect a chord by ear — press, strum, done. It listens until the answer settles rather than for a fixed time, so a clean open chord resolves in about a third of a second; strumming again restarts it, so a bad take needs no second press.
* Ranked alternatives — the best fit is a guess, not ground truth, so the runner-ups sit under it and one tap swaps the page over to any of them.
* Chord shapes, not just names — the most idiomatic grip drawn large, plus other voicings walking up the neck. Open shapes are the ones a player expects to see, by name.
* Capo-aware — detection is unaffected (the microphone hears the real chord either way), but the shapes are redrawn behind the capo, fret numbers stay as printed on your neck, and anything the capo pushes off the end is dropped rather than offered. Chords can be named by what you hear or by the shape your hands make.
* Song sheets — capture a part chord by chord, name it Intro or Chorus, reorder the parts, and read the whole song back as diagrams. Parts can be renamed, chords fixed by hand without playing them again, and the finished sheet shared to any app.
* Chord dictionary — look any of 252 chords up by hand, without playing a note. Power chords, sixths, ninths, 6/9 and 13ths included.
* Chord finder — set the dots on a guitar neck and it names the shape, slash bass included, with other names for the same notes and chords a finger away. Behind a capo it names what sounds, and the capo drags along the neck.
* English and German — pick the app's language without changing the whole phone. German note names (H/B) are a separate switch, since being taught H is not the same as reading German.
* Session comforts — System/Light/Dark themes, keep-screen-on, an optional capo prompt at launch, an in-app quick help sheet, and backup/restore for your songs. Preferences persist across launches.
Heard: maj, min, 7, maj7, m7, sus2, sus4, across all 12 roots. Drawn: those plus 5, dim, aug, m7b5, dim7, 7sus4, 6, m6, add9, 9, maj9, m9, 6/9 and 13 — yours to look up and write down, though the microphone will not name them. Shapes assume standard tuning (EADGBE).
Honest about accuracy: template matching on clean triads is good, and degrades on a boomy room, a badly tuned guitar, or a phone held across the room. It is a practice aid, not ground truth — hence the runner-up row, which is one tap from correcting it.
Microphone access is required — listening to your guitar is the whole app. Audio is analysed on the fly and never recorded, stored or sent anywhere; the app has no network permission at all.
No ads, no trackers, no network access.

fdroid:io.github.adithya_jayan.myreperto.name: Repertoire
fdroid:io.github.adithya_jayan.myreperto.summary: An app for musicians to track their repertoire and media.
fdroid:io.github.adithya_jayan.myreperto.description:
Repertoire is a cross-platform application designed for musicians, dancers, magicians, or performers to help manage their repertoire (musical pieces, dance routines, or even magic tricks).
The app helps you keep your sheet music, notes, audio recordings, videos, links, and practice logs neatly organized for every piece in your collection.
 - Create a library of your pieces/songs, with all related information attached. 
 - Save related media like recordings, links and notes in one consolidated location. 
 - Log your practice sessions. Keep in touch with stuff you learnt over time.
 - Tag your pieces and organize your gallery into groups. Quick and easy search and filter functionality to find what you want.
 - Various quality of life features, like thumbnails for your pieces, speed control for audio (If you want to practice slow), etc.
 - Personalization options to make it to your liking, and automated and manual backup options so you don't lose any data.

fdroid:net.opendasharchive.openarchive.r.name: Save by OpenArchive
fdroid:net.opendasharchive.openarchive.r.summary: Safely preserve, organize, and share your mobile media

Save (Share Archive Verify Encrypt) by OpenArchive enables you to safely preserve, organize, and share your mobile media.
* Upload any type of media to a private server or directly to the Internet Archive and the WebDAV Servers.

fdroid:org.koreader.launcher.fdroid.name: KOReader
fdroid:org.koreader.launcher.fdroid.description:
KOReader is an ebook reader optimized for e-ink screens. It can open many formats and provides advanced text adjustments.
 See below for a selection of its many features:
 Supports both fixed page formats (PDF, DjVu, CBT, CBZ) and reflowable e-book formats (EPUB, FB2, Mobi, DOC, CHM, TXT, HTML). Scanned PDF/DjVu documents can be reflowed. Special flow directions for reading double column PDFs and manga.
 Multi-lingual user interface optimized for e-ink screens. Highly customizable reader view with complete typesetting options. Multi-lingual hyphenation dictionaries are bundled in.
 Non-Latin script support for books, including the Hebrew, Arabic, Persian, Russian, Chinese, Japanese and Korean languages.
 Unique Book Map and Page Browser features to navigate your book.
 Special multi-page highlight mode with many local and online export options.
 Can synchronize your reading progress across all your KOReader running devices.
 Integrated with Calibre, Wallabag, Wikipedia, Google Translate and other content providers.

fdroid:org.smssecure.smssecure.name: Silence
fdroid:org.smssecure.smssecure.description:

Silence is an SMS/MMS application that allows you to protect your privacy while communicating with friends.

Guandan (掼蛋) is a Chinese climbing card game for four players in two partnerships, played with two decks. Teams start at level 2 and work their way up to Ace, and the red hearts of the current level are wild — they can stand in for any card.

* Bots fill any empty seat, so you can start a game on a single device

* A hint button when you are not sure what to play
* Five colour themes, including a light mode, remembered between sessions
All devices need to be on the same Wi-Fi network. Tribute (进贡) is not implemented.

flathub:com.betterstickies.BetterStickie.name: Better Stickies
flathub:com.betterstickies.BetterStickie.description:
Capture ideas, tasks, and deadlines on colorful notes that live on your desktop instead of disappearing
 into a folder. Each note holds rich text, checklists, screenshots, file shortcuts, and a reminder
 — so the thing you want to remember stays in front of you until you act on it.
 Features:
 Rich text formatting (bold, italic, strikethrough, titles)
 Customizable colors and background images
 Reminder system with desktop notifications
 Dark and light theme support
 Drag and drop file shortcuts
 Checkbox and todo lists with strikethrough
 Code block auto-detection with syntax styling
 Customizable in-app keyboard shortcuts
 Export to TXT, Markdown, JSON
 The free version includes up to 4 notes (tabs count toward the limit). Premium removes the limit
 and unlocks inside the app (About › Activate Premium…), on up to 5 computers per account. The app
 uses the network only once, at activation.

flathub:com.github.Flacon.name: Flacon
flathub:com.github.Flacon.summary: Flacon extracts individual tracks from one big audio file containing the entire album of music and saves them as separate audio files
flathub:com.github.Flacon.description:
Flacon extracts individual tracks from one big audio file containing the entire album of music
 and saves them as separate audio files. To do this, it uses information from the appropriate CUE
 file. Besides, Flacon makes it possible to conveniently revise or specify tags both for all tracks
 at once or for each tag separately.
 Supported input formats: WAV, FLAC, APE, WavPack, True Audio (TTA)
 Supported output formats: FLAC, WAV, WavPack, AAC, OGG or MP3
 Support of profiles, you can have different encoding options for different cases, such as
 maximum quality for your computer, and CD quality for your phone
 Replay Gain analysis (album-gain and track-gain modes)
 Multi-threaded conversion process
 Automatic character set detection for CUE files
 Generation of the pertrack CUE file in the output dir

flathub:com.nedrichards.octopusagile.name: Agile Rates
flathub:com.nedrichards.octopusagile.summary: Rates and usage for UK smart electricity tariffs
flathub:com.nedrichards.octopusagile.description:
Follow current and upcoming half-hour electricity rates, usage history, and estimated spend
 for supported Octopus Energy electricity tariffs in the UK.
 Check the current rate at a glance, and find the cheapest time to run appliances or charge devices.
 This app is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Octopus Energy.

flathub:com.polydez.KeyVault.name: OTP Authenticator App
flathub:com.polydez.KeyVault.description:
KeyVault is a secure 2FA/OTP manager that helps you store and manage all your two-factor
 authentication codes and time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) in one secure location.
 All data is stored locally and only on your devices. This app can be used as-is or, manually sync
 2FA codes from one device to another with the import/export tool. 
 KeyVault also has an Android and Windows version which allows you to import/export your codes
 with ease and with encryption (offline). 
 Features:
 Secure storage for all your 2FA and OTP tokens (keys are stored on device, never online)
 Automatic TOTP code generation
 Easy organization of authentication codes
 Cross-platform support (Android, Windows available, with Mac and iPhone coming soon)
 Pro Features (unlocked with KeyVault Pro License on Android)
 Create and categorize your OTP codes
 Customize your OTP codes with colors and icons
 Personalize KeyVault OTP app with custom themes
 Activate PIN for security

flathub:com.thincast.client.name: Thincast Remote Desktop Client
flathub:com.thincast.client.summary: A free RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol) Client for Linux, macOS and Windows
flathub:com.thincast.client.description:
Thincast Client allows you to connect to virtual applications and desktops over the RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol). It offers features like built-in support for redirecting webcams, configuring remote apps, regular security updates and hardware-accelerated video decoding to extend the battery life of your device, ideal when working on the go. Using the Remote Desktop (RD) WebAccess Client you gain easy access to and control of published virtual machines (with Thincast Workstation), desktop sessions and applications. Initial support for 64-bit ARM based devices (aarch64 only) like Raspberry Pi has been added with V. 1.0.184.
 As of today, we are the main contributor to the FreeRDP project.

flathub:dev.aadhil.devtpro.name: DevT Pro
flathub:dev.aadhil.devtpro.summary: Essential developer tools in one fast, offline app
flathub:dev.aadhil.devtpro.description:
DevT Pro brings more than 100 everyday developer tools into one fast, keyboard-friendly desktop
 app. Convert, format, validate, inspect and generate data without sending anything to a server.
 Convert between JSON, XML, YAML, CSV, TSV, TOML and TOON
 Generate Java, C#, TypeScript, Python, Dart and Kotlin models from JSON
 Format, minify and validate JSON, XML, YAML, SQL, HTML, CSS and JavaScript
 Encode and decode URLs, Base64 and JWTs, with tree and table viewers for structured data
 Generate hashes, encrypt text, and create UUIDs, ULIDs, passwords and secret keys
 Test regular expressions, compare text, convert timestamps and parse cron expressions
 Generate and read QR codes
 Quickly find any tool with the command palette, work across multiple tabs, and drag files directly
 into supported editors.
 DevT Pro is free to use with a limited set of tools. A one-time license key, bought from a link
 in the app, unlocks every tool, the devtpro command line, the MCP server and deep links.

flathub:org.kde.kid3.name: Kid3
flathub:org.kde.kid3.description:
With Kid3, an audio tag editor, you can edit tags in MP3, Ogg/Vorbis, DSF, FLAC, Opus, MPC,
 APE, MP4/AAC, MP2, Speex, TrueAudio, WavPack, WMA, WAV, AIFF and tracker files.
 All frames in the ID3 tags of MP3 files can be edited, and it is possible to convert between
 ID3v1.1, ID3v2.3 and ID3v2.4. Synchronized lyrics can be edited, imported and exported to LRC Karaoke
 files.
 The tags of multiple files can be set together. It is possible to generate tags from file names
 or the contents of other tag fields and to generate file names from tags and rename folders from
 tags. Automatic case conversion and string replacement help to keep tags consistent.
 Album data can be imported from gnudb.org, MusicBrainz, Discogs, Amazon; automatic batch import
 is available for multiple folders. It is also possible to export data and generate play lists.
 Kid3 uses the KDE Frameworks. Users of other desktop environments may prefer Kid3-qt instead,
 which is without KDE dependencies.

flathub:org.sil.dictionary-app-builder.name: Dictionary App Builder
flathub:org.sil.dictionary-app-builder.description: Dictionary App Builder helps you to build customized dictionary apps for Android and iOS smartphones and tablets. You specify the lexicon data file to use, the app name, fonts, colors, the about box information, the audio, illustrations and the icons. Dictionary App Builder will package everything together and build the customized app for you. You can then install it on your phone, send it to others by Bluetooth, share it on microSD memory cards and publish it to app stores on the Internet.

firefox-addons:945329.name: Open With Internet Download Manager
firefox-addons:945329.summary: Open and download desired links with internet download manager.
firefox-addons:945329.description:
Open With Internet Download Manager is a browser extension that enables you to open and download a desired item with an Internet Download Manager (IDM) application. 
To operate with this add-on you need a native-client patch to connect your browser with native IDM application in your OS. Please read the following to get more info on how to install native-client and operate with this add-on.
1) after installing the add-on, you need to connect it with native applications (i.e. IDM) on your machine. If you do not have IDM, please head to ( internetdownloadmanager.com/download.html ) and install IDM on your machine. Once you have IDM, you need to make the connection between IDM and your browser.
2) to make this connection, a separate patch is provided in GitHub. Please download and install this patch from: https://github.com/alexmarcoo/open-in-native-client/releases 
Follow the instruction in the above GitHub repo to download and install the related patch to your system. After installing, the "Open With Internet Download Manager" add-on, your browser can communicate with IDM on your machine (i.e. Window OS).
3) before using the add-on, please open the option's page and make sure the path to IDM is correct based on your operating system. For example, the path to IDM in Window 10 is: C:\Program Files (x86)\Internet Download Manager\IDMan.exe
Next, please follow the below steps to open and download desired links in IDM.
a. right click on a download link and then click on the - Download with Internet Download Manager - from the context-menu.
b. IDM has several input arguments to enhance downloading desired files. The default argument for downloading is: /d. To get more info about other arguments please open the add-on option's page and read section arguments. Please note that, you need to add parameters comma separated, for example to automatically download a file write: "/d,/n" in the designated area.
c. you can set the IDM path in your machine from the options page.
To report any bug, please fill the bug report form in the add-on's homepage .

firefox-addons:3118620.name: CherryPickd: Smarter Shopping Checkout
firefox-addons:3118620.summary: Cherry-pick what you buy across thousands of stores. Check out with today's picks, then restore the rest to your cart with one click.
firefox-addons:3118620.description:
Your cart has 8 things. You want to buy 2 today. CherryPickd lets you check out with just those 2, and keeps the other 6 safe so you can put them back in one click.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Open your cart. Click the CherryPickd button next to Checkout.
2. Mark each item Today or Later. You see the total for today's items as you go.
3. Click to set the Later items aside. Big cart? Tap "All later", then tap Today on the few you want. CherryPickd takes them out of the store cart (on stores with tick boxes, like SHEIN, it unticks them) and keeps a list in your browser.
4. Check out as normal.
5. Come back and click "Put back". CherryPickd adds the items to your cart again and checks the cart to make sure they really arrived. If an item did not come back (for example, it sold out), it tells you which one.
PRICE DROPS ON SAVED ITEMS
When you visit a store, CherryPickd checks today's price of the items you saved from that store (up to 8 items, at most once every 6 hours) and shows you when a price went down. It only checks while you are on the store. It does not run in the background, and it does not work on Target or SHEIN yet.
WHERE IT WORKS
• Switches on at thousands of online stores built on Shopify, WooCommerce and BigCommerce.
• Also has store code for big stores such as Amazon, Target, Walmart, SHEIN, SKIMS, Ulta Beauty, Gap, Nordstrom, Mango, H&M, Macy's, Best Buy, Canada Goose, Lancôme and Jomashop. If a store does not work in Firefox, email us.
• On any other Shopify, WooCommerce or BigCommerce shop, click the CherryPickd icon (in the toolbar or the Extensions menu) and choose "Turn on for this shop".
• Desktop Firefox.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No site access at install. You turn it on one store at a time, and you can turn it off at any time.
• Your set-aside items stay in this browser. They are not sent to us.
• No account, no sign-in, no passwords.
• No affiliate links, codes or cookies. CherryPickd never replaces a creator's link or code.
FREE
CherryPickd is free to use.
Questions or a store that does not work? Email support@getcherrypickd.com .

CREATE PURE

If you love unhinged reactions, silly creature noises, and strategic merge evolution, this is your new obsession! Create brainrot animals, craft absurd creatures, and push your italian brainrot evolution to its absolute limit.
CREATE PURE BRAINROT CHAOS
Drag, mix, and match traits to build the funniest and most unpredictable brainrot animals.
Every merge triggers new mutations, goofy animations, and silly sounds that turn each run into a meme.
- Mix traits to create hybrid beasts
- Trigger weird reactions and unexpected combos
- Watch your brainrot evolution spiral into madness
This isn’t a normal animal game, it’s a full brainrot game with creativity gone feral.
BATTLE WITH YOUR CREATIONS
Take your creatures into fast, chaotic animal battles.
Outsmart enemies, choose the right hybrid, and crush opponents with raw, unhinged power.
- Strategic matchups
- Meme-worthy animations
- High-stakes animal battle moments
- Climb the ranks of true brainrot evolution masters
- Every victory brings bigger rewards… and even weirder creatures.
BUILD THE STRONGEST BRAINROT ANIMALS
Unlock new species, stack abilities, and grow your zoo of madness.
Your success depends on smart decisions AND your tolerance for meme chaos.
- Over 100+ trait combinations
- Merge evolution paths
- Endless creature merge variations
- Surprising synergies and funny animals
The deeper you go, the louder and more unhinged the brainrot animals become.
CHAOTIC FUN, ZERO RULES
Zoologic makes brainrot evolution feel alive with:
- absurd creature designs
- silly sounds and meme-level reactions
- fast merge evolution gameplay
- constant surprises
- pure “what did I just create” energy
Perfect if you want a brainrot game that’s both strategic and stupid in all the right ways.
PLAY HOW YOU WANT
- short, chaotic sessions
- long breed-and-battle runs
- offline play
- simple controls, deep combos
- fully free to play
Whether you're here for logic, laughs, or full-on meme chaos, Zoologic delivers.
 Download Zoologic now!! 
Craft bizarre hybrids, master your brainrot evolution, and dominate every animal battle with the most unhinged brainrot animals ever created.

bluejetty:00146942:ios.summary:
The Lincoln app elevates your ownership. Clean, effortless and easily customizable, the Lincoln app lets you remote start, lock and unlock, use your phone as a key, and monitor your GPS location at no extra cost.
Features list for consider
bluejetty:00146942:ios.description:
The Lincoln app elevates your ownership. Clean, effortless and easily customizable, the Lincoln app lets you remote start, lock and unlock, use your phone as a key, and monitor your GPS location at no extra cost.
Features list for consideration:
• Remote Features*: Get added control with features like remote start, lock and unlock, and more in the palm of your hand.
• Vehicle Management: Keep track of your fuel or range status, vehicle stats — and use your Phone As A Key — with a simple tap.
• Scheduling Service: Select your preferred dealer and schedule maintenance to keep your Lincoln running smoothly. 
• Connected Services: Activate available trials, purchase plans, or manage services like BlueCruise, the Lincoln Connectivity Package, and more.
• GPS Location: Never lose sight of your Lincoln with GPS tracking. 
• Lincoln App Updates: Updated regularly to give you the latest features and information. 
• Lincoln Access Rewards: Use Lincoln Access Rewards to redeem points for Lincoln Service, Accessories, available Connected Services, and more**.
• Over-the-Air Software Updates: Set your software update schedule through the Lincoln app or directly in your vehicle.
*Disclaimer Language* 
The Lincoln app, compatible with select smartphone platforms, is available via a download. Message and data rates may apply.
*An activated vehicle modem and the Lincoln app are required for remote features. Evolving technology/cellular networks/vehicle capability may limit or prevent functionality. Remote features may vary by model.
**Must have an activated Lincoln Access Rewards account to receive Lincoln Access Rewards Points. Points are not redeemable for cash and have no monetary value. Point earning and redemption values are approximate and vary by products and services redeemed. See the Lincoln Access Rewards Program Terms and conditions at LincolnAccessRewards.com for information regarding expiration, redemption, forfeiture, and other limitations on Lincoln Access Rewards Points.

NoteAI – Your Intelligent Note-Taking Assistant
NoteAI is a revolutionary note-taking app powered by advanced artificial intelligence, designed to capture, organize, and share your thoughts seamlessly. Whether you’re in a meeting, lecture, brainstorming session, or simply capturing spontaneous ideas, NoteAI makes it effortless.
Key Features:
Smart Recording & Transcription:
Record your meetings, lectures, or on-the-go ideas, and let our AI-powered engine instantly convert your speech into text. No more manual note-taking—just clear, accurate transcriptions at your fingertips.
Instant Summaries:
Quickly generate concise summaries of your recordings. Our AI extracts the key points, allowing you to review and share the essence of your conversations without sifting through lengthy texts.
Organized Note Management:
Keep your notes in perfect order with customizable folders. Mark important notes as favorites and use our intuitive search functionality to find what you need, exactly when you need it.
Seamless Sharing:
Easily share your transcribed notes and summaries with colleagues, friends, or team members with just a few taps. Collaboration has never been easier.
Flexible Subscription Options:
Enjoy a robust set of free features or upgrade to our PRO plan for unlimited recordings, enhanced transcription accuracy, and premium support. There’s a plan that fits your needs.
Why Choose NoteAI?
NoteAI is built for simplicity and efficiency. Its user-friendly interface and powerful AI integration help you focus on what truly matters—capturing ideas and insights without interruption. Experience a new level of productivity and ensure you never miss an important detail again.
Embrace the future of note-taking with NoteAI—where intelligent automation meets effortless organization. Download now and transform the way you capture your world!
You can unlock all features via auto-renewable subscription: 
we offer three auto-renewing subscription options: weekly subscription, monthly subscription, annual subscription.
By subscribing you get unlimited access to all NoteAI features.
Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account.
You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Your account will be charged according to your plan for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
If you wish to avoid auto-renewal you must turn it off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period in your Account Settings.

bluejetty:00097062:ios.description:
Game Overview：
A thrilling horror-themed casual tower defense game that blends strategy, skill, and intense action. Tap to command weapons, fend off monsters, and protect your sacred sigil!
 Gameplay：
1.Tap and React:
 Tap weapons, life energy, or boost icons inside the magic field. Your character spins and runs within the circle—step on a weapon to unleash attacks, on a heart to restore HP, and on buffs to trigger power-ups!
2.Battle System:
 Hordes of monsters swarm from all directions—zombie dogs, undead rats, and terrifying bosses await. Swap between weapons like bows or blades, upgrade levels to boost damage and attack speed, and strengthen life energy to survive relentless waves of horror.
3.Progression & Rewards:
 Clear stages to earn Diamonds and Gold, unlock new weapons, characters (like “Little Red”), and eerie stages such as “Dachang High School”.
4.Extra Features:
 Visit the Shop to buy weapon shards, power-ups, or bonuses with gold, diamonds, or ads. Collect monster entries in the Bestiary for extra rewards and deeper exploration.
 Experience：
Grow stronger through every battle—face the horror, defend your circle, and unleash your ultimate weapons in this chilling monster siege!

bluejetty:00071613:ios.description:
Fasting App is the easiest way to keep track of your eating routine, get tips along the way and make your daily fasting better. Reach your goal weight, get healthy and boost your energy in a fasting community.
The fasting method is safe and natural. This is your way of feeling at your best with the healthy and effective weight-loss method, that is trusted by hundreds of millions of people worldwide.
You don't need to count calories all the time. Enjoy your food, then fast some part of the day. When fasting, your body goes into a fat burning process called ketosis. You’ll feel light and full of energy during this time to do what you love and lose fat at the same time!
The app is great for beginners and experienced fasters alike. We'll help you find a plan that suits you and your goal. Then you'll get tips and motivation to stick to your plan.
You don’t need to change your eating habits or avoid any groups of food. Just start fasting in the evening for at least 12 hours, most of which will occur when you are sleeping. Use Fasting App to get the most out of each day.
Let's start the journey to a better version of yourself. You will see the result in the mirror in just a few weeks. Get the long-lasting health benefits.
Subscription & Terms
Fasting App is a freemium. You can use some intermittent fasting plans for free as well as get a personal plan and all the app's features by subscribing. Subscribe in the app to get premium access.
You can also choose a trial period and try all the premium features for free. No obligation, free to cancel anytime.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after purchase.
Read our Terms of Service at: https://fasting.beauty/termsofuse/
For the Privacy Policy, please visit: https://fasting.beauty/privacy/

bluejetty:00138365:ios.description:
Break through language barriers, communicate naturally, and build connections.
【Why Timekettle】
Translate online across 54 languages and 108 accents, with offline translation available for 25 language pairs. For one-on-one conversations, each person wears one earbud to hear translations as you speak—without waiting for the other person to finish or passing a device back and forth. When you’re offline, keep communicating using supported offline language pairs.
Designed for international business, business trips, studying abroad, travel, and everyday conversations across languages.
【Key Features】
• One-on-One: Translate face-to-face conversations in real time, with each person hearing translations in their own language.
• Live Listening: Listen to translations and follow the translated text in real time during meetings, presentations, and classes.
• Voice Call Translation: Communicate across languages on supported devices and in supported calling scenarios.
• Multi-Media Translation: Translate audio and video content to help you understand information in other languages.
• Device & Translation History Management: Connect your earbuds, set languages, and view and export your translation history. 
【Compatible Devices】
LiveTalk, W4 Plus, W4 Pro, W4, M3, WT2 Edge (W3), WT2 Plus, M2, ZERO
Some features require compatible Timekettle translation earbuds. Feature and language availability varies by device model, operating system version, and service conditions.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://cdn.timekettle.co/agreement_en.html

bluejetty:00193129:android.name: Code Z Day: Horror Survival 3D
bluejetty:00193129:android.summary: Are you a fan of tickling your nerves? Are you attracted by gloomy abandoned premises? Is it a pleasure to wander in thre dark and not know where a monster will jump at you from? Do you feel like a fish in water in an atmosphere of horror?
bluejetty:00193129:android.description:
Are you a fan of tickling your nerves? Are you attracted by gloomy abandoned premises? Is it a pleasure to wander in thre dark and not know where a monster will jump at you from? Do you feel like a fish in water in an atmosphere of horror? Do you like it when the veins shake with fear? Aren't you afraid of blood in shooters? Does disturbing music caress your ear? Sure your nerves are like ropes? Then you urgently need the novelty of 2021 - the cool horror shooter Code Z Day! The game works without internet!
The plot is right! Endless icy space, in the darkness of which a lonely space station glows faintly. It looks abandoned. Doesn't send distress signals. The station name Edelheim pulsates with a green emergency light. Twilight reigns inside, the team seems to have evaporated. Suddenly, somewhere in the depths of the station, shots are heard, terrible inhuman screams are heard, and after a moment everything calms down again. Cautious creeping footsteps are heard. A man with a weapon appears from around the corner. And this person is you! You are the only survivor in this cursed, forgotten place. A long time ago, you lost count for a long time, the station was taken over by monsters. They killed the entire team and damaged the communication system with the outside world, so there is nowhere to wait for help. Your whole life is a struggle to survive.
Code Z Day is a classic first-person shooter set in a chilling horror setting. An easy shooter in which your task is to hit the creatures without a miss. A convenient sight helps you in this, if it glows red - pull the trigger without hesitation, you will 100% shoot the fiend of hell. Merciless action-mixing keeps you in suspense all the time, mutants climb on you from all cracks, only have time to exterminate them. The more monsters you send to the next world, the more ammunition you need - use the adventure game option, explore the territory, collect ammo, look for secret places with useful game bonuses.
Separately, it is worth mentioning the excellent 3D graphics of the game, with clear vivid renderings. The free first-person camera option will take you into gloomy corridors, where a bloodthirsty mutant can jump out at you from around every corner. A comfortable motor option with a quick turn, running skill and the ability to move backward with your back more than once will help you save your life.
C

bluejetty:00026858:ios.description:
eSign App will turn your iPhone or iPad into a powerful instrument for e-signing PDF documents and other formats, and it also allows you to send documents for signature to another party.
Quickly import or scan, add a signature, and share any document as a PDF or JPG file. You don’t need an Internet connection because all documents are stored locally on your device.
FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS:
— Easily Sign Documents Anywhere
— Fill and Edit Documents
— Create Your e-Signature
— Import Your Documents
— Send Documents for Signing
— Invite the Other Party to Sign
— Work seamlessly with cloud services thanks to integrations with iCloud, Dropbox, Evernote, Box, OneDrive, Google Drive, and others.
Subscription plans:
• 1-week subscription with a 3-day trial version for $4.99
• 1-month subscription for $9.99
• 12-month subscription for $49.99
Note: Prices may vary by location.
Subscription auto-renewal information:
— A free trial period is available.
— Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase.
— Your free trial subscription will automatically renew to a paid subscription unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the free trial period.
— The subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription.
— The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current subscription. The cost depends on the selected plan.
— Users can manage their subscriptions, and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
— Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://e-sign.co/privacy
Terms of Use: https://e-sign.co/terms
For any questions or inquiries, please contact us at support@e-sign.co.

bluejetty:00166788:ios.summary: Winner of PocketGamer's 2024 Big Indie Pitch! Battle it out in all new 3v3 multiplayer modes like Mini MOBA, Brick Battle, Deathmatch and Battle Royale. Play Survival Story Mode and earn skins by surviving the Huggable invasion in a re-imag
bluejetty:00166788:ios.description:
Winner of PocketGamer's 2024 Big Indie Pitch! Battle it out in all new 3v3 multiplayer modes like Mini MOBA, Brick Battle, Deathmatch and Battle Royale. Play Survival Story Mode and earn skins by surviving the Huggable invasion in a re-imagined BATTLE BEARS -1 starring Oliver, Riggs and Wil. Warning: Do NOT get hugged to death!
Play and level up all your favorite bears from Battle Bears Gold with wacky weapons! Collect unique skins to show you’re the finest fighter on the Ursa Major!
NEW ORIGINAL MODES
- MINI MOBA: A fun fast LoL inspired 3v3 MOBA anyone can play! Protect your Main Base while defending your Huggable minions as they take down your opponent’s shields. Destroy the enemy Tesla Turrets and Main Base to secure the win. Navigate a variety of three-lane maps with Lavable Golems that when destroyed can provide damage buffs or health boosts to your team.
- BATTLE ROYALE: Every bear for themselves! 10 players battle it out to be the Last Bear Standing. Destroy boxes to get Supplies and increase your strength. Avoid the Huggable storm cloud and use teleportation pads. May the odds be ever in your favor ;)
- BRICK BATTLE: Inspired by Battle Bears Zombies, collect and carry the most Rainbow Bricks back to your Unicorn Cart to win. Don’t let the opposing team blow up your Cart or else you gotta start over. Watch out for the Bearbershop Quartet and their deadly Angry Bombs!
- DEATHMATCH: Based on Battle Bears Gold’s team death match! Each kill awards a point. The team with the most points at the end wins it all.
UNLOCK AND UPGRADE HEROES
Collect and upgrade the famous Battle Bears!
Level them up and collect unique skins. 
Oliver the Soldier
Wil the Chub Scout
Riggs the Heavy
Astoria the Sniper
Graham the Engineer
Tillman the Demo
Huggy the Huggable
Saberi the Healer
Sanchez the Arbiter 
Botch the Toxic Assassin 
B1000 the Assault 
Necromancer the Zombocalypse
Swanny the Hunter 
More heroes coming!
DAILY WEEKLY EVENTS!
Complete a wide variety of fun quests to earn rewards.
INVITE YOUR FRIENDS!
Invite and join your friends to play matches together. 
DAILY SHOP! 
Keep checking back for new skins and bundles in the Shop. Buy Bear Boxes, Joule Packs and Gas Can Packs in the Shop as well. 
BATTLE PASS!
Buy the Golden Bear Pass to unlock Gold Bear Pass Rewards and Premium Quests.
BE THE TOP BEAR!
Climb the leaderboards to prove you’re the GOAT! Check your News and Inbox for special events and prizes for top leaderboard players.
NEW MUSIC OST!
Experience new Battle Bears music and remixes of classic BB tracks on different maps.
NEW UPDATES COMING!
We're working on new heroes, skins, maps, and modes for upcoming seasons.
HOW TO PLAY:
Slide LEFT button around to move your bear.
Slide RIGHT fire button to aim, then let go to fire.
To Auto-Fire just tap on the RIGHT fire button.
Wait for Super Attack button to charge up.
To Jump: Stand on Jump Pad for a second. 
SUPPORT: 
Contact us via Settings > Support
or visit BattleBears.com/support
JOIN OUR COMMUNITY!
Discord.gg/BattleBears
X.com/BattleBears
YouTube.com/BattleBears
Facebook.com/BattleBears
Instagram.com/BattleBears
TikTok.com/BattleBearsGame
MERCH
Win Official Merch in In-Game Events
Merch, plushies and board game at BattleBears.com

bluejetty:00061574:ios.description:
The most important thing about selling on eBay is to know your numbers. Profit Finder is here to help you have a clear understanding of your profit and expenses for selling on eBay.
DETAILED RESULTS
Profit Finder gives you a detailed results section to determine your profit, margin, and return for a given sale. A bar chart is available to make sense of your profit, item cost, and any shipping or sale fees. You can also determine the margin obtained from the sale price or determine the sale price from the desired margin.
SELL YOUR WAY
Whether you are a small or large seller, Profit Finder offers you the full range of available options from eBay managed fees to eBay stores. The following fees and deductions can include:
- 10% Top Rated Seller
- Schedule Listing
- International Site Visibility
- Gallery Plus
- Listing Designer
- Bold
- Subtitle
- Free Listing
SAVE FOR LATER
For faster calculations, you can create templates that save any combination of settings. You can also save previous results for later viewing.
GET SHARING
After saving an item, your results can be shared using the standard iOS share sheet.
eBay fees are current as of November 2024. Profit Finder is not endorsed or affiliated with eBay or PayPal. The accuracy of its results is not guaranteed.
Finally, if you enjoyed Profit Finder, please take some time to leave a review. Feedback is always appreciated for future updates.
Subscription Details
– Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
– Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase
Terms of Use: https://www.profitfinderapp.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.profitfinderapp.com/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00044512:ios.description: The FAY Fix It app is your tool to help improve the City of Fayetteville, North Carolina. Whether it is a pothole, damaged street sign or graffiti, FAY Fix It makes reporting a code or ordinance violation to City Hall as easy as pressing a button. The app harnesses the power of GPS to provide a precise location for staff so that they can begin fixing the problem. You can also include a photo with your reporting to help the City quickly identify the problem. Residents will be able to track the status of their report or follow other reports made by members of the community.

bluejetty:00169514:ios.description:
Legacy FuturHealth: Microdosing Program
This is the Legacy FuturHealth app, supporting our microdosing program for existing members. If you recently signed up for FuturHealth, download the FuturHealth+ app instead — that's where you'll access your care.
FuturHealth connects you with licensed medical providers for prescription weight loss support. Download the app, answer a few quick questions, and start your virtual consultation to see if a prescription is medically appropriate for you. Join over 400,000 people who've started their weight loss journey with FuturHealth.
What Makes FuturHealth Different
FuturHealth takes a medical approach to weight loss. You'll connect with licensed providers who can help determine if prescription weight loss medication is right for you.
What You Get With FuturHealth
Medical Support
- Virtual consultation with a licensed medical provider
- Ongoing care from providers in your state
- Medication shipped directly to your door (if prescribed)
- Support from your medical team
Easy To Use
- Simple app that tracks your progress
- Connect with your provider anytime
- Get answers to your questions fast
- Support team available when you need help
How It Works
- Download the app and answer a few questions
- Complete a virtual consultation
- If appropriate, receive your prescription medication at home
- Track your progress in the app
- Stay connected with your medical team
Safe and Effective
All prescriptions come from licensed medical providers. Your provider will review your health history and determine if weight loss medication is medically appropriate for you. Results vary from person to person. Most people see gradual weight loss when they follow their provider's guidance.
Subscription Terms
Payment is charged when you sign up. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the next billing period. You can manage your subscription in the app.
We offer a Membership Satisfaction Guarantee on FuturHealth program fees. Medication and provider fees are non-refundable. See full Terms of Service for details.
Read our full Terms of Service and Privacy Policy at futurhealth.com/terms and futurhealth.com/privacy.
Important Information
Weight loss medication isn't right for everyone. Your provider will determine if it's medically appropriate for you based on your health. Always talk to a healthcare professional before starting any weight loss program.
Microdosing is subject to the determination of a patient's treating provider.

bluejetty:00141035:ios.description:
Welcome to Idle Pizza Restaurant Tycoon, the ultimate idle cooking game where you build your dream pizzeria food empire! 
Start as a beginner pizza chef, cook delicious burgers, pizzas, and more food, and grow your tiny pizza shop into a global pizzaiolo powerhouse!
Pizza + Idle = Perfect Combo
Build and manage your own pizza shop! Bake the perfect pizza, and expand your restaurant. 
Your cooking never stops, even when you're offline! That’s the power of a true idle tycoon.
Upgrade the Best Pizza Machines
Become a legendary pizza chef by mastering your machines! Upgrade your cooking stations, automate your pizza production lines, and optimize every part of your idle food factory. Efficient machine upgrades mean faster pizza output, better profits, and happier customers.
Fast Pizza Delivery Service
Add scooters and delivery staff to your restaurant. Get your pizza and burgers to your hungry customers quickly. A faster delivery means happier customers and more coins!
Upgrade Your Supermarket & Shop
Buy new ingredients, unlock exotic food recipes, and add more cooking stations. Turn your small pizza corner into a massive supermarket-style kitchen. Expand your shop empire and dominate the idle restaurant world!
Strategy Meets Automation
This isn't just about tapping — it's about thinking smart. Balance your cooking lines, time your machine upgrades, and plan your delivery flow to maximize profits. Whether you're a casual player or a min-maxer, there's always a better way to run your pizza empire. Let your brain do the cooking!
Features:
 Easy tap-and-build mechanics – perfect for idle fans
 Fun cooking upgrades and delicious food visuals
 Real pizza chef strategies with a casual pace
 Delivery mechanics with growing challenge
 Endless empire-building fun with addictive progression
 No need to be online – your idle empire runs 24/7!
Whether you're a fan of idle games, love cooking simulators, or just want to run your dream pizza shop, this tycoon is for you. Perfect for fans of chef games, burger shops, and fast-paced food fun.

bluejetty:00164736:ios.description:
Your voice. Their inbox. Real impact.
Resistbot makes civic engagement effortless. Text, tap, or type to send letters directly to your elected officials—from your Mayor to the President. No phone trees, no busy signals, no excuses.
“Raise your hand if you would rather go get a cavity filled than make four calls and leave four voicemails… thank goodness there is a better way.” -Resistbot User
Join 10 million Americans who’ve sent 50 million letters since 2017. When thousands of constituents speak up on an issue, elected officials pay attention—and real change happens.
How It Works
1. Browse campaigns created by users like you.
2. Tap “Send to My Officials” to open the Resistbot chatbot.
3. Tap send and follow the prompts. Your message is delivered in minutes via email, fax, or postal mail.
Real Change, Real Stories
A single Resistbot campaign started by a young Tennessee activist helped bring back the U.S. House in 2020 to stop USPS sabotage. College students in New York used Resistbot to end police misconduct shield laws. Your letter could be next.
Beyond Letters
Use Resistbot to call your officials, find local office locations, check your voter registration, and access dozens of civic engagement tools. Start by browsing popular campaigns, or explore the full guide to see everything Resistbot can do.
Trusted by Millions
Press: Vetted by Snopes (twice), featured in Teen Vogue, Fast Company, Miami Herald, Arizona Republic, Lifehacker, and Engadget
Amplified by: Billie Eilish, Khloe Kardashian, Mark Ruffalo, Alyssa Milano, Camila Cabello, and more
Your data is safe: We don’t sell to campaigns or third parties. We’re member-supported, not backed by billionaires or special interests. Active since 2017 with a user bill of rights at resist.bot/rights
Download now and make your voice heard in 60 seconds.
Need help? Visit resist.bot/about or contact our volunteer support team—they’re ready to power your activism.

bluejetty:00065152:ios.summary:
Newsmax is a premier news platform that offers comprehensive news coverage, breaking news, and real-time updates on topics that matter to you.
Forbes calls Newsmax "a news powerhouse," and The New York Times describes it as a "potent force
bluejetty:00065152:ios.description:
Newsmax is a premier news platform that offers comprehensive news coverage, breaking news, and real-time updates on topics that matter to you.
Forbes calls Newsmax "a news powerhouse," and The New York Times describes it as a "potent force in U.S. politics".
It is America’s fastest-growing news channel.
From the corridors of the White House to the halls of Congress, our reporting covers every aspect of US political life. We provide trusted news on health, personal finance, faith, and freedom issues, reflecting our commitment to delivering 'Real News for Real People'.
The app includes easy access to Newsmax.com. Staying informed has never been so easy. Visit Newsmax today and step into the world of well-rounded news coverage.
JUST ANNOUNCED:
You can now get access to our premium subscription service Newsmax+ within the app.
Newsmax+ delivers breaking news, expert analysis, and commentary from renowned contributors and political pundits - content you can’t find anywhere else.
Each day you’ll find Rob Schmitt, Greta Van Susteren, Greg Kelly, Carl Higbie . . . and great guests like Mike Huckabee, Dick Morris, Kari Lake, Alan Dershowitz, Rick Santorum, Victor Davis Hanson and more.
Mornings on Newsmax start with Rob Finnerty and Sharla McBride . . . and our team of daytime anchors follows giving you the latest from Washington, New York, and places around the globe.
In the late afternoon, Chris Salcedo and Carl Higbie host some of the best shows on cable news.
Your Premium Subscription Includes:
- Newsmax channel 24/7 access
- Access to the archive for great shows like “Rob Schmitt Tonight,” “Greta Van Susteren The Record” and “Greg Kelly Reports” – and all of our top shows!
- Documentaries on President Trump, Joe Biden’s presidency, Faith in America, the Rise of Woke, and much more.
- Actor Jon Voight’s “Land of Israel” full series!
- Programs on the founding of America, Civil War, greats like Abe Lincoln, George Washington, and Ronald Reagan, World War II . . . and more!
- Comedy documentaries that will have you laughing – with Bob Hope, Don Rickles, and more!
- Special briefings from top newsmakers in the worlds of politics, health, and finance
- And much more!
Get free unlimited access to the Newsmax2 streaming channel, with the latest news and analysis.
Newsmax2 delivers compelling breaking news and analysis with the latest on politics, finance, and health — including great conversation and interviews with high-profile talent and contributors from across the political spectrum.
At Newsmax, we believe in the power of information. We are dedicated to presenting facts, offering diverse viewpoints, and encouraging open dialogue. Whether you're a political aficionado or simply want to stay updated, Newsmax is your comprehensive destination for reliable, extensive, and timely news.

bluejetty:00031324:ios.description:

Password Setup: When user forgets the password, it can be recovered by email/cellphone number. There will be a verification code following the password reset method.

Error Report: When scooter fails, the app can display the failure fault, as well as the recommended procedure for the fault.
Display: Display the remaining battery power, cruising range, current speed, current total mileage, scooter lock and unlock etc.
Driver moving data

Why Choose White Noise - Deep Sleep Sounds?
This app provides the perfect blend of White Noise, Fan Sleep Sounds, and other calming audio to mask distractions and create the ideal environment for sleep. Whether you're looking for a simple Noise Machine or a customizable Sound Generator, this app has everything you need.
Features of White Noise - Deep Sleep Sounds:
Extensive Sleep Sounds Library
Discover a wide selection of White Noise, Fan Noise, and natural Rain Sounds. Choose from a variety of Deep Sleep Sounds, each designed to help you sleep better.
Fan Noise for Ultimate Relaxation
Enjoy authentic Fan Sleep Sounds that replicate the calming hum of a fan, a favorite choice for many seeking consistent, soothing audio for relaxation and sleep.
Customizable Noise Generator
Use the built-in Sound Generator to mix and match White Noise, Fan Noise, and other Sleep Sounds. Adjust volume, pitch, and intensity to suit your personal preference.
Noise Machine for All Needs
Block out unwanted disturbances with a powerful Noise Machine. Whether it’s city noise, neighbors, or other distractions, our Sound Machine creates the perfect soundscape.
Ideal for Any Environment
Whether you're at home, traveling, or in a noisy hotel, White Noise - Deep Sleep Sounds turns your space into a serene haven with soothing Fan Noise and other calming audio.
Rain Sounds and Natural Audio
Drift off to sleep with tranquil Rain Sounds and other nature-inspired Sounds for Sleep. Perfect for those who prefer gentle, natural audio to aid relaxation.
Benefits of Using White Noise - Deep Sleep Sounds:
* Promotes Deep Sleep Sounds for a restorative night’s rest.
* Blocks out disruptive noises with continuous White Noise.
* Helps babies, toddlers, and adults fall asleep faster with calming Sleep Sounds and Fan Noise.
* Enhances focus and productivity by masking distractions during work or study.
Designed for Everyone:
Whether you're looking for White Noise, Fan Noise, or the ideal Sleep Sounds, this app is perfect for:
* People struggling with insomnia or light sleepers.
* Travelers needing a portable Noise Machine or Sound Generator.
* Parents creating a soothing sleep environment for babies and kids.
* Professionals needing a concentration boost with calming White Noise.
* Timer and autoplay features to stop audio when you fall asleep.
* Intuitive interface for quick access to your favorite Deep Sleep Sounds.
* Offline playback for seamless use anywhere.
The app leverages the scientifically proven benefits of White Noise and Sleep Sounds to calm your mind and promote relaxation. Use the Noise Generator to craft your ideal audio, blending Fan Sleep Sounds, Rain Sounds, and more. With this Noise Machine, you'll have endless options to create the perfect atmosphere for sleep or relaxation.
Why is White Noise Important?
White Noise provides consistent sound waves that mask sudden noises, such as traffic or conversations, which can disrupt your sleep. By incorporating Fan Noise, Rain Sounds, and other Deep Sleep Sounds, this app ensures a peaceful sleep environment for all.
