bluejetty:00153685:ios.name: Yosemite GyPSy Guide Tour
bluejetty:00153685:ios.summary:
Plays commentary automatically as you drive so you don't miss any of the best places to visit, plus stories, tips and directions.
GyPSy Guide’s narrated driving tour for Yosemite National Park is an excellent way to enjoy all the benefits
bluejetty:00153685:ios.description:
Plays commentary automatically as you drive so you don't miss any of the best places to visit, plus stories, tips and directions.
GyPSy Guide’s narrated driving tour for Yosemite National Park is an excellent way to enjoy all the benefits of a guided tour while you explore at your own pace.
There are 200+ audio points that play automatically along the scenic drive, featuring the best things to see and do, complete with stories, tips and driving directions. 
As you drive, your professional tour guide shares advice on how to prioritize your time at recommended “not to be missed” viewpoints, suggested side-trips and places of interest. 
Tours work offline using free GPS signal and location services, so no data roaming, network, or Wi-Fi is required while touring.
Visit www.gypsyguide.com for route maps, sample commentary and tips and advice.
WHAT TO EXPECT: 
Yosemite just might be the iconic US National Park. A land of giants, massive granite cliffs and domes providing the setting for dramatic waterfalls to tumble thousands of feet over.
While in Yosemite Valley, with stops at Yosemite and Bridalveil Falls we’ll show where to spot for rock climbers on the sheer granite El Capitan. Considered mecca for climbers from all over the world, you’ll hear about their feats, while new records may be set for you to see. 
As we climb to the spectacular Glacier Point for views down into the valley, you’ll learn how important Presidential visits shaped the future for National Parks and hear how the legendary Buffalo Soldiers became guardians of the National Park.
Travel to a hidden corner of Yosemite National Park, the Hetch Hetchy Valley and feel rather insignificant as you stand under the towering Giant Sequoias in Mariposa Grove.
The tour officially starts and ends close to each entrance of the Park; Big Oak Flat, El Portal, Fish Camp Wawona or Lee Vining Tioga Pass entrances. Or you can join and pick up the commentary anywhere along the route. Narration will automatically trigger at the next commentary point.
WHAT YOU’LL SEE:
Highlights along the tour route include
• Mariposa Grove
• Bridalveil Falls
• El Capitan
• Yosemite Valley
• Glacier Point
• Hetch Hetchy
• Tioga Pass
• Yosemite Falls
• Half & Sentinel Domes
• Wawona Covered Bridge
• Olmsted Point
• Tuolumne Grove
Don't miss out on the best stops and stories. Enhance your Yosemite National Park experience with our audio driving tours.
CHARGING:
++ Continued use of GPS/Location Services in the background increases battery usage. We strongly recommend taking a cigarette style (DC outlet) car charge to keep your phone charged, and avoid charging through the USB port. 
AUDIO:
Listen directly from your phone or connect to the car stereo via Bluetooth. Avoid using a direct connection to the USB port of a rental vehicle as this can cause audio issues. The audio can play through your car’s Apple CarPlay and Android Auto display, please note that the map will display only on your phone.
IPADS:
** iPad models must include a GPS chip. Please note only the iPad Wi-Fi + Cellular models of iPad contain a GPS chip. Wi-Fi-only iPad models have limited location service capabilities and are unable to play commentary automatically.
DOWNLOADING:
The apps are larger in size in order to work offline. You must download the app ahead of time over Wi-Fi (recommended) or cellular data. Once downloaded, you can tour offline without cell service. 
ABOUT US:
GyPSy Guide™ produces award-winning narrated audio tours along scenic drives and road trips around the world. 
Our tours are enjoyed by travelers who prefer to set their own pace and itinerary on vacation, but enjoy a fun, informative and educational guided experience while driving themselves. Our goal is to provide a great introduction to the region and inspire you to learn more and return. 
None of our apps include paid advertising or placements for benefit.

bluejetty:00062762:ios.description:
Feel time move. Stay on track. Stress less.
From the makers of the original red disk timer, the Time Timer® App transforms the powerful visual tool trusted by families, teachers, therapists, and productivity pros for over 30 years into a fully customizable experience on your device.
Whether you’re helping students build focus, supporting kids through daily routines, or simply managing your own tasks without overwhelm—Time Timer makes time feel more tangible and manageable.
What Makes Time Timer Different?
Iconic Visual Timer
Watch time disappear as the disk gets smaller—a simple, intuitive way to feel time passing, not just track it.
Inclusive by Design
Trusted by people with ADHD, Autism, executive function challenges, or just a busy brain. Invented by a mom for her child, Time Timer has supported users of all abilities for decades.
Flexible for Every Routine
Use it once or build structured sequences. Create presets for daily habits. Run multiple timers at once. Make routines visual and calm transitions.
Trusted in Schools, Homes & Workplaces
From kindergarten classrooms to therapy sessions to boardrooms, Time Timer helps reduce resistance, improve focus, and make time awareness easier for everyone.
Free Features Include:
Create up to 3 timers 
Run multiple timers at once
Use the original 60-minute red disk — or choose any duration
Adjust sound, vibration, and color with limited options
Premium Features Unlock Even More:
Unlimited customization
Build routines with timer sequencing (morning checklists, therapy steps, work sprints)
Organize timers with Groups
Sync across mobile and desktop devices
Quick Set +/- buttons for fast adjustments
Customize disk size and detail level
Use Time Timer For:
Morning and bedtime routines
Homework and study blocks
Transitions between tasks
Work sprints and focus sessions
Therapy, coaching, or classroom support
Daily life skills for kids, teens, and adults
Why It Works
Time Timer® transforms time from something abstract and invisible into something your eyes can track and your brain can trust. That’s why it’s backed by research, loved by educators, and recommended by occupational therapists worldwide.
Created for real life. Trusted for decades. Download Time Timer today and feel the difference.

bluejetty:00154006:ios.name: Passaic County MOVE
bluejetty:00154006:ios.summary: Passaic County MOVE is a new way to get around Passaic and Clifton, NJ. We’re a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, and reliable. Whether you need a ride to the bus stop, train station, or the local parks, Passaic County MOVE will get y
bluejetty:00154006:ios.description:
Passaic County MOVE is a new way to get around Passaic and Clifton, NJ. We’re a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, and reliable. Whether you need a ride to the bus stop, train station, or the local parks, Passaic County MOVE will get you there!
With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way. 
HOW IT WORKS:
- Book a ride by setting your pickup and dropoff addresses, and indicating if you’re riding with any additional passengers. 
- You will be given an estimated time when the vehicle will arrive upon booking your trip. The estimated arrival time of the driver will be automatically updated as your vehicle makes its way to meet you.
- When your driver arrives, please promptly board the vehicle. 
- There may be others on board, or you may make a few additional stops along the way! - You can track your ride and share your status in real-time from the app. 
- The card you have on file will be charged at the time you complete your trip. 
SHARING YOUR TRIP:
Our algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience of a private ride with the efficiency and reliability of a public one.
AFFORDABLE.
Rides are priced comparably to other transit services in your area. Your wallet will thank you! 
RELIABLE:
Track your ride as the driver is on their way to you, and while you’re on the vehicle too. 
OUR VEHICLES:
Passaic County MOVE is wheelchair accessible! If you require a wheelchair, you can request accessibility by filling out a form in our app. When you request a ride, you’ll be matched with a wheelchair accessible vehicle. 
Questions? Reach out at support-passaiccounty@ridewithvia.com.
Loving your experience so far? Give us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00088646:ios.summary: Hainan Airlines Holding Co., Ltd. (hereafter referred to as "Hainan Airlines") was established in January, 1993 in Hainan Province, China's largest special economic zone and free trade port. Hainan Airlines is committed to providing passeng
bluejetty:00088646:ios.description:
Hainan Airlines Holding Co., Ltd. (hereafter referred to as "Hainan Airlines") was established in January, 1993 in Hainan Province, China's largest special economic zone and free trade port. Hainan Airlines is committed to providing passengers with comprehensive and seamless airline services and creating a safe and comfortable travel experience. 
In the first half of 2026, Hainan Airlines and its subsidiaries operate over 1,400 domestic and international routes, including over 1,200 domestic routes, covering all provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities in the Chinese mainland, as well as nearly 200 international and regional routes to 53 overseas cities, covering Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania and Africa. Hainan Airlines has also actively responded to the Belt and Road Initiative by building a world-class airline network with seamless international and domestic interactions, high quality and a large scale. Actively implementing the strategic objectives of accelerating the development of a country with a strong transportation network, Hainan Airlines and its subsidiaries have established operational bases and branches in 23 cities and municipalities, including Haikou, Beijing, Guangzhou and Shenzhen.
From 1993 to date, Hainan Airlines has been operating safely for 33 years and has maintained an excellent operational record. bluejetty:00184803:ios.summary:
Sky Force - The Legendary Shoot'em Up Reborn for a New Generation
Sky Force is a modern arcade shoot'em up that brings classic top-down shooter action back to mobile with explosive 3D visuals, satisfying progression, and endless replay val
bluejetty:00184803:ios.description:
Sky Force - The Legendary Shoot'em Up Reborn for a New Generation
Sky Force is a modern arcade shoot'em up that brings classic top-down shooter action back to mobile with explosive 3D visuals, satisfying progression, and endless replay value. The skies are burning. Enemy squadrons, towering war machines, and colossal bosses stand between you and victory. Strap into the cockpit, push the throttle, and rediscover one of the most acclaimed airplane games ever made.
A Classic SHMUP Experience, Rebuilt for Modern Players
Inspired by the golden age of vertical arcade shooters, Sky Force 2014 combines fast-paced aerial combat with smooth touch controls, handcrafted enemy waves, and intense bullet-dodging action. Every mission challenges your reflexes, your timing, and your ability to stay calm when the screen fills with fire.
Whether you are a longtime fan of classic shoot'em up games, a bullet hell veteran, or discovering the genre for the first time, Sky Force delivers a polished, accessible, and deeply rewarding arcade experience.
Explosive 3D Action on Mobile
Sky Force takes the classic top-down shooter formula and upgrades it with detailed 3D environments, cinematic explosions, dynamic effects, and beautifully designed battlefields. Fight across oceans, scorched war zones, and storm-filled skies as you blast through enemy forces and push deeper into the campaign.
Every stage is built to feel fast, readable, and satisfying - perfect for quick mobile sessions, but deep enough to keep you coming back for perfect runs. Play online or take the action offline anywhere you go.
Epic Boss Battles That Test Your Skill
Massive flying fortresses. Mechanized war machines. Screen-filling enemies armed with devastating bullet patterns.
Sky Force's boss battles are designed to be both spectacular and demanding. Learn their attacks, dodge incoming fire, strike at the right moment, and prove you have what it takes to become an ace pilot.
Upgrade Your Ship and Master Every Mission
This is more than a one-run arcade shooter. Sky Force rewards persistence, precision, and smart upgrades.
Collect stars, improve your aircraft, and return stronger after every mission. Upgrade your main cannon, side guns, magnets, shields, missiles, and special weapons. Rescue civilians, complete objectives, unlock new difficulty levels, and chase medals as you work toward 100% completion.
Every run matters. Every upgrade brings you closer to building the ultimate fighter.
Built for Replayability
Sky Force is easy to start, but hard to master. Replay missions on higher difficulties, improve your score, perfect your routes, and compete for better results. With multiple objectives, upgrades, medals, tournaments, and leaderboards, every level gives you a reason to return.
Why Players Love Sky Force
- Classic vertical shoot 'em up gameplay reimagined for modern devices
- Intuitive touch controls designed for fast arcade action
- Explosive 3D visuals, cinematic effects, and detailed environments
- Deep aircraft upgrade system with meaningful progression
- Massive bosses and intense bullet hell combat
- Multiple difficulty modes for casual players and hardcore arcade fans
- Missions, medals, tournaments, and leaderboards for long-term replay value
- Retro arcade soul with modern mobile polish
- Plays online or offline, anywhere you go
Take to the Skies
Sky Force is a love letter to classic arcade shooters - fast, explosive, challenging, and endlessly satisfying. It is the airplane game that redefined mobile shoot 'em ups and continues to thrill millions of pilots worldwide.
Download Sky Force free, upgrade your aircraft, and fight your way through one of the most iconic plane shooter experiences ever made.
The war for the skies has begun. The leaderboard is waiting. Take off now.

bluejetty:00123808:ios.name: CRIMO
bluejetty:00123808:ios.summary:
Love deduction games? Use your logic to solve puzzles and investigate gruesome murder cases! Analyze clues and follow the trail to send those criminals to justice!
Join the CRIMO special unit, specialized in logical crime investigations. Af
bluejetty:00123808:ios.description:
Love deduction games? Use your logic to solve puzzles and investigate gruesome murder cases! Analyze clues and follow the trail to send those criminals to justice!
Join the CRIMO special unit, specialized in logical crime investigations. After a short training at the Police Academy, you will be sent to lead gruesome murder cases in Miami and New York, by applying pure logic to solve puzzles. Collect clues, analyze them, confirm evidence or reject false leads: you will cross-off all possibilities until you can designate the murder weapon, find out the motive and unmask the criminal. Are you ready to use your wits and deduction skills to fight crime?
Did the actress do it for revenge using a handgun as the powder on the pillow suggests?
Or maybe it was the politician, but did he use the knife or the chainsaw? Was it out of sheer madness or was it for power? for love? Or simply money? The next clue might be decisive...
CRIMO's puzzles offer a fascinating cross-over between games of logic like sudoku and minesweeper, crosswords and criminal investigation board games. You will decode which squares to touch in the grid by following hints giving the sizes of blocks in each row and column. It’s a real mind challenge wrapped in a fun experience where you need to think and use your brains to succeed.
Avoid making mistakes or you will take a punch, suffer a scratch or even take a bullet! Thank god you can replenish your health by eating a burger, hot-dog or... how about a donut?
You will learn easily, progress rapidly and quickly get hooked! It's ultra addictive!
FEATURES:
• Tens of criminal cases in two iconic cities: Miami and New York
• Hundreds of grid puzzles to solve by logic and deduction
• Dynamic investigation board where your searches spread out and interconnect like a spider web as in the most exciting detective flicks
• Get acquainted with Jamie, police officer, Jim, forensic expert as well as the Chief of Police, Madam District Attorney, the firefighter...
• Special challenges: burning crime scenes with clues going up in smoke, FBI-restricted access zones where your hands are tight…
• Works on iPhone 5s and above and iPads
Time to solve puzzling crimes by logic & deduction! PLAY NOW!
Created by ooblada & CHQL
Please note that CRIMO is completely free to play, but virtual currency can be purchased with real money to get some in-game items such as extra lives, health boosters or instant analyses. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Terms of use:
https://oobld.com/tos-apps-en

bluejetty:00116200:android.summary: In many cases, it happens that you have deleted a message, whether intentionally or unintentionally, and you want to retrieve the lost messages, but you do not find an appropriate and effective application to do your job. And you try many a
bluejetty:00116200:android.description:
In many cases, it happens that you have deleted a message, whether intentionally or unintentionally, and you want to retrieve the lost messages, but you do not find an appropriate and effective application to do your job. And you try many applications to retrieve deleted WhatsApp messages, but to no avail, and you end up losing hope and losing messages forever.
Retrieving deleted messages from the phone, whether they were deleted, old or recent, is now easy and possible with the application to recover deleted messages from our phone.
How does the application to recover deleted messages from the old phone work?
The deleted messages recovery application records all conversations, so when the sender deletes the message, our application restores deleted phone messages to save them so that you can view the messages later.
Our application also allows you to retrieve deleted messages from the phone after formatting, and whether they are new or old, it does not make any difference to us.
We hope that you will like our application.

bluejetty:00045568:ios.description:

Our app is designed with drivers in mind, prioritizing their needs by creating the app with alerts, easy-to-use interface and large icons. OPTIMISED PERFORMANCE & DESIGN
We are dedicated to improving our app's speed and usability. By continuously improving our performance, we ensure our users have the best experience, while also striving to keep the app fast and stable.

bluejetty:00082780:ios.description:
Turn your photos, Live Photos, and videos into scroll-stopping collages with PopGrid.
Create polished photo collages, photo grids, long collages, and seamless layouts for your feed, Stories, and carousel posts—without starting over every time you add a photo.
MAKE MORE, ALL AT ONCE
Combine up to 50 photos in one collage. Choose how many photos appear in each row, resize any image, and set the canvas ratio to create photo merges, vertical layouts, and waterfall-style collages your way.
MAKE IT STAND OUT
Use AI cutouts to add depth and a layered look to your collage. Mix in Live Photos to turn everyday moments into content that feels more alive.
FINE-TUNE EVERY DETAIL
Build photo grids, seamless collages, and waterfall layouts. Adjust borders, spacing, background colors, image ratios, and the size of each photo until everything fits just right.
MADE FOR LIVE PHOTOS
Create with Live Photos and videos, mute an individual Live Photo, or add your own audio for a more complete final edit.
READY TO SHARE
Export photos, Live Photos, and videos in high quality and in the size you need for every post.
PopGrid gives you more ways to turn everyday photos into something worth sharing.
------------------------------
This app offers subscriptions for "Collages". They're available (in United States pricing) for $2.99 weekly or $24.99 yearly. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period (and charged to your iTunes account). You can turn off auto-renew/manage subscriptions in your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00073343:ios.description:
PLAY SKILL GAMES. WIN REAL CASH PRIZES.
Play over 20 skill-based games, earn rewards as you play & compete for real cash prizes on WorldWinner.
Play favorites like Solitaire Rush, YAHTZEE®, Bingo Bingo!, Puzzle Match, Crystal Champions, Blackjack, Spades and more.
WorldWinner has been home to skill-based games for over 25 years, with more than $2 billion in prizes awarded to players!
Plus, new users get a 100% deposit match up to $200! Ts & Cs apply.
NEW: SOLOS
Record the fastest time at your level, and win instantly! 
Solos are the fastest way to start winning real cash on WorldWinner, and it changes how skill games work.
EPIC FREEBIES AND REWARDS
- Spin the daily wheel for extra Reward Points & Bonus Bucks, and discounts
- Complete goals and challenges to win exclusive prizes & rewards
- Unlimited free warm-up tournaments
- Join our Premier Club for additional deposit discounts, rewards, and benefits!
PLAY 20+ SKILL-BASED GAMES
From Solitaire, Spades and Bingo to puzzle, card and word games, there’s always something to play.
Solitaire Rush:
Our most popular game. Classic solitaire with a fast, skill based twist and real cash on the line.
WorldWinner also has Spider Solitaire, Pyramid Solitaire, Klondike and FreeCell.
YAHTZEE® Roll Dice, Win Cash:
Play a new take on the classic YAHTZEE® game. Spin five slots and use strategy to fill your Score Card for the highest score.
Bingo Bingo!:
Daub the right number squares, make as many Bingos as you can & build your score before time runs out.
Puzzle Match:
Put your puzzle skills to the test in a quick game where every move can help build your score.
Crystal Champions:
Match, clear and score your way through a colorful puzzle challenge.
Blackjack Peak Payout:
Play a skill-based twist on classic Blackjack. Peek at the cards before they are dealt and use your skill to make your move.
Wheel of Fortune®: 
Play America’s favorite TV game show! Spin the wheel, find consonants & solve the word puzzle before time runs out.
Spades Showdown: 
The classic partnership card game, now played for real cash against real, skill matched opponents.
SCRABBLE® Cubes: 
Hasbro's classic word game, reimagined. Build the best words from your letter tiles to score the most points.
You will also find Payline Slots, Poppin Panic, ATARI® Breakout, and more. Real skill, real cash, no luck required.
MORE WAYS TO PLAY
Choose the way you want to compete.
Solo: Play against the score, get instant results and earn more with higher scores.
Head to Head: Two-player tournaments matched by skill rating.
Multiplayer: Skill-matched tournaments with three or more players.
FreePlay: Enter a daily free tournament and play for a cash prize.
JackPOP: Fast multiplayer tournaments with a random prize pool.
Progressive: Prize pools grow with every entry.
Survivor: Play through multiple rounds. Top players advance until the final cash prizes are awarded.
Select games also feature Blitz, Dash, Express and Turbo tournaments.
25+ YEARS OF TRUST AND FAIR PLAY
WorldWinner has been running skill-based games for over 25 years.
Compete in fair games against players at similar skill levels. Track your results, collect your winnings and enjoy a 100% ad-free experience.
There are no added fees or charges on withdrawals, so the money you win is yours to withdraw.
FAST, EASY DEPOSITS AND WITHDRAWALS
We've been providing fair play and big cash outs for over 25 years. With no added fees or charges on withdrawals, you earn the money you win.
- AmEx
- Apple Pay
- Discover
- Mastercard
- PayPal
- Venmo
- Visa
Online real money gaming is not available in some US states, including AR, CT, DE, LA, and SD. Playing card games for cash are not permitted in IN and ME. But you can still enjoy playing our games for free anytime, anywhere.

bluejetty:00184511:ios.description:
يمُكّنكَ “وثاق” من إنشاء بطاقة دعوة إلكترونية أنيقة مزوّدة بـ “بار كود” يُتيح لضيوفك معرفة تفاصيل المناسبة وتوثيقها تلقائيّا، وبكل أريحية وانتظام
مميزاتنا : 
 • تصاميم جاهزة ومتنوعة 
وثاق يوفر لك تصاميم مميزة وجميلة لجميع أنواع مناسباتك
 • طلب تصميم خاص
بإمكانك طلب تصميم خاص لمناسبتك
 • ارسال الدعوات عن طريق الرسائل النصية أو الواتساب 
 يمكنك اختيار ارسال الدعوة عن طريق الرسائل النصية أو عن طريق الواتساب لتصل لكل مدعويّك خلال دقائق
 • خدمة الباركود 
لمناسباتك الخاصة ، يمكنك ارسال باركود خاص لكل مدعو
 • ارسال الموقع 
يمكنك ارسال موقع مناسبتك لكل المدعوّين عن طريق قوقل ماب
 • كتابة نص و بيانات المناسبة 
يمكنك صياغة دعوتك بأسلوبك الخاص وكتابة بيانات مناسبتك من ( تاريخ ووقت ) لتصل لكل مدعويّك بحب
 • رد الضيوف بقبول الدعوة أو الاعتذار 
يتيح وثاق لمدعويّك خيار قبول الدعوة أو الاعتذار عنها
وبذلك تصلك إحصائية كاملة بعدد الحضور لمناسبتك
 • حساب خاص للحارس لإدارة دخول المدعويّن
بإمكانك ادارة وتنظيم دخول ضيوفك للمناسبة عن طريق مسح الباركود الخاص بكل مدعو عند وصوله للمناسبة 
باستخدام حساب الحارس في تطبيق وثاق
Wethaq can provide you unique and special Electronic invitation cards contain ” QRcode ” for your guests to be able to know all the details and capture it automatically organized with simplicity.
Wethaq Features
 • Ready-made Various Designs
Wethaq provides you special and beautiful ready-made designs for all kinds of occasions
 • Order your Custom Design
You can request your own custom design, made specifically for your occasion
 • SMS & WhatsApp Invitations
You can send your invitation via SMS or WhatsApp to all your guests within minutes
 • QR Code Service
To enjoy your private occasions, you can send a QR code to each one of your guests
 • Events Locations
You can share your event location to your guests through Google Map
 • Customized Invitation Texts & Details
Write your customized invitations in your own style, add your event date, time and details and hit (Send). The invitations will reach to your guests list with love within minutes
 • Accept/Reject Button 
Wethaq will give your guests the option to either accept or reject the invitation.
This will give you a clear idea about the size of your guests list and their information
 • The Guard Feature
You can manage your guests' entrance to your private events by scanning their QR codes, using the guard account provided by Wethaq

bluejetty:00091467:ios.description:
Split or Merge cars? Play this relaxing but challenging car merging game now!
Come and play — here, “play” means pure stage-clearing fun: clear goals, well-balanced challenges, and hundreds of unique cars waiting for you to unlock and collect through nothing but pure play.
You can play casually, just to enjoy the thrill of merging and upgrading cars. Or you can go all in — focus on dodging at the edge of danger, rack up skill points, and compete asynchronously with players worldwide.
At the very beginning, when you merge a new car and dash toward the milestone distance, you’ll feel an incredible sense of comfort and satisfaction.
As your goals shift, you’ll crave new ways to play —
• Never missing a single merge opportunity (99% of beginners will miss them).
• Dodging at the very last second to chain combos and watch your skill points skyrocket.
Because here, even a brand-new player can break straight into the Top 100, or even Top 10. Before you know it, aiming for #1 — something you rarely consider in real life — becomes your natural goal in this game. That’s part of its true meaning: to let you chase the top, fueled by pure play.
Even if you don’t make #1, the thrill of pushing your limits, the anticipation of victory, and the satisfaction of achievement will immerse you in that rare flow state only games can bring.
Play this super fun car-merging runner now!
Download instantly — tiny install size, no endless loading!
Play anytime, anywhere — while waiting, on a break, even in the bathroom!
Works perfectly offline on trains, planes, or anywhere without internet!
Because this is a single-player game — No WiFi Needed!
No paywalls, totally free!
To keep the developer alive and creating more games, we recommend playing in Normal Mode.

bluejetty:00120260:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00120260:ios.description:
Learn Art is a beautifully designed art quiz that turns the world's greatest paintings into a game. Built and cared for by a single passionate developer, it has been enjoyed by art lovers for over ten years.
510 paintings · 85 painters · 30 art movements · 4 languages.
FREE TO START
Gallery 1 gives you 140 paintings by all 70 great masters, every game mode, the slideshow and the full info cards. No trial, no countdown.
WAYS TO PLAY
• Quiz — a painting appears; pick the right painter among four.
• Choose the painting — we name the artist, you find the work.
• Letter quiz — rebuild the painter's name letter by letter.
• Movements quiz — identify the artistic movement behind a work.
• Slideshow & info cards — browse the paintings and read about them freely.
LEARN AS YOU PLAY
A built-in hint system helps when you're stuck — reveal a biography, remove wrong answers, or get a letter — so every round teaches you something.
LEARN ART PLUS
One purchase unlocks Galleries 2 and 3 and the Plus gallery: 370 more paintings, 15 more masters, Japanese ukiyo-e, Cubism, Fauvism and Naïve Art, and unlimited hints in every gallery. Yours for life, including the art added later. A one-time purchase, not a subscription.
FROM GOTHIC ART TO MODERN ART
Learn to recognize the great masters across seven centuries — from Gothic art and the Proto-Renaissance through the Renaissance, Baroque, Rococo, Neoclassicism, Romanticism, Realism, Impressionism, Post-Impressionism, Symbolism and Expressionism, to Cubism, Fauvism and Japanese Ukiyo-e.
NO BANNERS, NO FORCED ADS
Learn Art is made to be looked at. There are no banner ads and no full-screen interstitials interrupting your game.
GAME CENTER
Climb the leaderboard and unlock achievements as you progress.
FOUR LANGUAGES
Play in English, French, Spanish or Italian — titles and biographies are fully translated.
Free to download. Enjoy!

Daily Verse: Set reminders to receive daily Bible verse notifications.

Verse Editor: Create beautiful Bible verse posts using different backgrounds and share them with others.
Nearby Churches: Discover churches near your location.
Books: Explore a collection of Christian eBooks.
Wallpapers: Browse a beautiful collection of inspiring wallpapers.
Videos: Watch videos on Jesus, hope, wisdom, motivation, gratitude, healing, and more.

bluejetty:00120624:ios.description:
Organize tasks, outline ideas, and plan anything with clarity and ease
Suru is a flexible, visual tool for creating to-do lists, managing projects, outlining notes, and organizing everything from class assignments to vacation plans. Whether you are brainstorming your next idea or tracking daily tasks, Suru helps you stay structured, focused, and inspired with clean design and powerful features that fit your workflow.
With Suru you can:
 • Create multi-level checklists and break big tasks into smaller ones
 • Outline papers, presentations, and research with photos and detail
 • Take clean, structured notes in class, at work, or on the go
 • Plan vacations, events, or personal goals
 • Reorganize tasks with drag-and-drop and customize colors
 • Attach relevant photos directly to your lists
 • Share outlines and checklists with friends, family, or teammates
 • Mark tasks complete and track your productivity
 • Export beautifully formatted PDF outlines
With Suru Pro you can:
 • Create unlimited projects and media attachments
 • Sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac
 • Back up your projects and lists to the cloud
 • Access exclusive color themes and export formats
With Suru Teams you can:
 • Share and collaborate on lists in real time
 • Invite others to view or edit projects
 • Keep everyone on the same page at work, home, or school
Why users love Suru:
 • Clean and intuitive interface
 • Colorful themes for visual thinkers
 • Flexible enough for lists, outlines, plans, and notes
 • Works across all your Apple devices
Subscription Info:
Suru Pro and Suru Teams are available via monthly or annual subscriptions. Prices may vary by region. Subscriptions are charged to your iTunes account and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Manage your subscription in iOS Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited upon purchase.
Support: support@esotericdevelopment.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.esotericdevelopment.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.esotericdevelopment.com/tos

Explore a World of Fun Word Puzzles with Words to Win – No-Wager Cash Tournaments Based on Skill!
Looking for a fun way to exercise your brain and earn rewards? Words to Win combines clever crossword puzzles with skill-based tournaments, where you can compete for cash prizes by ranking on the leaderboards—no wager needed! Challenging and Fun Word Puzzles – Discover hidden words in crosswords as you progress through diverse levels.
Boost Your Skills – Stuck on a word? Use helpful boosts to reveal letters and keep advancing!
Bonus Words & Extra Coins – Create as many words as possible and find bonus words for extra coins.
Travel the World – Start in the scenic landscapes of Australia, then unlock beautiful destinations like Mexico, Africa, and Hawaii.
Why Play Words to Win?
No-Wager Cash Tournaments – Join skill-based tournaments to compete with others, climb the leaderboards, and earn cash prizes—all without wagering.
Engage Your Mind – Solve clever crossword puzzles designed to challenge and grow your word skills.
Fun and Relaxing – Enjoy a blend of relaxation and excitement as you explore beautiful destinations.
Adventure Awaits – Each level presents new puzzles and a fresh adventure to explore.
Download Words to Win now and dive into a world of word puzzles, where your skills help you compete for leaderboard spots and earn cash rewards—all in stunning locations!

bluejetty:00136832:ios.name: Barcelona Travel & Audio Guide
bluejetty:00136832:ios.summary:
Tickets and tours: Sagrada Família, Park Güell and more. Hear the story of every sight with the audio guide and walk an itinerary planned on the time you have. In English and 11 other languages.
TICKETS AND TOURS IN BARCELONA
Entry tickets
bluejetty:00136832:ios.description:
Tickets and tours: Sagrada Família, Park Güell and more. Hear the story of every sight with the audio guide and walk an itinerary planned on the time you have. In English and 11 other languages.
TICKETS AND TOURS IN BARCELONA
Entry tickets and guided tours: Sagrada Família, Park Güell, Casa Batlló, La Pedrera and Camp Nou, booked through GetYourGuide from the page of each place.
Hop-on hop-off buses, flamenco shows.
BARCELONA AUDIO GUIDE
Tap "Listen" on any place of the guide and the app reads its story aloud, sentence by sentence, while you stand in front of it: Sagrada Família, Park Güell, Casa Batlló. Pause, go back a sentence, change the speed. The audio guide speaks the language you read the guide in.
BARCELONA ITINERARY BY THE TIME YOU HAVE
Tell the app how much time you have and where you start, and it plans a walking itinerary through the sights of Barcelona: the stops in order, the walk between them in minutes, the route on the map. Follow it step by step, stop by stop. Or save the places you like and turn them into your own walk.
MAP OF BARCELONA
All the sights of Barcelona on one map: the photos of the most famous ones, the others by name as you zoom in. Tap a place for its page, its tickets and the walking directions from where you are.
THINGS TO DO IN BARCELONA
98 places to see, each with its story, photos and the tours that visit it: Sagrada Família, Park Güell, Casa Batlló, La Pedrera, Las Ramblas, La Boqueria, Gothic Quarter, Palau de la Música Catalana and many more.
TRAVEL TIPS FOR BARCELONA
370 answers to the questions travellers ask before and during a trip to Barcelona, for example:
• Best ways to skip lines at Sagrada Familia
• Best time to visit Sagrada Familia to avoid crowds
• Essential Gaudí sites to see in Barcelona
MORE IN THE GUIDE
• Weather for the next 7 days
• Hotels in Barcelona on Booking.com, for tonight, the weekend or your dates
• My guide: save places with a tap and find them on the map
FREE, OR PREMIUM
The Barcelona guide, the audio guide, the map, the travel tips and a one-hour itinerary are free, with ads. Premium, a single purchase, removes the ads and adds longer itineraries, your own lists of places ("Day 1", "Day 2"), unlimited walking directions and the offline guide: the whole guide of Barcelona downloaded to your phone, to read without a connection.

No matter where you go, with mobile banking your bank account goes with you, 24/7. So download the First Community Mobile Banking application today and see how easy mobile banking can be. 
Not yet an EXPRESSnet user? Contact us at 800-767-8880 to get started.

bluejetty:00170150:ios.summary:

Our Compression feature shrinks photos and videos with minim
bluejetty:00170150:ios.description:
As the first and original duplicate cleaner, Cleansmith is designed to reclaim your valuable storage space by identifying and removing duplicates, similar media, and large files.
Our Compression feature shrinks photos and videos with minimal quality loss, saving gigabytes without sacrificing your precious memories.
◎ Main Features
1) Smart Delete
Find and remove unnecessary media with our powerful scanning options:
- Auto Search Categories: Our proprietary algorithm automatically detects Duplicates, Similar Photos/Videos, Large Files, Blinking/Closed Eyes, and Low-Resolution media.
- Deep Search: On-device AI analysis catches similar photos and videos that regular scans miss — cropped or edited shots, and videos saved in different quality or formats.
- Media Types: Clean up specific types like Screenshots, Selfies, and Bursts.
- Albums: Select items from your custom albums to streamline and clear.
- Sort & Filter: Find exactly what you want by date, file size, favorites, hidden status, on-device vs. iCloud, video duration, resolution, format, orientation, and more. Filter by blurry photos, people, camera models, places, and potential space savings, or include and exclude specific albums.
- Compare & Choose: Compare duplicate and similar photos side by side and zoom in to choose what to keep.
- Protect Favorites: Your favorites are kept when you clean Duplicates and Similar. A duplicate group with several favorites keeps one copy.
- Hidden Groups: Review hidden duplicate and similar groups in Settings and restore the ones you choose.
- Large Cleanups: Enjoy faster browsing and selection, with the option to delete selected items all at once or in smaller batches.
2) Organize Gallery
- Quickly sort unsorted photos and videos into specific albums.
- Sort your custom albums by size, name, or item count. Redesigned album selection makes adding and removing items easier.
3) Photo & Video Compression
- Save up to 95% of space with minimal quality loss.
- Compare original and compressed quality, zoom in on details, and review results before removing originals.
- Photo Options: Adjust resolution and quality, set a maximum resolution or target photo size, choose JPEG, PNG, or HEIC, and remove location and camera information.
- Video Options: Adjust resolution, codec, frame rate, and audio, with MOV and MP4 output.
- Ultrafast: Compress multiple photos at once and boost video compression.
- Supports GIF, Live Photo, Burst, and slow-motion compression. Live Photo size targets account for both the photo and video.
- Shrink Live Photo: Remove the video component to keep a still image and save space, or remove the photo component to keep only the video.
- Spatial Media: Compress supported spatial photos while retaining their spatial content, or convert spatial photos and videos into regular media.
4) AI Magic Eraser
- Remove unwanted people, objects, or background elements from photos with our advanced Magic Eraser, giving your photos a clean, professional look effortlessly.
5) Smart Utilities
- Photo & Video Viewer: Enjoy immersive viewing and detailed media information. Skip 5 seconds or hold to play videos at 2× speed.
- Photo Editing: Crop, rotate, adjust, and add text directly from the viewer. Save a copy or replace the original photo.
- Sharing: Share selected photos and videos directly from your library.
- Storage Monitor: Check storage of all your albums from the side menu.
- Home Widgets: Add widgets to monitor album storage.
- Private Album: Keep your sensitive photos and videos safely locked away in a secure folder.
◎ Privacy-First: 100% Local Cleanup
You don't need an internet connection to use Cleansmith because it works 100% offline on your phone. Your privacy is our top priority.
◎ We Value Your Feedback
Your experience matters to us! For questions or suggestions, reach out to us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/photocleaner
If you liked using Cleansmith, please rate us in App Store!

bluejetty:00026341:ios.description:
Are you ready to take on the ultimate challenge of becoming the richest person in the world?
Welcome to Money Maker Idle, the ultimate money printing game! It is so addictive!
In this game, you will start with nothing but a simple machine that prints a few dollars per minute. But with your tapping skills and upgrades, you will turn this humble machine into a mighty money-making empire!
Tap! and upgrade. Slice your way through the game, as you unlock more powerful machines and build multiple production lanes. With each upgrade, the piles of money printed will get larger, and you'll be on your way to becoming richer than Elon himself!
Experience the rush of slicing through piles of cash with our unique "Slice it All" feature and enjoy the ASMR sensation of perfect slices with our ASMR Slices. Double your money with the "Double Money" power-up, and rain down cash with the "Make it Rain" feature.
With this Tap Tycoon game, you'll feel the adrenaline rush as you tap your way to the top of the leaderboard. And with "Money Rush", you'll be able to maximize your profits with fast-paced, high-intensity gameplay.
But that's not all - you'll also be able to compete in weekly events, earn special bonuses, and unlock exclusive rewards. This is the ultimate office fever game.
So, download Money Maker Idle now and get ready to embark on the ultimate journey to get rich! With our addictive gameplay, stunning graphics, and thrilling features, you'll never want to stop playing. And who knows - you might just become the next billionaire!

bluejetty:00068876:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00068876:ios.description:
Unleash the power of your smartphone to take you on a guided tour of the night sky, even if you’ve never used a telescope before.
STARSENSE SKY RECOGNITION TECHNOLOGY
This one-of-a-kind app uses patent-pending technology in combination with a Celestron StarSense Explorer telescope (sold separately) to analyze star patterns overhead to calculate the telescope’s position in real time with pinpoint accuracy.
StarSense Explorer’s sky recognition technology has revolutionized the manual telescope by eliminating the confusion common among beginners and enhancing the user experience for even seasoned telescope users. Many would-be astronomers become frustrated or lose interest in their manual telescope because they don’t know where to point it to see planets, star clusters, nebulae, and galaxies—the good stuff! StarSense Explorer tells you exactly which celestial objects are currently visible in the night sky and where to move your telescope to place those objects in the telescope’s eyepiece. 
THE NIGHT SKY AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
The user-friendly planetarium interface allows you to scan the skies for objects you wish to view. You can also search for objects in the extensive database. 
Not sure what to observe? StarSense Explorer automatically generates a list of all the best stars, planets, galaxies, nebulae and more currently visible from your location. Simply select one from the list and off you go! 
While you observe, you can access detailed information, images, and audio descriptions for the most popular objects. It’s a great way for the entire family to learn scientific facts, history, mythology, and more, deepening your understanding of the night sky.
EASY AS 1-2-3: DOCK, LAUNCH, OBSERVE
To get started, assemble your StarSense Explorer telescope and download the app. Your telescope includes a unique unlock code to access the full features of the app. Connect your phone to the telescope by placing it into the StarSense dock and launch the app.
After a simple 2-step procedure to align the smartphone’s camera with the telescope, the app displays a view of the night sky and shows a bullseye on the screen to represent the telescope’s current pointing position. From here, you can select an object to view by tapping it in the planetarium view or selecting it from the Tonight’s Best observing list. Objects will vary from night to night; you may see planets like Jupiter or Saturn, nebulae like Orion, the Andromeda Galaxy, or other object types.
Once you select an object, the app displays pointing arrows onscreen. These indicate where to move the telescope to find it. Follow the arrows until the bullseye appears centered on target. When the bullseye turns green, the object is visible in the telescope’s lower powered eyepiece. 
HOW STARSENSE EXPLORER WORKS
StarSense Explorer uses image data captured by the smartphone’s camera to determine its pointing position. The app captures an image of the night sky and then matches the star patterns within the image to its internal database in a process like fingerprint matching or facial recognition. 
The process of extracting star pattern data in images to determine a telescope’s current pointing position is called “plate solving.” It is the same method used by professional observatories and orbiting satellites. 
The StarSense Explorer app is the first app ever developed that uses plate solving to determine the smartphone’s current pointing position. Other astronomy apps rely on the smartphone’s gyroscopes, accelerometers, and compass to estimate its pointing position. These methods are not accurate enough to place objects within the telescope’s field of view. 
StarSense Explorer technology is patent-pending. 
COMPATIBILITY
Compatible with iPhone 6 and higher.
LOCALIZATION
Support for English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Japanese and Russian.

bluejetty:00098883:ios.name: Arcanterra: A Story Driven RPG
bluejetty:00098883:ios.summary:
Arcanterra is a fast-paced action RPG with roguelike elements, focused on skill-based combat and steady progression.
Fight in real-time battles, face waves of enemies, and unlock new talents that gradually expand your combat options as you
bluejetty:00098883:ios.description:
Arcanterra is a fast-paced action RPG with roguelike elements, focused on skill-based combat and steady progression.
Fight in real-time battles, face waves of enemies, and unlock new talents that gradually expand your combat options as you grow stronger.
Jump straight into intense encounters where positioning, timing, and smart decisions matter. Defeat enemies and bosses, then choose upgrades that enhance your abilities and help you push further with each attempt. Every run builds on the last, unlocking new possibilities and improving your overall power.
Key features:
- Real-time hack and slash combat with responsive mobile controls
- Roguelike-inspired progression with meaningful upgrades
- Talent choices that enhance and refine your playstyle
- Artifacts that permanently strengthen your character
- Active companions that assist you in combat
- Challenging bosses and escalating enemy waves
- Colorful, painterly pixel-art fantasy world
Progress through a growing set of systems designed around experimentation and replayability. Discover new talents, artifacts, and companions, combine upgrades, and adapt your approach as difficulty increases.
Between runs, unlock permanent improvements, earn rewards even while offline, and expand your options for future attempts. Regular live-ops events introduce new challenges, limited-time content, and additional rewards.
Join guilds, chat with other players, and take part in a growing community. Social features allow you to share progress, discuss strategies, and experience Arcanterra together with other adventurers.
Explore a world of ancient ruins, forgotten magic, and dangerous creatures. The story unfolds subtly in the background, adding atmosphere without interrupting the action.
Enter Arcanterra, master its combat, and see how far your progression can take you.
Official website: http://www.funventure.eu

bluejetty:00021685:ios.summary: At Qatar Airways, we believe your journey should be as rewarding as the destination itself. That’s why we’ve designed our mobile app to put you in complete charge – with everything you need for a seamless journey right in the palm of your h
bluejetty:00021685:ios.description:
At Qatar Airways, we believe your journey should be as rewarding as the destination itself. That’s why we’ve designed our mobile app to put you in complete charge – with everything you need for a seamless journey right in the palm of your hand.
Get the most out of our app by becoming a Privilege Club member. It’s not just about being part of the ‘club’ – it’s about embracing a new lifestyle, a passport to more of everything you love. Think bigger rewards, better benefits and a richer travel experience. And the best part? The journey doesn’t stop after you land. Our app helps you find ways to earn Avios on your everyday life, even when you’re not flying. 
Travel smarter, live bolder and embrace the journey. This is the life. 
- Be inspired. Set your location and share your travel dreams, and we’ll handle the rest. You'll get tailored recommendations, exclusive promo codes and a whole lot of inspiration right at your fingertips.
- Book like a pro. Save time and effort with our personalised search wizard that picks up right where you left off. We’re all about that smart interface. 
- Earn Avios on every booking. Make every trip count. Join Privilege Club to earn Avios on every flight you take with us or our oneworld® partners. Check your Avios balance anytime with a tap on your Profile.
- Step into the future of travel. From bookings to bites, our AI-powered cabin crew, Sama, is here to help. Chat with Sama to book your dream destination or let her customise your menu in Business and First Class. 
- Double your adventure with a stopover. Explore Qatar during your journey with stopover packages starting from USD 14 per person. Easily tap to book for a taste of local culture, desert adventures, world-class shopping and more.
- Fast, easy and secure. Simply pay and go with convenient payment options, including e-wallets and one-click payments like Apple Pay and Google Pay. 
- Take full control of your journey. Add your trip and manage your booking on the go. Check in and download your digital boarding pass, make flight changes, select seats and more. 
- Add more for less. Travelling with special baggage or need an e-SIM? We've got flexible options to handle it all. Purchase add-ons effortlessly and skip the queue. 
- Travel smart with Live Activities. Get dynamic updates and see trip details right from your Lock Screen. Think check-in and gate information, boarding reminders and more. 
- Raise the bar. Stream, scroll and double tap at 35,000 feet with Starlink – the fastest Wi-Fi in the sky. Remember, Starlink is available on select routes, at no extra cost to you. 
- It’s all in the hub. Explore your benefits, rewards and all the ways you can collect and spend Avios in your Profile dashboard. Plus, get a sneak peek at what’s available on the next tier.

bluejetty:00025369:ios.description:
Bible Crossword Games – Daily Crossword Puzzles with Bible Verses and Scripture Study
Bible Crossword Games is a relaxing Christian crossword game designed to help you enjoy Scripture, learn Bible verses, and spend peaceful time with God every day. If you enjoy Bible games, crossword puzzles, word search games, or Christian learning apps, this is the perfect place to grow your faith while challenging your mind.
This app combines classic crossword gameplay with Bible verses, Scripture clues, and faith-based themes. Every puzzle is built around the Word of God, helping you reflect, study, and relax. Bible Crossword Games is ideal for anyone seeking a calm and meaningful alternative to traditional crossword games.
Designed for Bible Learning, Relaxation, and Daily Scripture Practice
Each crossword puzzle contains clues inspired by Bible stories, well-known verses, and essential faith concepts. As you solve clues and complete each crossword, you will unlock encouraging Scriptures that help you stay rooted in God’s truth.
This is more than a game. It is a daily habit of Scripture reflection, verse meditation, and quiet time with God.
Key Features:
1. Bible-Based Crossword Puzzles

bluejetty:00068194:ios.description:
Looking to buy new car? Or buy and sell a used car? You can do all this and more using CarDekho - the best car app in India. Do your car research - find out about latest car, popular car and upcoming car in India. Check out on-road price of various car models in your city, compare specs and features of two or more cars. Find out about the latest car offer and discount, get assistance with car loan, car insurance and more. You can even buy and sell used car easily using the CarDekho app, which has over 1 lakh used cars for sale. 
Benefits of downloading CarDekho app:
Compare on-road price, specs and features
Use the CarDekho app to get accurate and up-to-date on-road price of cars in your city. You can also compare car prices and specs, and even different variants of the same car to decide which one to buy.
Car Loan, Car Loan EMI Calculator
Find out more details about the car loan you might need using our car loan EMI calculator and get the best deals on car loan interest rates.
CarDekho Gaadi Store
Want to sell car? Head to CarDekho Gaadi store in your city to sell used car. We buy used car in a single visit. Find out the location of the nearest CarDekho Gaadi store and book an appointment using the CarDekho app. CarDekho Gaadi store gives you the best resale value on your car while also helping customers with RC transfer, loan closure assistance, instant money transfer and more.
Latest News, Reviews, Offers & More
Read the latest car news and in-depth, unbiased reviews from both industry experts and other car owners. Get a detailed look at the car through videos, images or even a 360-degree view of the car inside out. You can also find out your nearest car dealer, arrange for a test drive and learn about the best offers and deals on cars using the CarDekho app.
Buy & Sell Used Car With Ease
CarDekho also caters to all your used car needs with over 1 lakh used car listed for sale and accessible from the app itself. You can use CarDekho to easily sell used car by simply clicking a picture of the car, uploading it with the necessary details. At CarDekho, we also take on the responsibility of verifying prospective buyers to ensure that you are contacted by genuine customers only. If you want to sell car in the easiest, most reliable way, the CarDekho app is just a tap away.
That’s not all. Here are some more ways the CarDekho app will help:
• New Car Prices Across India : Explore all the details including Specifications, Pictures, Mileage, etc. 
• All Your Used Car Needs : Find certified used car to buy from second-hand car dealerships across India with information on how to get a used car loan as well. 
• Sell Used Car : Get genuine buyers from the biggest second hand customer base just by uploading a picture of the car and adding the details. Get the best value for your car using our used car valuation tool within the app.
• Expert Reviews : Read car reviews, comparisons and road tests along with latest car news. 
• User Review: You can also read genuine user reviews on CarDekho to help guide you and make an informed decision.
• Feel The Car: The CarDekho app’s 360-degree viewing feature allows you to experience what it is like to be inside and or around the car. 
• Compare Car: Compare features, prices, mileage, performance etc. to reach a logical conclusion in your car buying journey.
• Set Alerts: Stay up to date with the latest information on new car, upcoming car, and car prices in your city.
• Car Photos & Videos: Find latest car pics, inside scoops, and detailed car videos for the latest models. Hyundai Grand i10 Nios, MG Hector, Tata Altroz, MG Hector, Kia Seltos, Mahindra XUV300 and many more, all from the CarDekho app.

bluejetty:00167621:ios.description:
Spook: Your Personalized AI-Generated Text Story Companion
Ever wanted to dive into captivating text message stories that feature you and your friends as the main characters? Welcome to Spook, the ultimate app for AI-generated text message tales! With Spook, you can immerse yourself in personalized stories where you and your chosen companion become the stars of thrilling, suspenseful, and even hilarious conversations.
Features:
- AI-Generated Stories: Unlike traditional text story apps, Spook uses cutting-edge AI to craft unique stories on the spot, ensuring no two tales are ever the same.
- Personalized Characters: Input your name and the name of a friend, and watch as Spook weaves your names into the narrative, making the stories feel personal and engaging.
- Customizable Topics: Whether you’re in the mood for horror, romance, sci-fi, or comedy, simply choose your desired theme, and let Spook do the rest. The AI can adapt to any topic you provide, creating an endless variety of stories.
- Endless Entertainment: With AI at the helm, there’s no limit to the number of stories you can enjoy. Every session promises fresh and exciting narratives tailored just for you.
- Interactive Experience: Feel like you’re snooping through real conversations with our interactive text format. Tap to reveal new messages and let the suspense build with each exchange.
Subscription Details:
- Unlimited Access: Unlock the full potential of Spook with a subscription. For just $2.99 a week, enjoy unlimited access to all features and endless story possibilities.
- Subscription Benefits: As a subscriber, you’ll get unlimited story generation, personalized character integration, and access to all thematic options without any interruptions.
- Wait to unlock (only for unpaid): If you don’t want to pay yet, you can just wait between the episode intervals to unlock the next content!
Why Spook?
- Innovative Storytelling: Harness the power of AI to generate stories that are dynamic and ever-evolving, providing a new level of engagement.
- Tailored to You: Personalized content means the stories feel more real and immersive, drawing you deeper into the narrative.
- Versatile Themes: From spine-chilling horrors to heartwarming romances, Spook has a story for every mood and moment.
- Seamless Experience: Enjoy all the features of Spook without interruptions. Subscribe for unlimited access and never miss out on a new story.
*Prices are equal to the value that "Apple's App Store Matrix" determines is the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD.
By using Spook, you agree to our Terms of Use (http://www.walter-labs.com/spook/terms) & Privacy Policy (http://www.walter-labs.com/spook/privacy)

bluejetty:00018088:ios.description:
The Lone Star Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Lone Star Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Lone Star Bank App, you must be enrolled as a Lone Star Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00073874:ios.name: Lineman's Reference - XFMR LAB
bluejetty:00073874:ios.summary:
Learn it. Wire it. Energize it. Check your work.
Built by a working journeyman lineman for linemen and their apprentices. The XFMR Lab simulates distribution transformer banks driven by your own wiring — the metering, fusing, and faulting
bluejetty:00073874:ios.description:
Learn it. Wire it. Energize it. Check your work.
Built by a working journeyman lineman for linemen and their apprentices. The XFMR Lab simulates distribution transformer banks driven by your own wiring — the metering, fusing, and faulting all behave the way you'd expect in the field.
NEW IN 2.0 — BUILT-IN TRANSFORMER TRAINING (Replacing XFMR INFO)
Six guided lessons take you from "what's a transformer?" to wiring a 3-pot bank:
• Start Here — What is a Transformer?
• Dual H Bushings — The Two Wirings & the Nameplate
• The Tap Changer — One Pot, Multiple System Voltages
• Three-Phase — The Three Phases and How They're Related
• Bank Identification — Delta or Wye, Open or Closed
• Your First Bank: Delta-Wye Closed (120/208)
• More lessons on the way!
Work the lessons in order, or jump straight to the labs.
ALSO NEW IN 2.0
• The Sandbox (Beta) — wire anything from scratch in a COMPLETELY-customizable lab, with live, vector-based voltage and fault logic baked in.
• Death Traps — scenario-based transformer traps linemen run into — and how to navigate them safely.
• A brand-new look across every lab — new graphics, sharper, faster, & easier to read in the field.
• Voltmeter you can now drag with two fingers; readings update as the leads move.
• Parallel the secondary coils by hand in wye secondary labs
• Stats that track lab completions, quiz scoring and for-fun stuff like the number of fuses you've blown.
• User Customizations - the user can now alter the spec of their labs; from grounding to parallel coil cutover-direction, requiring the 4th cutout, tap changer implementation and more.
• 2.0 is FREE for everyone who already owns XFMR Lab — thank you for years of feedback and encouragement.
WHAT YOU GET
Single Phase — Single Bushing · Dual Bushing
Three Phase (closed) — Delta-Delta · Delta-Wye · Wye-Delta · Wye-Wye
Three Phase (open) — Open Delta-Delta · Open Wye-Delta
Misc — Paralleling · 4th Cutout · Death Traps (6 Scenarios)
Advanced — Straight 480 · 240/480 · 277/480 · Corner-Grounded 240/480 · Wye-Wye 5-Wire (120/240 + 120/208) - all now able to be wired up Wye AND Delta on the topside
The Sandbox (Beta)
EVERY FUTURE UPDATE IS FREE - THE APP IS A ONE-TIME PURCHASE. I'm always working on new updates.
TOOLS & REFERENCE
• Volt, ohm and rotation meters with real behavior
• Nameplate, secondary coil and tap changer animations
• Reference diagrams for every standard bank
Learning Mode walks apprentices through every wrong-connection check. Journeymen and experienced users can keep this turned off if they'd like.
QUIZZES
• Classic Quiz — Select each lab you want in your quiz - with graded scoring across each lab.
• Advanced Quiz — You're provided with the job-site info and need to pick the right nameplate and coil setup, then wire it.
• Bank ID - A beginner's quiz tied into the new XFMR Training lesson plan. The user is provided with different primary and secondary wirings and must correctly identify them.
Used by 30,000+ linemen since 2021.
Questions? Suggestions? Reach me at info@digitalapprentice.net

bluejetty:00024176:ios.name: IKEA Home smart
bluejetty:00024176:ios.summary:
With IKEA Home smart app and DIRIGERA hub, it's easy to create smarter everyday moments with lighting, speakers, blinds and air quality products.
Picture yourself waking up as your smart lights gently rise. Your favourite songs play on the
bluejetty:00024176:ios.description:
With IKEA Home smart app and DIRIGERA hub, it's easy to create smarter everyday moments with lighting, speakers, blinds and air quality products.
Picture yourself waking up as your smart lights gently rise. Your favourite songs play on the speakers and you still haven't gotten out of bed. How lovely, right? Smart products like lighting, speakers, blinds and air purifiers can make a lovely addition to your everyday life. When you improve the IQ of your home, life itself runs a bit smoother.
The magic happens when you combine two or more smart products from IKEA, tell them what to do in the app and save it as a 'Scene'.
A great scene is one you will use often. Think about waking up and going to bed, cooking and eating, date night and family time, or leaving and coming home. All everyday moments when we can support you with the best lighting, sound that suits your mood, and cleaner air.
When it comes to control, we think of everyone, from young to old and even visitors. So while the app gives you total control to customise your smart home, our range of remotes make it easy for everyone to live with and use a smart home.
In control 
• You can control products individually or in groups. You can turn whole rooms on and off or the whole home, all at once.
• Dim and change light colours, adjust blinds, speaker volume, and much more.
• Set the scenes you need and trigger them with schedules, a shortcut button or use the app.
Easy to use
• The home screen gives a fast overview of your whole home. Quickly control products, access rooms, or start/stop scenes. This is also where you add new products, rooms, and scenes. 
Organised and personal
• Organising your smart products in rooms gives fast access to the products you want to control.
• Personalise the app with your choice of icons, names and colours for rooms and products
• Create personal scenes, for example your own combination of cosy lighting and your favourite music. 
Integrations
• Connect to Apple Home, Amazon Alexa or Google Home to use a voice assistant.

bluejetty:00168588:ios.description:
OVERVIEW
Download our app and discover Gilt’s ever-changing assortment of top designers and one-of-a-kind experiences – all right at your fingertips. Shop on the go and get incredible steals for women, men, kids and home to inspire every facet of your life. Plus, find deals for unforgettable experiences available in your city.
SHOP OUR APP FOR:
+ Luxury and more designer brands at up to 70% off retail prices: Valentino, Stuart Weitzman, John Varvatos… to name a few.
+ New Sales with the latest inventory every day, plus longer-lasting shops arranged by style, trend and category.
+ Real-time reminders when Sales are on, so you never miss out.
+ Offers and exclusive experiences in your city. Gilt City has national deals and local offers in New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, San Francisco, Seattle, Boston, Atlanta, Houston, Dallas, Miami, Philadelphia, and Washington, DC.
CATEGORIES
+ Women: Trending dresses and skirts, shirts and sweaters, outerwear, denim and activewear. You will also find deals on intimates and loungewear, pants and shorts, and suits and blazers, along with swim and maternity brands. Plus, luxury shoes and trending jewelry and watches, as well as health and beauty musts.
+ Men: Trending outerwear, suits and sport coats, sweaters and hoodies, and stylish denim. Save on shoes, activewear, pants and shorts, and polos and tees. You will also find deals on trending swim, as well as socks, underwear and sleepwear.
+ Kids: Clothing, shoes and accessories for girls and boys. Save on toys, games and books. Plus, get amazing deals on baby gear.
+ Home: Savings on luxe bedding and bath, trending decor and accessories, and kitchen and tabletop. Find deals on bedroom and outdoor furniture, stylish luggage, pet accessories, and much more.
+ City: Exclusive local one-of-a-kind experiences and packages at great deals. Explore your city and save at the same time.
QUESTIONS?
Email Customer Service at customerservice@gilt.com

NETWORK STORAGE DEVICES:
Monitoring and firmware management of NETGEAR ReadyNAS 420, 520, 620, 3000, 4000 and 5000 series
Here is the full list of devices Insight manages by model [https://www.netgear.com/insight/devices.aspx]. Make sure your device is on this list to ensure your device will be manageable by Insight. After download, 
create your Insight account and let Insight help you add your Insight managed devices and create and configure your network. 
Insight Advantages:
Use Insight to discover, register, install and configure your Insight managed devices - switches, wireless access points and router gateways, and storage devices, as well as to setup your wired and wireless networks. 
Additionally, with the Insight app you can check the status of your network, re-configure and fine-tune settings and troubleshoot. You also can receive alerts and notifications on critical and important events related 
to your devices and networks. Most of the features available on the Insight Cloud Portal are available on the mobile app, making the NETGEAR Insight app an excellent tool to help stay on top of all your Insight-devices 
based networks. Additionally, with the Insight app, you have direct access to NETGEAR Help and Support. You truly have full visibility and control of all your networks in the palm of your hand – anytime, anywhere.
Unlike most network management solutions, NETGEAR Insight is a complete unified network management solution built specifically for the SMB market. With the easy, user friendly networking experience, NETGEAR Insight app enables 
multi-device configuration, network management, monitoring, and service deployment of select NETGEAR wireless, switching, routing and storage devices. 
Feature Highlights:
* Remote access into your networks and devices from anywhere right through your phone
* Unified and simplified multi-device configuration from your phone
* Unified cloud management of both wired and wireless networks
* Manage multiple network locations from one screen
* Troubleshoot issues and get NETGEAR Support right from your Insight app
* Intuitive mobile user experience
* No additional need for cloud controller, appliance, network manager, or PC/server
NETGEAR Insight Managed Devices -- check for list of devices managed by Insight [https://www.netgear.com/insight/devices.aspx]:
* Insight Managed Wireless Access Points – Meeting the need for higher bandwidth, multi-user support
* Insight Managed Switches — Networking made simple
* ReadyNAS Storage — Powerful, scalable
Now NETGEAR Insight supports landscape mode for tablets. Additionally, the NETGEAR Insight Cloud Portal is also available at https://insight.netgear.com.

bluejetty:00073439:ios.description:
iMapp - Find. Track. Stay Connected.
Stop worrying – with iMapp, you'll always know where your loved ones and devices are! This isn't just another mobile number tracker location app – it's your personal find my phone detective, family locator for caring parents, and ultimate friend finder for perfect meetups. Lost your phone? Need to find a friend? Looking for a precise people finder? iMapp does it in seconds!
Instant Device Tracking
Right now, you can find your phone even if it's on silent! Our advanced location finder works via GPS, Wi-Fi and cell towers – the perfect alternative to find my iPhone. Want to check your kid's after-school location? Activate kid tracker and breathe easy.
24/7 Family Safety
Your personal family tracker & parental control app with share my location features puts loved ones right in your pocket. Mom running late from work? Find my family shows her route. Teen out past curfew? Phone monitoring sends instant alerts. With people search, you can reconnect with old friends using just a phone number.
Smart Location History & Alerts
Never wonder where someone has been—iMapp stores 60 days of location history so you can review movements anytime. Set up geofence alerts to get notifications when friends or family arrive or leave key locations. Plus, monitor battery levels and get directions right from the app.
Speed Monitoring for Safe Driving
Drive with peace of mind using iMapp's speed control feature. Track a driver's speed in real-time and receive instant notifications when they exceed safe limits. Perfect for parents of new drivers - know if your teen is speeding the moment it happens. Worried about your partner's aggressive driving and want to use gps coordinates finder? Get alerts and have the conversation before it's too late. Our speed monitoring & control works seamlessly with all location tracking features for complete protection.
Itrack is a cell phone tracker app that includes the following features: find device Google -compatible tracking, number finder for quick searches, energy-saving geolocation modes, and secure family sharing options. Customize privacy settings to control who sees your location, ensuring you stay visible only to those you trust.
Download iMapp today and try a mobile number tracker location, find my phone, family search and friend finder app. Keep your loved ones close and your devices secure with seamless location sharing and track location technology.
Solicited access:
- to the camera and photo - to install the avatar
- to contacts - to invite friends
- to geo-position, including the background mode - to find the device location
- to push notifications - to send chat notifications
NOTE: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease the battery life of the phone
Download now and never lose track again!
Terms of Use http://imap-app.com/privacypolicy.html
Privacy Policy http://imap-app.com/privacypolicy.html

bluejetty:00185933:ios.name: ARTE.tv
bluejetty:00185933:ios.summary:
Compatible with AirPlay and Chromecast
Documentaries, reportages, magazine shows and concerts, all on the ARTE app. Watch your favourite ARTE shows whenever and wherever you want.
A whole world of ARTE in one App
New programmes every week
bluejetty:00185933:ios.description:
Compatible with AirPlay and Chromecast
Documentaries, reportages, magazine shows and concerts, all on the ARTE app. Watch your favourite ARTE shows whenever and wherever you want.
A whole world of ARTE in one App
New programmes every week: documentaries on social issues and engaging exposés. Reportage, live concerts and more… Find what you want to watch by browsing our categories.
Are you a Binge-watcher? 
With automatic play you don’t need to move. We will automatically play the next episode for you. Sit back and relax.
Watch ARTE offline 
With our download option you can now watch ARTE programmes offline. That means on the plane, on the beach or wherever you like. Download videos by pressing the download button (before you go off grid). Your downloads are stored in your “MyARTE” space for 72 hours and are accessible abroad.
Linkup to your TV screen
If you have a Chromecast key or Apple TV you can connect the ARTE app to your TV screen. Just click on the ‘Cast’ icon in the video player.
MyARTE
In your “MyARTE” space you can continue watching videos from where you left off, select your favourites and add content to watch later.
Language - Choose your language by clicking on the cog on the bottom-right of the video player. (English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish). You can also change languages in the app settings. 
For optimal performance the ARTE app needs to access to 
- Calendar in order to add upcoming programmes
- Bluetooth for access to Chromecast
- Microphone to configure Chromecast
Authorisation for access will be asked when you navigate the app. You can refuse access at any time.
If you have any comments or suggestions 
https://www.arte.tv/sites/en/corporate/users-guide/contact/
For legal reasons some of our programmes are only available in France and Germany whereas others are only available in Europe.

bluejetty:00123581:ios.description:
Can't decide where to eat? Let Restaurant Roulette choose for you!
Find open restaurants near you that serve the food you're craving & fit your price range - then spin the roulette wheel to randomly pick one! • Find nearby open restaurants using your location, a map, or a zip code.
• Filter restaurants by food category, price & distance.

• Select restaurants you want in the roulette & even add your own restaurants to the list.
• View restaurant ratings, food types, distance, price and more! You can even see the Yelp web page for each restaurant.
• Randomly select a restaurant from your roulette list.
• Get directions to your randomly chosen restaurant.
