bluejetty:00028641:android.description:
In the grim darkness of the far future, there is only war.
Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge is a fast-paced digital collectible card game (CCG) set in the vast, war-torn Warhammer 40K universe of the 41st millennium. Build powerful decks, command legendary factions, and fight across the galaxy in both single-player campaigns and competitive multiplayer battles. Collect all cards from the 6 factions available at launch, each with distinct mechanics, strengths, and strategies.
- Factions - 
• Space Marines: The Emperor’s finest warriors, adaptable and disciplined. 
• Goff Orks: Savage and unpredictable, the Orks rely on brute force, randomness, and overwhelming numbers. 
• Sautekh Necrons: Deathless legions that rise again to overwhelm enemies with sheer inevitability.
• Black Legion: The dark gods of the Warp grant their chosen followers forbidden powers, but at a cost.
• Saim-Hann Aeldari: Masters of speed and precision, the Aeldari focus on fast strikes and deception.
• Leviathan Tyranids: The Great Devourer comes in endless waves, evolving and mutating to adapt to any foe. 
Each faction in Warpforge plays differently, offering a variety of strategic options whether you prefer brute force, clever tactics, or unpredictable chaos!
- Game Modes -
• Campaign Mode (PvE): Dive into the rich lore of Warhammer 40K by playing through faction-driven campaigns. These narrative-driven battles introduce the personalities, conflicts, and motivations behind each faction, allowing players to experience iconic moments from the 41st millennium.
• Ranked PvP Battles: Climb the ranks, refine your deck strategies, and prove yourself as a master tactician of the far future against other players worldwide.
• Raids: Large-scale conflicts where entire player communities battle to unlock new special cards.
• Limited-Time Events & Draft Mode: Take on special challenges with unique deck-building restrictions or play in limited-time draft-style modes where every match is a test of improvisation and skill.
Prepare your forces, build and customize your deck, and enter the battlefield. Only the strongest will survive in the 41st millennium!

bluejetty:00124006:ios.description:
A classical point and click adventure, inspired by the old classics from the 90s!
Step through the portal. Solve the mystery. Find your brother.
The adventure continues! At the end of your last journey, you discovered a hidden portal. You've stepped through it, only to realize you are still trapped deep inside the same ancient pyramid—but in a secret, uncharted area.
Your mission remains the same: you must find your missing brother, Harley. As you navigate these forgotten rooms, you will discover letters he left behind. Piece by piece, his notes reveal a chilling mystery and hint at a dark, unseen force lurking within the pyramid's walls. Will you decipher the clues and find him before it's too late?
Legacy 2: The Ancient Curse is deeply inspired by classic point-and-click adventure games. It combines that traditional puzzle-solving feeling with beautiful 3D graphics to create a challenging and modern escape room experience.
Key Features:
• Read Harley's letters to piece together the story of his disappearance and uncover the ancient secrets hidden in the shadows.
• Explore a gorgeous, fully 3D environment that is much larger and more expansive than the previous game.
• Test your intelligence with puzzles and logical riddles that force you to think carefully before your next move.
• Rely on a dynamic hint system that gently nudges you in the right direction, or reveals the full solution if you get completely stuck.
• Play the game fully localized in English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, and Swedish.
Follow the development of the next title here:
https://www.instagram.com/nosignalproductionss/
I'm a solo developer, if you like to give me feedback or need support do not hesitate to send me an e-mail!

bluejetty:00033545:ios.description:
Welcome to Monster Hunter Puzzles! Explore the world of Monster Hunter through a cast of cute Felyne characters while solving challenging puzzles!
- Introduction
The Felyne Isles may seem like a peaceful corner of the Monster Hunter universe, but all is not well... Monsters are rampaging, making life miserable for the residents.
- Solve puzzles and help Felynes get back on their paws!
All of the "Catizens" have their own stories. Listen to what they need and solve their problems to bring the island back to life! There's drama waiting to unfold on every corner of these isles. Come join these cute Felynes on their soon-to-be island paradise!
Advanced Match 3 Puzzles
- Pieces move diagonally as well as vertically and horizontally!
- Solve puzzles to repel the monsters that appear!
- Make tons of special pieces during "Meowllocation Time"!
- Populate your island with new Felynes by solving puzzles!
- Raise your "Pawtential" and earn skills that will help solve puzzles!
- Compete with players around the world and earn ranking rewards!
Capcom—the company behind Monster Hunter, Resident Evil, Street Fighter, and Mega Man—now presents a casual and cute match 3 puzzle game. The destination? The Felyne Isles!
- What will you build!? Pick out buildings that fit perfectly with the Felynes and the island.
- Get to know these unique critters as you take them through the trials and tribulations of getting their businesses running again!
- Collect materials and exchange them for outfits to deck out your Felyne avatar with the latest fashion!
Note: The basic game is free to play, but there are some premium items available for purchase.
iOS Support:
- iOS 16.0 or later
- iPhone 11 or later, iPhone SE (3nd generation or later)
iPad Support:
- iPadOS 16.0 or later
- iPad (10th generation or later)
- iPad Pro 12.9-inch (3rd generation or later), iPad Pro 11-inch (1st generation or later), iPad Pro 10.5-inch
- iPad mini (6th generation or later)
- iPad Air (4rd generation or later)
Terms of Use
https://mobile.capcom.com/mhpuzzle/?tl=terms

bluejetty:00082461:ios.description:
MoodTalker - Your AI compassionate friend that will help you boost your mental health 24/7.
Feeling down and need a boost? Look no further than the MoodTalker. We offer a private space to share your worries without judgment. MoodTalker - An AI companion for your everyday emotional needs.
Whether you need a compassionate friend or an AI to talk to, the MoodTalker - MoodTalker is your right choice. Install the app for free, share your thoughts, write whatever is on your mind, and take some mind reading cards to lift your mood instantly.
Key Features:
##Empathetic Conversations with Adorable Friends
Need a compassionate friend during your lowest points? Meet Finnick the witty fox, Daisy the gentle deer, and Bruno the warm bear. These AI friends understand your emotions, play soothing music, and guide you through deep breaths. After each chat, they'll leave you a comforting journal entry to write your thoughts.
##Share Your Thoughts & Emotions
MoodTalker allows you to safely share your thoughts and feelings through text or voice. This mood tracker measures your emotional state and uses psychological techniques to help organize your mind. You'll receive personalized advice based on your emotional state and can track your emotional journey with insightful mood graphs.
##Mind Reader Card: Discover Your Heart
Feeling lost or looking for peace? Try MoodTalker's card reading feature. Pick a card, answer a few questions, and the magical card reader will reveal your personality and emotional state. Card reading is fun and can be uplifting when you're down.
##User-Friendly Interface & Free
Looking for a mood-boosting app that is easy to use? Download MoodTalker and enjoy its seamless features. Without complicated settings, you can simply install and start using our free mood app. Whether you're overwhelmed or just feeling a bit down, this mental health app is here for your mood balance.
Finding a compassionate friend is hard in this era, so we are here to help with your emotional needs. You'll get not just one, but several friends who will always be there for you. The mind reader card in this MoodTalker app is another wonderful option for boosting your mood. Pick a card and discover what is bothering your subconscious mind.
Install MoodTalker, share your thoughts, write whatever is on your mind, take some mind reading cards, and lift your mood instantly.
[Subscription Pricing and Terms]
MoodTalker is free to download. By upgrading to a subscription, you'll unlock all premium features, enjoy future updates for free, and experience an ad-free environment. We offer weekly, monthly, and yearly auto-renewing subscription options.
Once you confirm your purchase, the payment will be charged to your Apple iTunes account and will automatically renew at the end of each subscription period. To avoid renewal, cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends by managing your subscription in iTunes/Apple ID settings. bluejetty:00152813:ios.description:
GhostTube EVP is an advanced voice recorder for paranormal investigators and video creators to conduct EVP session (electronic voice phenomena). You can record regular voice recordings using only the microphone, or try our new experiment which combines microphone audio with audio signals modulated from interference detected by real sensors in your device. Advanced features exclusive for paranormal investigating include audio boosting so you don't miss any anomalies, audio tagging so you can tag moments of interest in your recordings, and voice activated system to make it easier to review your recordings for anomalies. 
GhostTube EVP provides a fully functional emulation of the discontinued DR60 voice recorder. As seen on numerous paranormal TV programs, these devices were discontinued in the 90s and the only way to get them is to spend thousands of dollars to buy one second hand from collectors. Our emulation closely matches the sample rate, audio boosting features and voice activated system (VAS) of the famed DR60, so now you can try it in your investigations risk-free without spending thousands of dollars online.
Key features of GhostTube EVP:
- Traditional EVP recorder
- Interference modulator
- DR60 emulator*
- Audio tagging*
- Adjustable sample rate
- Voice activated system (VAS)*
- Sound boost*
- Instant playback
- Scrubbable sound visualizer
- Access to GhostTube paranormal community and database with details thousands of haunted places around the world*
*Some features may require in app purchases or to create an account.
For more paranormal investigation and ghost hunting tools, check out our other apps.
GhostTube offers in-app purchases and subscriptions. Refer to our website for a full list of terms and conditions and EULA: GhostTube.com/terms
GhostTube is intended for use and enjoyment on real paranormal investigations and is a suitable substitute or supplementary device for many of the devices used on a typical investigation. But you need to keep in mind that the afterlife is a theoretical concept. It is often categorized as paranormal because the phenomena is not supported or explained by the natural laws of science currently understood and accepted in the scientific community. Paranormal tools in general are designed to measure and react to changes in the environment only. As such, paranormal tools should never be relied on to make important life decisions, as a form of definitive communication, or to cope with grief or loss. Words or sounds generated do not represent the views or opinions of the developer or its affiliates, and they should never be interpreted as instructions or requests.

bluejetty:00029297:ios.name: GPS Camera 55. Field Survey
bluejetty:00029297:ios.summary: Capture photos and videos with precise location, date, address, and custom notes overlaid directly on them. Add hand-drawn annotations to photos for quick markups in the field. Easily search and filter your shots by title, tags, or notes —
bluejetty:00029297:ios.description:
Capture photos and videos with precise location, date, address, and custom notes overlaid directly on them. Add hand-drawn annotations to photos for quick markups in the field. Easily search and filter your shots by title, tags, or notes — or sort them by proximity and date. Organize everything into folders or collections for structured reporting. Need to work with older photos? Import from your library and restore their location, direction, and notes automatically.
LOCATION OVERLAY 
Supports decimal, DM, DMS, UTM, and MGRS coordinate formats. 
True or magnetic heading, in degrees or mils. 
Accuracy and altitude in feet or meters.
CAMERA AND CAPTURE SETTINGS 
Save photos automatically or open in preview to annotate before saving. 
Option to save a copy to the photo library — original, stamped, or both.
Record location-aware field video with map, QR code, watermark, speed, and motion overlays, then replay recordings in the app. The basic version stores one video and exports a branded clip of up to 15 seconds.
ANNOTATE AND COMMENT 
Before or after saving, zoom in/out and draw directly on the photo using your finger or Apple Pencil. 
Crop, resize, rotate, or tilt the photo before or after saving.
Notes overlay supports Title, Note, Tags/Folder, and Address. 
Address can be auto-filled from GPS or entered manually. 
Edit notes and add annotations later (MENU > POINTS > tap an image). 
Tapping a point row opens the editor, where you can add an audio note. 
Timestamps support many formats and languages.
Scan QR codes, barcodes, or text and use the result for the title or note field.
WATERMARK 
The Pro Pack upgrade removes the basic version watermark and allows you to set up a watermark with your own image, text, and colors, if needed.
SHARE AND EXCHANGE 
Share multiple points via MENU > POINTS, or entire collections via MENU > POINT COLLECTIONS. 
Images can be shared with or without location/notes text, and with or without overlays. 
Photo filenames can include title, note, address, tags/folder name, collection, coordinates, altitude, heading, or capture date. 
To transfer complete points and images to another device, use KMZ (Google Earth archive) — includes photos, notes, annotations, and audio.
PDF REPORTS 
Generate and share PDF documents for the selected photos/points or whole collection/folder, with options for the number of images per page and photo descriptions.
ORGANIZE, SEARCH & SORT 
You can organize images into collections/folders. Existing images/points can be moved between collections. 
Search by notes, address, or tags; filter by creation month; sort by proximity; or show only one collection.
IMPORT 
Import photos from your library. The app reads TIFF/EXIF/GPS/IPTC metadata to restore location, direction, and notes for the stamp.
NAVIGATE 
Navigate back to any saved photo/point from its editor.
MAP VIEW 
Review any saved photo/point and its location on the map.
== PRO PACK UPGRADE ==
You can do a lot with the basic functions in the app. The PRO PACK upgrade adds:
- Ability to create additional point/image collections. 
- Enables sharing of more than 5 points/images at once. 
- Export/import capabilities — in particular, KMZ export/import enables transfer of collections or selected waypoints between devices. 
- Ability to save hand-drawn annotations for the image. 
- Crop, resize, rotate, or tilt the photo before or after saving.
- Extra protection of your work and privacy with PIN code or biometric-based access options. 
- Removes the basic version watermark and allows you to apply a custom watermark with your image, text, and colors.
- Unlimited saved videos and full-length stamped or original video exports.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Need to work with older photos? Import from your library and restore their location, direction, and notes automatically.

LOCATION OVERLAY  
Supports decimal, DM, DMS, UTM, and MGRS coordinate formats.  
True or magnetic heading, in degrees or mils.  
Accuracy and altitude in feet or meters.

CAMERA AND CAPTURE SETTINGS  
Save photos automatically or open in preview to annotate before saving.  
Option to save a copy to the photo library — original, stamped, or both.
Record location-aware field video with map, QR code, watermark, speed, and motion overlays, then replay recordings in the app. The basic version stores one video and exports a branded clip of up to 15 seconds.

ANNOTATE AND COMMENT  
Before or after saving, zoom in/out and draw directly on the photo using your finger or Apple Pencil.  
Crop, resize, rotate, or tilt the photo before or after saving.
Notes overlay supports Title, Note, Tags/Folder, and Address.  
Address can be auto-filled from GPS or entered manually.  
Edit notes and add annotations later (MENU > POINTS > tap an image).  
Tapping a point row opens the editor, where you can add an audio note.  
Timestamps support many formats and languages.
Scan QR codes, barcodes, or text and use the result for the title or note field.

WATERMARK  
The Pro Pack upgrade removes the basic version watermark and allows you to set up a watermark with your own image, text, and colors, if needed.

SHARE AND EXCHANGE  
Share multiple points via MENU > POINTS, or entire collections via MENU > POINT COLLECTIONS.  
Images can be shared with or without location/notes text, and with or without overlays.  
Photo filenames can include title, note, address, tags/folder name, collection, coordinates, altitude, heading, or capture date.  
To transfer complete points and images to another device, use KMZ (Google Earth archive) — includes photos, notes, annotations, and audio.

PDF REPORTS  
Generate and share PDF documents for the selected photos/points or whole collection/folder, with options for the number of images per page and photo descriptions.

ORGANIZE, SEARCH & SORT  
You can organize images into collections/folders. Existing images/points can be moved between collections.  
Search by notes, address, or tags; filter by creation month; sort by proximity; or show only one collection.

IMPORT  
Import photos from your library. The app reads TIFF/EXIF/GPS/IPTC metadata to restore location, direction, and notes for the stamp.

NAVIGATE  
Navigate back to any saved photo/point from its editor.

MAP VIEW  
Review any saved photo/point and its location on the map.

== PRO PACK UPGRADE ==

- Enables sharing of more than 5 points/images at once.  
- Export/import capabilities — in particular, KMZ export/import enables transfer of collections or selected waypoints between devices.

- Extra protection of your work and privacy with PIN code or biometric-based access options.

bluejetty:00187830:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00187830:ios.description:
Stop guessing your tax residency. Start proving it.
As featured in leading publications, Domicile365 is the trusted residency and day count tracking app for high-net-worth individuals, multi-state residents, digital nomads, globally mobile professionals and enterprises managing complex tax, statutory residency, and domicile determinations. Perfect for tracking multi-state travel, proving a change of domicile, and protecting against aggressive city, state, federal or international tax audits.
Core Features
• Automatic day count tracking by Country, State, City (including New York City), Province, and Territory
• Unlimited day count alerts by jurisdiction — email and push notifications as you approach key thresholds
• Download CSV logs and cryptographically-signed PDF audit logs — independently verifiable by auditors, CPAs, or advisors on Domicile365.com to confirm location records haven't been altered or tampered with
• Advisor Portal — invite your CPA or financial adviser for read-only access to your location data
• Manual entry for dates before you activated the app
• On-device AI to search and analyze your location history by date
• 60-day free trial — no credit card required
Location generally recorded throughout the day using the highest level of accuracy supported by your phone (consistent with efficient battery usage). Location is determined using a combination of GPS, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi hotspots and cell tower locations and then recorded. Please note that the continuous tracking may have a minor impact on battery life and data usage since location is continuously recorded and saved in the cloud. The App's applicable location algorithms are designed to minimize battery use.
Separate tools to check (a) Schengen Region status, (b) U.S. substantial presence test, (c) rolling 183 out of 365 day check, (d) Puerto Rico day count testing and (e) U.K. statutory residency test using the U.K. April 6 through April 5 tax year. 
Tools also provided to check location day counts considering only overnight stays or 24 hour periods (for UK, Monaco, Maryland, New Mexico, and other similar jurisdictions).
Audit Defense
Tax jurisdictions are increasingly aggressive in asserting residency — subpoenaing phone records, cell tower data, credit card logs and other items. The burden of proof is on you. Domicile365 generates a cryptographically-signed, contemporaneous record of your physical presence — and now lets you produce a signed PDF that auditors, courts, or opposing counsel can independently verify on Domicile365.com, confirming that your location logs are authentic and have not been altered after the fact.
– Sixty (60) day free trial provided. At the end of the sixty (60) day free trial period, you will be given the opportunity to subscribe to the Domicile365 monthly subscription to continue using the features of the app, which include daily tracking of your location, setting location alerts and access to tracking logs to establish your precise recorded locations. 
• Payment will be charged to Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
• Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to the App, where applicable.
Enterprise features are available. Track employee day counts for employer-employee income tax withholding. States impose employer income tax withholding based on days worked in-state. NYC Unincorporated Business Tax analysis, San Francisco Gross Receipts tax analysis, state heatmaps. 
Terms: domicile365.com/Legal.html
Privacy: domicile365.com/Privacy_Policy.html

bluejetty:00036005:ios.name: WebSSH - Sysadmin Toolbox
bluejetty:00036005:ios.summary:
Whether you're on the go or at your desk, WebSSH keeps you connected — anytime, anywhere! ٩(^‿^)۶
WebSSH is a professional SSH, Mosh, SFTP, Telnet, Serial and Port Forwarding client for iPhone, iPad and Mac, with a built-in Proxmox client
bluejetty:00036005:ios.description:
Whether you're on the go or at your desk, WebSSH keeps you connected — anytime, anywhere! ٩(^‿^)۶
WebSSH is a professional SSH, Mosh, SFTP, Telnet, Serial and Port Forwarding client for iPhone, iPad and Mac, with a built-in Proxmox client and a complete sysadmin toolbox. Built since 2012 for developers, system administrators and IT professionals who need reliable, secure remote access wherever they are.
CONNECT WITH CONFIDENCE
Authenticate with passwords, two-factor challenge, or keys (RSA, DSA, ED25519, PuTTY). Jump through bastion hosts, keep an alternative address per host for when you are inside or outside your network, and let known hosts protect you from surprises. Full terminal emulation (XTERM-256COLOR, XTERM, VT100) with WebGL rendering, split panes, inline images, buffer search, session recording and custom profiles — themes, fonts, colors and keyboard shortcuts tailored to your workflow.
NEW IN 33: ONE COMMAND, EVERY HOST
Run a command or a snippet on several hosts at once and watch the results come back side by side. The Terminal State Bar now shows more about the machine you are on, snippets get keyboard shortcuts on Mac, and the keyboard accessory keys can carry your own icons.
MANAGE FILES REMOTELY
The integrated SFTP and SCP client lets you browse directories, create, rename, upload and download files — and edit text files directly within the app. WebSSH can also open .txt files from anywhere on your device.
MORE THAN SSH
Mosh keeps your session alive through network changes, sleep and flaky connections — switch from Wi-Fi to cellular and pick up right where you left off. Telnet supports direct and interactive authentication, including the CP437 character set for BBS servers. Serial connections support full configuration (baud rate, parity, stop bits, flow control).
TUNNEL ANYTHING
Local and dynamic port forwarding, VPN over SSH to route your device's traffic through a server, port knocking and Wake-on-LAN to reach machines that are not listening yet.
PROXMOX AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Connect to one or more Proxmox servers and clusters, monitor your nodes at a glance (CPU, memory, storage), and manage your VMs and LXC containers — start, stop, reboot and migrate them right from your iPhone, iPad or Mac.
SNIPPETS THAT WORK FOR YOU
Save the commands you type every day, add dynamic variables, sync them from a GitHub Gist and fire them with a shortcut.
BUILT-IN SYSADMIN TOOLKIT
Quick diagnostics without leaving the app: Ping, Traceroute, DNS Lookup with propagation check, Whois, network scanner, Certificate Checker, Postmaster for SMTP and DMARC audits, HTTP Forge for crafted requests, Hex Viewer, Baker for data transformations, Code Forge for QR codes, Subnet Calculator, Cron generator, Password Generator and end-to-end encrypted Secret Share. The mashREPL local shell (ls, grep, curl, ping, tar and more) works even without internet access.
PRIVACY. PERIOD.
No account. No analytics. No ads. Your connections stay on your device, and iCloud sync only runs when you turn it on.
WHY WEBSSH?
Most SSH clients are either too basic or too bloated. WebSSH hits the sweet spot: professional-grade features, a clean mobile-first interface, and rock-solid reliability — every on-device feature unlocked with a single one-time PRO purchase, yours for life on every device.
One app. Every protocol. Zero compromises.
Download WebSSH and keep your servers close at hand, no matter where you are.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00016623:ios.description:
Meow-meow-meow!
Kid-E-Cats invite you on an exciting sea adventure!
Do you want to go and search for ancient treasures?
Lots of challenges await you on your way! Are you ready? Let's set off!
Fantastic journey with the cats on a big ship is waiting for you!
Pick your ship:
The Pirate Ship for the bravest!
The Sweet Ship for the ones with a sweet tooth!
The Coast Guard Ship in case order is your first priority!
Grandpa Cat found a real map, which shows where a treasure chest is hidden.
But the way to the treasure won't be easy, first of all you'll have to get to the island.
On the way you will deal with real icebergs, strong wind and even a storm ...
But the real sailors never give up, so neither shall we!
Cookie, Candy and Pudding have prepared interesting mini-games for real travelers!
- "Underwater treasure": dive under the water and find all the gold coins on the bottom of the ocean!
- "Diving": find all the fish! Be very attentive, they can hide anywhere!
- "Seashells collector": collect the most beautiful seashells with Candy!
- "Whale's photo": take pictures of the whale before he swims away!
- "Sea Shower": the whale has got dirty, wash the sea-mud off him!
- "Save the dinner": keep the birds away, they shouldn't eat the kittens' dinner!
- "Sea fishing": catch as many fish as possible!
The cats are getting really close! You only need to find the island now and run to grab the treasure!
So the treasure from the chest is... 
Oh no, you will have to find it out yourself!
Well, let's get going, ship casts off now!

listings.description:
Bunny Pop is a super fun & highly addictive match game that’ll keep you playing for hours!
Join Bunny on a colorful forest adventure bursting with a number of challenges!
Your efforts will be rewarded, so hop to it and bubble-shoot your way to victory!

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap on 2 or more cubes of the same color which are adjacent to each other.
• Special boosters & items to help you pass trickier levels.
• Pop all the Cubes with a minimal touch to score higher.
• No rush! Plan every move carefully.

FEATURES
• Numerous boosters and updates!
• The water level will rise with special potions, enabling the blocks to float!
• NO WIFI? NO PROBLEM! Enjoy the puzzle game anytime, anywhere!

• TONS OF UNIQUE LEVELS
- Over 300 levels with uniquely amazing challenges!
- Explore the beautiful bright world with Bunny!

• EASY AND FUN PLAY
- Easy to learn and fun to master

• Daily Spin!
- Earn daily rewards to help you out!

• NO WIFI? NO PROBLEM!
- Enjoy the game offline.

• STUNNING GRAPHICS
- Soothing soundtrack and gorgeous visual effects

NOTES
 • Bunny Pop is available on mobile phones & tablet PCs. 
• Bunny Pop contains ads like banners, interstitials, videos, and house ads.
• Bunny Pop is free to play, but you can purchase in-app items like AD FREE and coins.

E-MAIL
• contactus@puzzle1studio.com

HOMEPAGE
• https://www.puzzle1studio.com/

Privacy Policy
• https://www.puzzle1studio.com/privacy-policy/

Time to pop!
Thank you!

bluejetty:00122279:ios.description:
Shoot retro-style videos with one tap.
Just press the record button to turn everyday scenes into hundred years old movies!
[[ Friendly reminder ]]
This app simulates an analog film-reel camera.
There are some restrictions that don't exist in other video apps. 
- The maximum length of the video is 20 seconds for the default black and white film, and 6 seconds for other films. You can extend all films to 5 minutes if you purchase the PRO version.
- You can only append a new recording after the previous recording. If you want to create a new recording from scratch, export the previous recording first, then delete it.
- You only have one film for each effect
With these limitations, your creativity is challenged. Some people export multiple footages then use iMovie to create a full-fledged movie. Find your ways to fully utilize this powerful and fun tool!
[ Record stylized videos ]
- What you see in the preview is what you record
- You can append as many cuts as you like
- Free recording for 20 seconds for the Black & White Film, 6 seconds for others: best for SNS!
[ Realistic vintage effects ]
- Unique analog films effects: dirt noise and frameshifting
- The signature "Burning" effect when you stop playback
- The "Film End" effect after completing playback
- Realistic mechanical sounds make recording even enjoyable!
[ Simple operation ]
- All the main features are on one screen: record, playback, and camera flip
- Share your creations from the bottom-left share button
- You can always cancel exporting video by tapping the screen
[ PRO features ] (requires a subscription or one-time purchase)
- Extend all films to 5 minutes
- Record sound
- Full control of noise settings
- Import video from the camera roll
- Use front camera
- Square view/ square video export
- Fast & reverse play
- Free upcoming features
[ Troubleshooting ]
- Selfie is upside down — Turn off "Portrait Orientation Lock"
- Video not saved to Camera roll — Tap the Share button on the bottom-left, select video size, then select "Save Video". You might need to scroll down to see the option.
When you publish your work, please let us know with the tag #vintagefilmcam.
We can't wait to see your awesome artwork!
Limitations for now:
- Original color video recording will not be saved
- You cannot edit after recording. Please export the video and use other tools
We look forward to your opinions and requests.
Enjoy!
Kakumei team
Twitter: @vintagefilmcam
[ For auto-renewing subscriptions ]
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
Terms of Service: https://da1ssk.github.io/vfc/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://da1ssk.github.io/vfc/privacy.html

bluejetty:00027787:ios.description:
15 phút nghe sách mỗi ngày để phát triển bản thân và sự nghiệp. Fonos, kho sách nói best-seller lớn nhất Việt Nam, với hàng nghìn sách nói, ebook, tóm tắt sách, podcast, thiền và truyện ngủ.
Biến thời gian di chuyển, tập thể dục hay nghỉ trưa thành cơ hội học hỏi. Chỉ cần 15 phút mỗi ngày.
SÁCH NÓI BEST-SELLER & ĐỘC QUYỀN
Hàng nghìn sách nói được thu âm chuyên nghiệp bởi đội ngũ voice talent tại studio của Fonos, mang đến trải nghiệm nghe chân thực và sống động.
Nghe nhiều nhất trên Fonos: Tâm Lý Học Về Tiền, Đắc Nhân Tâm, Sapiens, Tư Duy Nhanh Và Chậm, Dạy Con Làm Giàu, Tam Quốc Diễn Nghĩa, Hoàng Tử Bé, Doraemon.
Từ các tác giả hàng đầu: Thích Nhất Hạnh, Yuval Noah Harari, Fredrik Backman, Phan Văn Trường, Giản Tư Trung, Đặng Hoàng Giang, Xuân Phượng.
Fonos hợp tác cùng các nhà xuất bản uy tín nhất Việt Nam: NXB Trẻ, Nhã Nam, Alphabooks, Thái Hà, First News. 100% nội dung có bản quyền.
Sách nói kinh doanh, phát triển bản thân, lịch sử, văn học, khoa học và nhiều thể loại khác.
EBOOK
Đọc sách điện tử ngay trên Fonos. Kết hợp nghe sách nói và đọc ebook trong cùng một ứng dụng.
TÓM TẮT SÁCH
Nắm ý chính của sách hay trong 15 phút. Phù hợp cho người bận rộn muốn đọc nhiều hơn.
PODCAST & NỘI DUNG ĐỘC QUYỀN
Podcast về kinh doanh, phát triển bản thân, lịch sử và văn hóa. Cùng nội dung độc quyền: thiền, truyện nói thiếu nhi, truyện ngủ và nhạc chủ đề.
ĐƯỢC TIN DÙNG BỞI HÀNG TRIỆU NGƯỜI VIỆT
- 3.500.000+ lượt tải
- 35.000+ đánh giá, 4.7 sao trung bình
- Ứng dụng nổi bật của Apple 2024
- Được Forbes Vietnam, Vietcetera, CafeF giới thiệu
TÍNH NĂNG NỔI BẬT
- Nghe offline: tải sách về nghe không cần mạng
- Tốc độ nghe linh hoạt: 0.5x đến 2x
- Hẹn giờ tắt: nghe truyện trước khi ngủ
- CarPlay: nghe sách khi lái xe
- Đồng bộ: tiếp tục nghe trên mọi thiết bị
- Chương 1 miễn phí: thử nghe trước khi đăng ký
GÓI ĐĂNG KÝ
Fonos cung cấp nhiều gói phù hợp nhu cầu, từ gói Lite cho người mới bắt đầu đến gói Premium với toàn bộ nội dung: sách nói, tóm tắt sách, podcast, ebook và thiền.
Tải Fonos ngay để bắt đầu nghe sách mỗi ngày.
Thanh toán sẽ được tính vào tài khoản Apple ID khi xác nhận mua. Gói đăng ký tự động gia hạn trừ khi được tắt ít nhất 24 giờ trước khi kết thúc kỳ hiện tại. Quản lý hoặc hủy đăng ký trong Cài đặt > Apple ID > Đăng ký.
Điều khoản sử dụng: https://fonos.vn/terms
Chính sách bảo mật: https://fonos.vn/privacy

bluejetty:00161832:ios.description:
GOLDEN Chat App is a vibrant hub designed for sports enthusiasts, offering a secure and engaging platform to connect, share, and celebrate their passion. Built on the belief that sharing enhances life, the app fosters a thriving community where users can discuss teams, transfers, the rise of new GOATs, and a wide array of sport-related topics. Stay informed with timely reminders about your favorite team’s matches, national team games, and the world’s most exciting competitions, uniting fans to grow stronger and happier together.
The app’s live-score feature delivers precise, real-time game data, ensuring rational and informed discussions. Beyond that, GOLDEN Chat App stands out with its advanced statistics and mathematically calculated personalized filters, allowing users to dive deep into game analytics and tailor their experience to their preferences. Engage in thrilling chat contests that test your sports knowledge, adding a fun competitive edge to the community. Whether you’re analyzing performance stats, joining contests, or simply enjoying the camaraderie, GOLDEN Chat App combines cutting-edge features with a love for sports to create an unmatched experience for every fan. This release marks the new face of the former Golden Tips brand, ushering in a bold evolution of innovation and community engagement.
Subscription Information:
The app requires an automatic renewal subscription.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, with the renewal cost clearly identified.
You can cancel a subscription via the subscription settings in your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the subscription period ends to avoid being charged for an additional month. For more details, visit http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098. Note that cancelling your subscription will revoke your access to the app.
Your purchase can be restored if you reinstall the app or lose access while your subscription remains active.

bluejetty:00040604:ios.description:
Traveling.com – Book Bus, Train, Ferry & Flight Tickets
Formerly GetByBus, Traveling.com is the all-in-one transport app for booking bus tickets, train tickets, ferry tickets, flight tickets, plane tickets and airport transfers across Croatia, the Balkans, Europe, Asia and 70+ countries worldwide. Compare trusted carriers, routes, departure times and ticket prices, discover travel deals and travel discounts, save money with cheap tickets, cheap bus and cheap train options, and enjoy secure online booking with instant confirmation.
Planning European travel, last minute travel or a multi-country trip? Book transportation online and manage every journey from one easy transport app.
BOOK BUS, TRAIN, FERRY & FLIGHT TICKETS
Search, compare and book transport in one convenient travel app.
- Bus travel across Europe, the Balkans and Southeast Asia
- Train travel for regional and international rail
- Ferry tickets across Croatian islands and the Adriatic
- Airport transfers and shared minivans
- Flight and plane tickets for longer journeys
PLAN EVERY TRIP – JOURNEY PLANNER & ITINERARY MANAGER
Our journey planner lets you build a trip itinerary, compare transportation options, organise your travel itinerary and manage bookings — all in one place.
Instantly access:
- Departure schedules and live availability
- Ticket prices and route details
- Carrier information and onboard amenities
- Traveler reviews and ratings
- Boarding information and travel updates
- Customer support before, during and after your trip
Everything you need for seamless travel is available in one easy booking app.
CROATIA, THE BALKANS & EUROPE
Popular routes include Zadar to Zagreb, Split to Zadar, Split to Zagreb, Sibenik to Zagreb, Rijeka to Zagreb, Zagreb to Plitvice Lakes, Zagreb to Dubrovnik, Dubrovnik to Split, Split to Makarska, Dubrovnik to Kotor, Dubrovnik to Mostar, Kotor to Budva, Sarajevo to Mostar, Sarajevo to Belgrade, Sarajevo to Zagreb, Mostar to Kotor, Split to Hvar, Metkovic to Zagreb, Tivat to Kotor, Ljubljana to Zagreb, Novi Sad to Belgrade, Tirana to Podgorica, Kotor to Podgorica, Pattaya to Suvarnabhumi Airport, Bangkok to Pattaya, Chiang Mai to Bangkok, Budapest to Vienna, Skopje to Prishtina and Sofia to Skopje.
Travel across Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Albania, Slovenia, Italy, Germany, Austria, France, Spain, the United Kingdom, Southeast Asia and beyond.
COMPARE TRUSTED CARRIERS
Compare schedules, transparent ticket prices, travel duration and onboard amenities before you book.
- FlixBus, Megabus and National Express
- Alsa, Avanza, Sena, Autostradale and BlaBlaCar Bus
- Jadrolinija, TP Line and Krilo
- Arriva, Centrotrans and Nomago
- Lomprayah, Thai Railway and GreenBus
MANAGE BOOKINGS & TRAVEL ACTIVITIES
Manage every booking with ease.
- Manage bookings anytime
- Change bookings or cancel tickets
- Download tickets and travel vouchers
- View upcoming trips
- Multi-transport booking for every journey
MOBILE TICKETS
Download tickets directly to your phone and board using QR codes whenever available.
EXCLUSIVE TRAVEL DEALS
Unlock app-exclusive travel deals, travel discounts and affordable asia travel, europe travel and last minute travel options.
CUSTOMER SUPPORT 24/7
Our customer support team is available before, during and after your journey.
WHY TRAVELERS CHOOSE TRAVELING.COM
- 200,000+ departures across 70+ countries
- One-stop transport app for bus travel, train travel, ferries and flights
- Journey planner and trip planner in one app
- Secure online booking with instant confirmation
- Easy booking, ticket management and travel activities
- Mobile tickets and downloadable travel vouchers
- Book transportation across multiple countries online
- Travel deals and affordable travel options
Download Traveling.com today with more routes, carriers and countries than ever.

bluejetty:00035568:ios.summary:
1.5 million travelers use Stippl to plan every trip: route planner, day planner, budget tracker, travel journal, reels and eSIM. Everything your next holiday needs, in one app.
Plan your journey in minutes. Relive every adventure forever.
bluejetty:00035568:ios.description:
1.5 million travelers use Stippl to plan every trip: route planner, day planner, budget tracker, travel journal, reels and eSIM. Everything your next holiday needs, in one app.
Plan your journey in minutes. Relive every adventure forever.
TRAVEL ROUTE PLANNER
Build your entire trip visually: add cities, stops and destinations across countries and continents. Change a stop and your whole route adjusts instantly.
• Plan routes across multiple cities and countries
• Add transport between every stop: flights, trains, buses
• See your full journey mapped out at a glance
TRAVEL DAY PLANNER
The most detailed day planner for travelers. Schedule every activity, restaurant, museum and transfer, hour by hour, day by day. More detail than any other travel app.
• Hour-by-hour schedule for every day of your trip
• Add places, times, notes and bookings to each day
• See your full day at a glance: nothing gets missed
TRAVEL BUDGET TRACKER
Track every expense as you travel and always know exactly where your money is going. Split costs instantly. Perfect for families, couples and solo travelers.
• Log every expense by category: food, transport, accommodation
• Split bills instantly with your travel group
• Visual budget overview so you never overspend
TRAVEL JOURNAL & DIARY
Stippl is the travel journal app and travel diary that keeps every memory in one place: photos, notes and stories from every trip you've ever taken.
• Daily journal entries with photos and notes
• Build a travel diary across every adventure
• Look back on every trip, every detail
TRAVEL REELS & PHOTOBOOKS
Turn your trips into stories automatically. Stippl creates travel reels and beautiful photobooks from your photos, ready to share without any editing.
• Auto-generated travel reels from your trip photos
• Photobooks that capture every moment
• Share your journey with friends and family
AI TRAVEL PLANNER (PRO)
Tell Stippl what kind of trip you want (relaxed, cultural, adventurous, off the beaten track) and the AI travel planner builds your full itinerary in seconds.
• Full itinerary generated by AI in seconds
• Choose your travel style: culture, adventure, nature and more
• Edit, adjust and make it completely your own
BOOKING & TRANSPORT ORGANIZER
Stop digging through your inbox. Add all your flight, hotel, train and activity confirmations to Stippl and access everything instantly.
• All your bookings in one place
• Flights, hotels, trains and activities
• Goodbye, confirmation email chaos
ESIM MOBILE DATA
Stay connected the moment you land. Buy an eSIM directly in Stippl and get local data in 190+ countries. No roaming charges, no SIM swapping.
• Local data plans in 190+ countries
• Buy and activate directly in the app
• Works alongside your existing number
SMART PACKING LIST
Never forget what to pack again. Build smart packing lists tailored to your destination and trip length, and check everything off before you leave.
• Customizable packing lists per trip
• Check off items as you pack

bluejetty:00130924:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the timeless teachings of the Bible with Biblfy, your ultimate companion for spiritual growth and enlightenment. Dive into the King James Version (KJV) of the Bible, engage in daily devotionals and prayers, test your knowledge with interactive quizzes, and explore personalized Bible reading plans that cater to your unique interests. Whether you're a devout follower or simply seeking solace, Biblfy is designed to be your gateway to a deeper connection with faith.
Key Features:
 - Prayer & Devotionals: Begin and end your day with heartfelt prayers and insightful devotionals. Our carefully curated content offers wisdom and inspiration to navigate life's journey, helping you find solace, strength, and purpose.
 - KJV Bible: Immerse yourself in the eloquent language of the King James Version Bible. Easily access and explore the sacred texts, make notes, and bookmark verses for personal reflection and study.
 - Bible Quizzes: Put your Bible knowledge to the test! Engage in fun and educational quizzes that challenge your understanding of Scripture, deepening your connection with the stories, parables, and teachings within.
 - Bible Reading Plans: Choose from a diverse range of reading plans tailored to your interests and needs. Whether you're exploring specific themes, characters, or books of the Bible, our plans offer a structured way to engage with the Word.
 - Twice Daily Devotion: Experience daily spiritual growth with morning and evening devotionals. Start your day with intention and reflection, and close it with gratitude and contemplation, all guided by Biblfy's thought-provoking content.
 - Reading Tracker: Keep track of your Bible reading progress and accomplishments. Celebrate milestones and share your journey with friends, fostering a sense of community and accountability.
 - Personalized Experience: Tailor Biblfy to your preferences. Choose from various themes, font sizes, and reading modes to create an experience that resonates with your style.
Whether you're seeking inspiration, guidance, or a deeper connection with faith, Biblfy offers a comprehensive platform to explore the profound teachings of the Bible. Experience spiritual growth, connection, and transformation through Scripture, prayer, and reflection.
What people say about us:
“The app delivers God’s meaningful and insightful messages in an easy-to-read and understand way. It’s simply and straightforward and I would recommend it to anyone......especially to those who are seeking some reassurance of God’s plan for all of us.”
“This app is part of my morning routine. It has a devotional reading and prayer that really help me. I find encouragement, inspiration, and hope. The app has beautiful themes that also set the mood for my day. I love being able to read about an ancient church and it’s history, as well. This is definitely worth using.”
”I enjoy meditating to the word daily throughout the day…if I start and end my day. through this site I know that I have had spiritual reflection. Thank you for this wonderful App!”
You may use this app permanently for free, but if you want to contribute to Biblify mission of delivering and spreading wisdom each day, moments of grace and love, patronage subscription available in the app.

bluejetty:00152624:ios.description:
An island. An expedition. A horror and mystery adventure full of puzzles and escape moments.
You are part of a research expedition on a remote island—a place that should have been forgotten long ago. Officially, it's about nature conservation, but beneath the surface lie old experiments, vanished missions, and traces that no one should have found. It soon becomes clear that this is no ordinary adventure, but a journey full of horror, creepiness, and mystery.
This game is a text adventure with escape elements. Your decisions determine who survives and what comes to light in the end. Each choice brings you closer to the truth or leads you deeper into darkness.
What awaits you:
- An interactive horror story that will grab you.
- A creepy atmosphere in an abandoned environment.
- Puzzles and escape passages that challenge your mind.
- A mystery thriller in which every clue is crucial
In the end, it's up to you:
- Will you solve the puzzles and escape this escape nightmare?
- Will you face the horror lurking beneath the surface?
- Or will you succumb to the horror of the island?
Find out – if you dare. BioSol is counting on you.

* Vessel catalog

* Waypoints, routes, ETA, XTD, speed limits
* Route Meeting Point
* Visual CPA
* AIS "virtual boarding"
* Mariners tools: VRM, EBL, Mariners Notes, Clearing Lines

Pholorize is an AI photo colorizer app that colorize black and white pics automatically with its power from artificial intelligence. Pholorize mostly used to enhance and colorize old photo albums by more than 10000+ users and is recognized as one of the most known image colorizer apps. It has the capability to both enhance and colorize photos both in single and batch mode. So, you can basically scan an old photo album and add color to each photo instantly.
With this professional photo enhancer, you can easily enhance photo quality, unblur & sharpen images, and restore old photos to crystal-clear HD.
KEY FEATURES
Colorize and Restore Old Pictures
Add vibrant colors to any photo with single and batch photos modes. Colorize your old b & w family photos and memories and revive them again. With image restoration tool, first step is to enhance the photo quality by upscale the photo resolution, the second step is to remove the artifacts and finally the, AI will colorize the photo. By completing all three steps, you will restore old photos.
Improve Photo Resolution
Increase and upscale your pictures into HD photos without losing any detail. 
Enhance Photo Quality
You can easily use ai photo enhancer by only selecting your photos with one
 tap. The core of the enhancer relies on the powerful AI Enhancer technology the advantage of such technology brings face details and quality of photos in seconds.
Sharpen Details
Sharp and vibrant photos always look better compared to old photos. Pholorize makes it possible to edit and sharpen photos for also enhanced and colorized photos. You can easily adjust sharpen and vibrant settings.
Color Filters
Different type of prebuilt color filters make it easier to enhance both the colors of the photo and the picture itself. You can use this feature as a post-process tool after colorization.
Color Curves
Colorization process can be improved with the color curves. You can edit Red, Green, Blue and RGB channels seperately, it will generate better photos based on the quality of colors.
ADJUSTMENTS
With adjustments, you can edit all of the following list;
- Brightness - Contrast
- Saturation - Highlights - Shadows
- Tint
- Sharpness
Batch Colorization
What if you have an old photo album with lots of beautiful memories and photos, your heritage from back ? It is super easy with Pholorize, just select each captured image from your albums and that’s it! In a few seconds, you will find the beautiful memories back with it’s colorized version. It is pretty cool to see the old photos in AI improved quality.
UNLIMITED ACCESS TO ALL FEATURES
– You can subscribe for unlimited access to all features.
– Subscriptions are billed automatically at the rate depending on the selected subscription plan.
- Terms of use: https://www.rayinformatics.com/terms
- Privacy policy: https://www.rayinformatics.com/privacy

bluejetty:00122715:ios.description:
APP DESCRIPTION: 
The Farmers Bank Spencer, IA Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances. 
FEATURES 
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization. 
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills. 
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances. 
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Farmers Trust & Savings customer service directly from the app. 
SAFE AND SECURE 
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access. 
GETTING STARTED 
To use the Farmers Bank Spencer, IA Mobile App, you must be enrolled as a Farmers Trust & Savings Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

All Recovery - Photos, Videos scans
bluejetty:00116117:android.description:
Bring lost moments back under your control. All Recovery - Photos, Videos helps you recover deleted photos, videos and restore files from your phone memory with a clear, step-by-step flow you can trust.
All Recovery - Photos, Videos scans device storage (MediaStore, cache, and - when available -Trash/Recycle Bin) to detect items that may be recoverable. You can preview each file, select exactly what you need, and restore photos and videos in batches - no root required.
✅ What you can do
◆ Photo & video recovery (recently deleted): find deleted photos or deleted videos that are still restorable
◆ Document/file recovery: discover and restore files (PDFs, images, etc.)
◆ Preview before restoring: verify deleted photos and videos before restore
◆ Batch restore: recover deleted photos and videos multiple at once
◆ SD card support: scan external storage for photo recovery and video recovery
◆ Flexible sorting & filters: organize by date, size, or type
◆ Secure delete: permanently remove unwanted photos or files
❓ How it works
◆ Scan your device to detect recoverable photos, deleted videos, and files
◆ Preview results to confirm deleted content before recovery
◆ Restore selected photos and videos, or choose batch recovery for multiple items
✍️ Compatibility & notes
◆ Works with common photo and video formats used by device and Gallery apps
◆ Supports internal storage, phone memory, and SD cards (with permission)
◆ Results vary by device, storage, and how long ago photos or videos were deleted
◆ Items permanently removed may not be recoverable
◆ No root required. Optional features (e.g., cloud backup) require internet only if enabled
👉 Permissions we request (and why)
◆ Photos & media/Library: to scan, preview, and recover deleted photos and videos
◆ SD card: to scan and restore files from external storage
Take action while photo recovery is still possible. Scan, preview, and restore deleted photos, videos, and files easily with All Recovery - Photos, Videos.
Whether it’s deleted photo recovery from phone memory or deleted video and image recovery, bring your memories back - in your control, with clear limits.

HOW I
bluejetty:00159123:ios.description:
Meet Riley — the baby development coach and milestone roadmap trusted by 35,000+ families. See your child's path ahead, take fun quizzes, find local age-appropriate events and understand how you can support your child at every stage.
HOW IT WORKS
- You share your parenting goals and style. Riley gives you a customized milestone 'storyline' for your child's development with skills to check off, guides, articles and more
- Talk to Riley anytime you need support - why is my baby fussy right now? Is this much crying normal? Jet lag nap schedule for travel? Riley is empathetic, tailored to you and available at 3AM
- Riley provides you with stage-based insights, tips and activities to help your child learn and develop cognitive and physical skills. You can also ask Riley to save memories of your child so that you never forget when they took their first steps, kicked a ball, and more
- For newborn parents- track sleep, feeds, diapers, and growth in seconds, and get customized sleep schedules built on demand
- For expecting parents - be prepared on day one, whether it be asking Riley questions about the first 48 hours with baby, or how to prepare your current little one for a new sibling
REVIEWS
"A must have for new parents"
“The parenting partner you didn’t know you needed"
“I love chatting with Riley. Riley is smart, empathetic, and makes me feel supported as a young mom who has never done this before"
FEATURED IN - The Bump, Glamour, TechCrunch, NBC, Axios and more
AWARD WINNING - 2025 AI Breakthrough Award
WHY PARENTS CHOOSE RILEY
• 24/7 pediatric advice chat — empathetic, evidence-based answers from our pediatrician-built knowledge base
• All-in-one baby & sleep tracker — log sleep, naps, growth, nursing, bottles, and diapers with one tap.
• On-demand sleep schedules — use “Golden Window” to get a sleep plan that adapts as your baby grows.
• Daily cognitive skill-building ideas — age-appropriate activities & local outings curated just for you.
• Milestone tracking — tell Riley about recent milestones your child has achieved, and Riley will create personalized activities related to your child’s progress
PARENT-LOVED FEATURES
• Share logs with partners & caregivers in real time
• Generate bedtime stories featuring your child’s name & favorite themes
• Track progress from newborn through grade school in one secure place
Download Riley for free today

- 4,000+ High-Quality Questions: Cover all key exam areas with rigorously reviewed questions, each paired with detailed explanations to reinforce learning.
- Targeted Subject Categorization: Streamline your study sessions by focusing on the categories where you need the most improvement.
- Performance Tracking & Analytics: Monitor your progress, identify strengths and weaknesses, and adjust your strategy using our comprehensive analysis tools.
- User-Friendly Interface: Enjoy a clean, intuitive design that lets you concentrate on what matters most—your preparation.

bluejetty:00129197:ios.name: Snap Markup - Annotation Tool
bluejetty:00129197:ios.summary:
Snap Markup — Photo Markup & Editor
Turn any photo into a polished, annotated image in seconds. Mark up screenshots, documents, receipts, real estate, and snapshots with on-device AI, pro editing tools, and effortless sharing — all in one a
bluejetty:00129197:ios.description:
Snap Markup — Photo Markup & Editor
Turn any photo into a polished, annotated image in seconds. Mark up screenshots, documents, receipts, real estate, and snapshots with on-device AI, pro editing tools, and effortless sharing — all in one app.
ALL-IN-ONE MARKUP
Crop, rotate, draw, add text, stickers, and overlays from one toolbar. Reorder tools in Settings so your favourites are always one tap away.
DOCUMENT SCANNER
Scan multi-page documents with auto edge detection and straightening. Export as a clean image or searchable PDF.
COLLAGE MAKER
Combine multiple photos into beautiful grid layouts with adjustable spacing, borders, and ratios.
GIF MAKER
Turn photos or video clips into animated GIFs. Add text, stickers, and overlays, then export a ready-to-share loop.
BATCH RESIZE & EXPORT
Resize multiple photos at once. Set custom dimensions and DPI for print or web, and export to PNG, JPG, or HEIC.
PHOTO SPLITTER
Slice an image into a grid for seamless social posts and carousels.
SMART CROP & ROTATE
On-device AI detects documents and faces and suggests the perfect crop. Free, fixed-ratio, and shape crops (rectangle, circle, star, triangle). Rotate, flip, or auto-straighten skewed documents.
ADJUST & AUTO ENHANCE
Fine-tune brightness, contrast, saturation, and exposure with live sliders, or tap Auto Enhance. Cinematic filters in one tap.
BACKGROUND BLUR & COLOUR
Powered by Apple Vision AI — blur the background for a portrait look, or swap it for any solid colour.
ANNOTATE LIKE A PRO
Arrows, shapes, lines, freehand pen, curves, and numbered step callouts. Customise stroke colour, thickness, and opacity. Annotate large images without cropping first.
HIGHLIGHT & HIDE
Spotlight key details, or pixelate sensitive info — faces, addresses, account numbers — before sharing.
TEXT, STICKERS & OVERLAYS
Full text styling with drag, pinch, and rotate. Emoji and shape stickers, plus photo overlays — long-press to remove a background on device.
MORE TOOLS
Date & location stamp, measurement ruler, speech bubbles, OCR text extraction, code scanner, translate, signature, watermark, frame, collage, photo stitch, webpage & map capture, blank canvas, and searchable PDF export.
SHARE WITHOUT FRICTION
Save to Photos or Files, print, copy, set as wallpaper, or share anywhere. Export lossless PNG, high-quality JPG, or HEIC. Generate custom PDFs with your choice of name, quality, and orientation.
76 LANGUAGES & THEMES
Fully localised in 76 languages. Light, Dark, and Auto themes.
PRIVACY FIRST
All AI processing runs on device. Your photos never leave your iPhone or iPad.
Feedback or suggestions? Contact us at support@appculus.com — we'd love to hear from you.

bluejetty:00128087:ios.description:
Anxiety relief games for your fingertips. Touch the screen and watch calming colors flow, swirl and glow — a relaxing ASMR escape whenever stress builds up.
No goals, no timers, no pressure. Just satisfying antistress visuals that respond to every touch, soothing music, and guided breathing to help you slow down and unwind.
WHAT'S INSIDE
• Fluid Art — swipe to paint glowing, flowing colors. Every touch feels smooth and satisfying.
• Kaleidoscopes — endlessly shifting symmetric patterns that are easy to get lost in.
• Fractals & Tunnels — hypnotic, trippy visuals to calm a busy mind.
• Particles — thousands of light particles that follow your finger.
• Calming Music & Sounds — ambient soundscapes made for relaxing and focusing.
• Breathing Exercises — follow a gentle animated rhythm to slow your breath and reset.
• Make It Yours — adjust colors, speed, intensity and music to match your mood.
GREAT FOR
• Taking a quick antistress break during a busy day
• Winding down before bed
• Fidgeting and keeping restless hands busy
• Staying calm and focused while studying or working
• Anyone who loves satisfying, mesmerizing visuals
EXTRAS
• Save your creations as wallpapers
• Works offline — relax anywhere
• Put on headphones for a deeper, more immersive experience
SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribe to Premium for unlimited access to all visuals, music and features for the whole subscription period.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
• The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal anytime in your Apple ID Account Settings.
• Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://mobile-apps.dev/wave-privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://mobile-apps.dev/wave-terms-of-use/

FOR FANS
- Easily acces
bluejetty:00016828:ios.description:
MyRacePass (MRP) gives you real-time access to lineups, results and information from thousands of race tracks. Follow your favorite tracks and series for quick access and stay up to date with all the racing action!
FOR FANS
- Easily access race information, lineups, results, and live timing.
- Follow point standings from your favorite tracks and series.
- View upcoming events to plan your next outing.
- Get the latest event updates rain outs.
- Access race by race point breakdowns for thousands of drivers.
- Access thousands of news articles from all genres of racing.
- Join Fantasy Racing and make your picks for hundreds of events.
- Listen to audio straight from the Announcers!
FOR PROMOTERS
- Sell more tickets for your events online and scan users into the gate.
- Publish schedules and point standings for maximum distribution.
- Promote your organization with on-demand apparel sales.
- Publish news articles to keep your fans and drivers in the know.
- Run Fantasy Leaderboards to engage your fans all season long.
FOR DRIVERS
- Find your official results and lineups.
- Review race by race point breakdowns.
- Check into racing events by scanning your device.
- Update your profile to keep fans in the loop.
MRP BASIC
- With a MRP Basic subscription you gain access to live timing and previous lap times for all tracks using MRP Live for only $7.99/year across all devices you log into.
MRP PRO
- A MRP Pro subscription comes with all the features of MRP Basic AND full sanction points AND full race-by-race points breakdown for all drivers in points throughout the MyRacePass network for only $34.99/year across all devices you log into.
MRP ALL ACCESS
- A MRP All Access subscription comes with all the features of MRP Basic, MRP Pro AND unlimited Fantasy Racing for only $54.99/year across all devices you log into.
MRP ALL ACCESS (Monthly)
- A MRP All Access (Monthly) subscription comes with all the features of MRP Basic, MRP Pro and MRP All Access for only $5.99/month across all devices you log into.
MANAGE SUBSCRIPTIONS
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Subscriptions are valid on any device logged into with your account.
- Visit https://www.myracepass.com/terms for full Terms and Conditions.

bluejetty:00140091:ios.description:

bluejetty:00087656:ios.description:
Prepare for an electrifying gaming experience like no other with Draw Fight: Freestyle Action. This innovative action-packed game puts your creativity and strategic prowess to the test, offering a unique twist on traditional combat gameplay. 
- Unleash Your Artistic Fury: In Draw Fight, you are not confined to the limitations of pre-determined attacks. Instead, you wield the power of your creativity by drawing your own attack patterns! Whether it's a swift sword strike, a barrage of arrows, or a devastating energy blast, the choice is yours. Customize your attacks and obliterate your foes in style!
- Master Varied Attack Patterns: The game offers an extensive arsenal of attack patterns for you to experiment with and master. Combine different strokes and techniques to create your signature moves, ensuring that every battle is a thrilling display of your skills.
- Beware of the Perilous Waters: The stakes are high in Draw Fight. The battlefield is surrounded by treacherous waters, and if you fall in, it's game over! This adds an exciting layer of challenge and strategy, forcing you to balance your aggression with precision to stay on solid ground.
- Explore Diverse Stages: Draw Fight takes you on an epic journey across various captivating stages. You'll battle your way through bustling cityscapes where cars unexpectedly approach, and you'll even take your fights to the skies on airplanes! Each stage presents its own unique challenges and opportunities for creative combat.
Draw Fight: Freestyle Action is not just a game; it's a canvas for your imagination and a platform to prove your combat prowess. Get ready to draw your destiny and become the ultimate freestyle fighter in this one-of-a-kind gaming experience. Are you up for the challenge?

bluejetty:00156639:ios.description:
The ABIM Physician Portal app provides a convenient way for physicians to stay on top of their Maintenance of Certification (MOC) program requirements and important deadlines.
Key Features:
• Provides access to a physician’s personalized ABIM Physician Portal anytime, anywhere
• Helps physicians easily track their MOC requirements
• Allows physicians to set custom reminders for key dates and tasks
• Free and ad-free for ABIM Board Certified physicians
• Please note: The app does not support access to or completion of exam questions.
About the American Board of Internal Medicine:
Since its founding in 1936 to answer a public call to establish more uniform standards for physicians, Certification by the American Board of Internal Medicine (ABIM) has stood for the highest standard in internal medicine and its 21 subspecialties. Certification has meant that internists have demonstrated – to their peers and to the public – that they have the clinical judgment, skills and attitudes essential for the delivery of excellent patient care.
ABIM is not a membership society, but a physician-led, non-profit, independent evaluation organization. Our accountability is both to the profession of medicine and to the public.
ABIM certifies approximately one out of every four physicians in the United States. There are more than 200,000 ABIM Board Certified physicians. To learn more, visit abim.org.
Have feedback or questions? Email us at request@abim.org.

bluejetty:00166099:ios.description:
One day, land vanishes with rising seas. Hunger, illness, and mutants killed 80% of mankind.
You, a survivor, emerge as hero of high seas.
▶ Endless Weapon Upgrades
Engage in tough battles with easy gameplay. Tap to upgrade the weapons with post-apocalyptic technology. 
Enjoy a bounty of rewards even while you're AFK. 
▶ Defeat Endless Enemies
Defend yourself with full effort from enemies' rain of bullets. Worse still, hundreds of fierce beasts block your way. Take everything possible to boost your power and increase your chances of survival.
▶ Assemble Legendary Crews
Only the fittest can survive the apocalypse. Survivors with unique skills are scattered across the icy world, from naval officers to doctors, engineers, and pilots, all waiting to follow your lead.
▶ Renovate the Cabins
It's not just the enemies that pose a threat—the pervasive cold does too.

bluejetty:00074894:ios.name: Production Chain Tycoon
bluejetty:00074894:ios.summary: Welcome to Production Chain Tycoon, the idle simulation game that puts you in the role of a CEO managing your industrial empire. In this game, you must use strategy and careful management skills to optimize your supply chain, increase produ
bluejetty:00074894:ios.description:
Welcome to Production Chain Tycoon, the idle simulation game that puts you in the role of a CEO managing your industrial empire. In this game, you must use strategy and careful management skills to optimize your supply chain, increase production efficiency, and become the ultimate tycoon. 
At first, start producing essential resources such as wood and stone with a basic production line. You must expand and improve your operations and move on to more complex products such as concrete or plastic. You must carefully manage your resources and logistics to confirm that your assembly line runs smoothly and efficiently, even when idle. 
Manage both supply and demand chains. Carefully balance production with demand to ensure that you are meeting the needs of your factories while also maximizing profits. Take your opportunities to optimize the assembly line to increase productivity and reduce upkeep. As the game progresses, the supply and demand chains become increasingly complex, but as an industrial tycoon, you are not afraid of such insignificant setbacks.
Another important aspect of the game is resource management. You must oversee the progress of your resource mining operations and make strategic decisions about allocating your resources to support your production efforts. This will involve managing logistics and inventory to ensure you have the materials you need to keep your factories running smoothly.
Key features:
- Manage an industrial empire
- Optimize supply chain and increase production efficiency
- Balance production with demand
- Research and develop new technologies
- Play offline, even without an internet connection
In short, Production Chain Tycoon is an awesome idle sim game with endless hours of strategic gameplay. It’s got a ton of focus on supply chain management, resource management, and technology development. If you are up to building your own industrial empire, give Production Chain Tycoon a shot!

bluejetty:00129535:ios.description:
The only app with both Google Street View AND Apple Look Around in one place.
Plus 2,000+ live webcams, real traffic, 3D Earth, and a Geoguessr-style game.
Made in Belgium, trusted since 2012.
NEW IN VERSION 9
A brand-new Street View: smoother, sharper, and fast.
Daily challenge: five places a day, the same for everyone, with a streak and a home-screen widget.
Live weather: the panorama shows the weather that's there right now.
Effects: snow, rain, fog, northern lights and more on any street.
Time machine: the same street in earlier years, side by side or played as a time-lapse.
Share any view: the picture, plus a link that opens the same spot in Google Maps.
Favorites with a photo of each place.
Landscape almost everywhere.
WHAT YOU GET
Two street view providers, one app
Flip between Google Street View and Apple Look Around with one tap. Apple has the freshest imagery in some cities, Google has wider coverage. You don't have to pick.
2,000+ live webcams worldwide
Watch beaches, ski lifts, harbours, and city squares in real time. Watch them free from the map; browsing by country is part of Premium. Webcams come from OpenWebcamDB.
Live traffic
Real-time traffic on the map. Useful before you drive somewhere, or just to see how bad rush hour looks in Tokyo.
MAP & NAVIGATION
Tap anywhere on the map and you're there in 360°. Switch between street, satellite, and hybrid views. The 3D terrain mode makes mountains and valleys actually look like mountains and valleys.
Point your phone, the panorama follows. The compass mode lets you walk around without touching the screen.
GPS positioning, and address search with Premium.
GAMES & EXPLORATION
Location guessing game
We drop you somewhere random in the world and you guess where. Like Geoguessr, but you don't need a browser tab open.
Daily challenge
Five places a day, the same for everyone. Keep your streak going, share your score as a row of squares, and put today's place on your home screen with the widget.
Curated places
A growing list of handpicked locations worth seeing — from obvious stuff like the pyramids to weirder finds.
Random location
One tap, you're somewhere new on Earth. Good for killing time, good for daydreaming about trips.
SAVING & SHARING
Save your favorite spots and webcams, each with a photo. 3 favorites free, unlimited with Premium. Share the view you're looking at: the picture, plus a link that opens the same spot in Google Maps.
PREMIUM
No ads, past captures, time-lapses and then-and-now comparisons, every effect, full HD imagery, full-screen panoramas, address search, webcams by country, unlimited favorites, and the live compass mode.
GOOD FOR
Armchair travelers, geography nerds, students, trip planners, real estate people, teachers, and anyone who likes looking at far-away places.
WHY THIS APP
Most street view apps want $20 a month for things that should be free. Most webcam apps don't have street view. None of them have a guessing game. We have all three, and we've been doing this for 14 years.
TECHNICAL
Requires iOS 16.4 or later. Universal: iPhone and iPad, with the Liquid Glass look on iOS 26 and later. Needs an internet connection. Location services optional.
Not affiliated with Google, Apple, or OpenWebcamDB.
Terms: https://broddin.be/street-viewer-pro-terms-of-use/
Privacy: https://www.broddin.be/street-viewer-pro-privacy-policy/
