● Support for 4.1 to 5.1
The Longman Dictionary of Contemporary Engli
bluejetty:00196785:android.description:
The new edition of the best-selling Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English is a complete vocabulary and grammar resource that will enhance your learning of English. 
● Support for 4.1 to 5.1
The Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English (6th Edition) © 2015 
Now with integrated Grammar, Thesaurus, and Collocations Dictionary. 
Improve your English with the full content of the dictionary at your fingertips:
Natural English
● 165,000 corpus-based examples of natural English show words in context and how English is really used.
Comprehensive
● 230,000 words, phrases, and meanings – more than any other learner's dictionary.
Easy to use – easy to understand
● Definitions written using a vocabulary of just 2,000 words – the Longman Defining Vocabulary, ensuring all definitions are clear and easy to understand.
Expand your vocabulary 
● Frequency information on the most common words – the new Longman Communication 9000 – helps you learn them first.
● Words from the Academic Word List highlighted to help you improve your essays and presentations.
Write and speak fluently 
● An integrated Collocations Dictionary with more than 65,000 collocations: learn word combinations to use the correct words together, such as ‘take a test’ (not ‘make a test’), ‘heavy rain’ (not ‘strong rain’), and ‘highly successful’.
● The integrated Thesaurus with more than 18,000 synonyms, antonyms, and related words helps you improve your writing by using more precise and high level words: stop saying ‘nice’, instead, say ‘lovely, delightful, enjoyable, wonderful, brilliant’.
● Register Notes on the differences between spoken and written English help you express yourself precisely.
Improve your grammar
● Avoid making common mistakes and get extra help with grammar patterns and using the correct tenses.
Improve your pronunciation
● All headwords pronounced in both British and American English 
PLUS 
● All example sentences pronounced in either British or American English (via external links) 
All this makes the Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English the largest resource of English available on any mobile platform. 
________________________________ 
Application Features: 
● Full content of the print dictionary 
● PLUS additional collocations, synonyms, and word origins 
● Guide on how to use the dictionary
● Search using wildcards and suggested words 
● Predictive text in search helps you with spelling as you look for words
● Search for idioms and phrasal verbs 
● Search history to help you find recently searched for words
● Support for search from within other compatible apps on your device 
● Fully detailed color Retina Display images
● Bookmark your favorite words
● Copy words and text to clipboard 
● Word-of-the-Day notifications
● New design and improved navigation
● Adjustable font scaling to support visually impaired users
● Saved bookmarks will be updated in a forthcoming release
The ultimate learner's resource of the English language for use anywhere, anytime. 
Copyright: 
Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English, Sixth Edition (LDOCE6) 
© Pearson Education Limited 2009, 2015

bluejetty:00152722:ios.description:
Cash-Out Club is the premium gaming platform where players compete to win real cash in quick matches across a variety of skill-based games, all in one app. No video ads. Just play. Sharpen your skills with free practice games or compete for real cash against players at similar skill levels.
WHY PLAY CASH-OUT CLUB:
— WIN REAL CASH — 
Outscore your opponents in 3-5 minute cash matches to win real cash. Improve your skills to unlock opportunities to play for even bigger cash prizes. 
— WIDE SELECTION OF GAMES — 
With a variety of games to choose from, find the ones that best fit your skills and enjoy more ways to compete for cash. 
- Solitaire
- Bingo
- Blackjack
- Spider Solitaire
- Block Puzzle
- Bubble Shooter
- Slots
- Word Puzzle
- Pyramid Solitaire
- Freecell Solitaire
— PREMIUM EXPERIENCE — 
No video ads. No gimmicks. Just smooth gameplay and a polished experience built for players who love fun mobile games.
— FAIR COMPETITION — 
Players are matched with others at similar skill levels and compete using the same card decks, game boards, and boosts. Strategy, speed, and skill determine the winner. Watch match replays to learn new strategies and improve your game. 
— SAFE & SECURE PAYOUTS — 
Deposit and cash-out with confidence using trusted payment providers, including PayPal, Venmo, Visa, and Mastercard. No deposit is required to withdraw cash winnings. A minimum withdrawal amount applies. Bonus Cash cannot be withdrawn and is forfeited at the time of withdrawal. 
Download Cash-Out Club today and discover why players keep coming back for premium gameplay, fair competition, and real cash rewards.

Tired of all the junk email you get? Try the most powerful spam filter for iPhone and iPad. Spamdrain protects your email from spam and junk email 24/7. Our anti-spam service is built on an artificial intelligence platform that we have tweaked and improved with the help of our amazing customers since 2004. So far, we have blocked 3.1 billion spam emails!
"Spamdrain has stopped viruses and spam from corrupting my iPad and iPhone. It sorts through all my mail and declares it Blocked or Allowed... You are in total control! I highly recommend Spamdrain!" – Cibolo314, App Store review
Sign up for a 14-day free trial (no credit card needed). If you love our spam filter (as we know you will), subscribe for less than the price of a cup of coffee.
STOP JUNK EMAIL
If you ever asked yourself how you can stop junk email or spam from clogging up your inbox, Spamdrain is for you. Spamdrain keeps your inbox clean on all devices and operating systems by blocking unwanted or malicious email – including automated emails or phishing attempts that use malware or spyware to attempt to access your sensitive banking or credit card information.
CLEAN ON ALL DEVICES
Connect your email and see the magic – everywhere. Mac or PC? POP3 or IMAP? Gmail, Outlook, Spark or Yahoo Mail? Spamdrain blocks junk email and spam across operating systems, devices and email providers. Simply connect and we do the rest.
EVERY NEW EMAIL CHECKED
The second you get a new email, we check it. If it is spam or junk, a virus or a phishing attempt, we remove it at once so you don't have to see it.
YOUR DATA REMAINS PRIVATE
You pay us a small fee so we never need to sell your data to anyone (unlike many others). We instead focus entirely on providing you with the best spam filtering in the world.
AI + A COMMUNITY OF ANTISPAMMERS
Let's work together to block phishers and spammers. We have fine-tuned our tech since 2004 and together with our amazing customers have created a spam filter service that efficiently blocks junk email. When you mark an email as spam, we will make sure everyone else is protected as well.
EMAIL SPAM FILTER STATISTICS AND CONTROL
When your account is up and running, you will be able to see statistics for your account and report spam that we may have missed. You can view blocked messages directly with this app. If you find an email you want to read on the blocked list, simply tap on it and 'allow'. When you do this, you help train the anti-spam filter and ensure that Spamdrain will send this email straight to your inbox the next time. Use Spamdrain to get an inbox with only the emails you want to read.
REAL CONTROL OF YOUR INBOX AND TOTAL SPAM PROTECTION
Get Spamdrain and retake control of your inbox. Sign up today and enjoy a clean inbox with nothing but the email you really want. Get rid of junk email and spam that is bothering and frustrating you!

UpKeep is the CMMS platform trusted by 4,000+ companies, including McDonald's, Caterpillar, and Chevron, to manage maintenance, safety, and reliability. Teams on UpKeep cut downtime by 26% and extend asset life by 11%.
Create a work order by voice, photo, or text. Check an asset's full history from the plant floor. Close out a PM with the checklist already built. UpKeep is designed for technicians first, so the work gets logged where it happens, not at a desk hours later.

WORK ORDERS: Create, assign, and track work from your phone. Voice notes become work orders, and every change is logged until the job is done.
PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE: Schedule by time, usage, or condition. Checklists and reminders make sure nothing gets skipped.

WHO IT'S FOR
Maintenance and operations teams in manufacturing, facilities, food & beverage, retail, transportation, and healthcare, from a single site to hundreds.
Move from reactive repairs to planned, predictable work. Download UpKeep and take your maintenance operation mobile.

* Music spectrum – Visualize sound changes with the rhythm of your music.

* No root required – Use the app without needing to root your device.

* Boost system volume – Enhance the sound for alarms, ringtones, and notifications.
* Boost media volume – Increase sound for videos, music, games, audiobooks, and more.
* Boost external speaker, headphones, and Bluetooth volume – Amplify sound for all your audio devices.
Built-in Music Player Controls:
* Music control features – Play, pause, skip, and display track info (album cover, song title, artist).
* Optimized music experience – Enjoy enhanced audio quality while listening to your favorite tracks.

* Simple and intuitive interface – Designed for ease of use with a clean, professional layout.

Build, wash, fuel up and go!
Discover one of the best construction games for kids! Construction Vehicles & Trucks is a fun-filled, colourful game for thinking, building and play, all at the same time. Keep your children entertained with this deep-digging, big building, pile driving journey of fun.
It’s as easy as picking your bulldozer or truck and heading onto the construction site to get creative. There are different kinds of tractors , big excavators and heavy utility construction vehicles for everyone. And kids get stuck in by using their own pile driver to dig piles of soil up to create strong building foundations – and that’s just the beginning. This trucking game will keep them busy building all the way from floor to roof.
First you build your truck, then you wash and refuel it, and then, you’re ready to construct your very own building. When you’re done, do it again with a totally different truck, or wash, refuel and try again!
Wash up, load your equipment and go straight to the construction site with the digger. This construction game gives creative and technically minded kids an outlet for their energy that will entertain them for hours on end. From quarry to site and foundation to final building, these trucks are built for all the construction action you could imagine.
This game keeps young minds and little hands busy and entertained with hours constructive play. Just hand them your smartphone or tablet and they’re ready to build, learn and enjoy while you do other things. Let them drive , dig the soil and enjoy!
So, pull up the truck, get it all cleaned up and get your kids ready for the construction ride of their lives with this digging, working and driving world of fun!

The game features uniquely composed music that was made specially to keep the fun and energy at its peak.
The graphics are eye-catching, colourful and lively, creating a welcoming and immersive world that they just won’t want to leave as they play and learn.
Entertaining jcb game for kids ! Play now construction games with the tractor !
Many levels added monthly : build a house , a playground , a beautiful hotel or a luna park !

bluejetty:00013673:ios.description:
The Arabic Bible is the translation of the Holy Scriptures into the Arabic language, created to help Arabic-speaking people understand the Christian faith in their native language. Arabic Bible translations date back centuries, preserving the meaning of the original scriptures.
Over the years, it has been revised several times to remain clear and meaningful for modern readers and younger generations. Today, the Arabic Bible continues to inspire and guide millions of Arabic-speaking people.
Features:
Daily Verse: Set reminders for daily Bible verse notifications.
MY LIBRARY: Access your highlights, notes, and bookmarked verses.
Old & New Testaments: Read both Testaments in one app.
Verse Editor: Create beautiful verse posts with backgrounds and share them.
Nearby Churches: Find churches near your location.
Books: Explore a collection of Christian eBooks.
Wallpapers: Browse beautiful and inspiring wallpapers.
Videos: Watch videos on Jesus, Hope, Wisdom, Motivation, Gratitude, Healing, and more.
Festive Calendar: Explore Christian festivals and feast days.
Popular Verse: Discover verses by topics like love, fear, and peace.
Customise Your Bible: Adjust fonts and text colors for comfortable reading.
1000 Praises: Explore a devotional collection honoring God’s names and attributes.
Bible Quotes: Share Bible quotes in image and text formats.
Bible Quiz: Test your Bible knowledge with engaging quizzes.
Bible Stories: Read timeless and inspiring Bible stories for all ages.
Bible FAQ: Find quick answers to common Bible and Christian life questions.
Verse Comments: Share thoughts and engage in community discussions.
Help Desk: Submit support requests with photo attachments.
Dictionary: Access a Bible-based dictionary with easy search.
Dream Meanings: Explore Biblical and Christian perspectives on dreams.
Word Highlights: Highlight words or letters for deeper reflection.
App Activity: Track reading streaks, time spent, refreshes, and app usage.
Search: Quickly find verses, chapters, and topics.
Products: Explore Bible-related products within the app.
VerseBot: Get AI-powered verse explanations with easy copy and sharing.
Notification History: Access your past notifications in one place.
Did You Know?: Discover daily facts about the Bible and Christian faith.
Bible Verse Clips: Enjoy short, inspirational Bible clips from the community.
Prayer Request: Submit prayer requests and receive community support.
Nearby Events: Discover Christian events and gatherings near you.
Chapter-Wise Video Learning: Watch videos for deeper chapter understanding.
Interactive Bible Games: Enjoy scripture-based games like SlideScript and VerseHunt.
Bible Clips: Watch short, inspiring Biblical clips from the faith community.
Bible Streaks: Maintain your daily Bible reading streak.
Background Music: Enjoy calming music while reading the Bible.
Mark as Read – Quiz: Take quizzes based on the verses you’ve read.
Audio Bible – Speed Control: Adjust audio speed for faster or slower listening.
Alarm: Set timely alarms and reminders for scheduled activities.
Worship Songs: Praise and connect with God through uplifting songs and lyrics.
Daily Prayer Reminder: Stay connected with God through daily prayer reminders.
Audio Bible Experience: Listen to reading plans with text-to-speech audio and soulful background music.

bluejetty:00086773:ios.description:
Bem-vindo à Epicfit360, a única plataforma que transforma a sua jornada fitness em uma experiência épica, abrangendo corpo, mente e alma. Com o nosso aplicativo, você terá acesso a um ecossistema completo que reúne todos os meios necessários para a sua transformação 360. Aqui, você encontrará uma variedade de conteúdos em vídeo e áudio, que podem ser baixados para assistir onde e quando quiser, cuidadosamente selecionados, projetados para ajudá-lo em cada aspecto da sua jornada de bem-estar: 
Treinos em casa e na academia: Desfrute de rotinas de exercícios cuidadosamente elaboradas para atender às suas necessidades, seja você um iniciante ou um experiente do fitness.

Saúde e bem-estar: Fisioterapia, nutrição, receitas saudáveis e técnicas de relaxamento para cuidar do seu corpo e mente de maneira 360.
Além disso, você se manterá conectado com a nossa comunidade para compartilhar suas experiências, receber apoio e inspiração para manter-se motivado em sua jornada. Recebendo também notificações exclusivas com nossas novidades!
Na Epicfit360, estamos comprometidos em proporcionar a você uma experiência completa e enriquecedora, capacitando-o a alcançar seus objetivos de forma holística e sustentável. Junte-se a nós nesta jornada e descubra a versão mais épica de si mesmo.

bluejetty:00096452:ios.description:
VoiceTrack is an AI meeting notetaker that captures every conversation, turns hours of audio into clean transcripts, and highlights decisions and action items for you. Record inside the app or import files, then rely on AI Chat to clarify anything without replaying the call. Need context from video research? Add the YouTube transcript feature as part of your workflow when you’re ready.
WHY TEAMS PICK VOICETRACK
• Stay present in the meeting while VoiceTrack captures the conversation automatically.
• Convert recordings or uploads into searchable transcripts, summaries, and action items in minutes.
• Chat with AI about any meeting to double-check decisions, blockers, owners, or next steps.
CORE CAPABILITIES
• AI transcription and diarization after every meeting with automatic language detection.
• AI summaries, highlights, and action items that land directly in the same workspace.
• AI Chat that understands the transcript so you can ask “What did we commit to?” or “Explain this part.”
• Flexible exports: PDF, DOCX, TXT, CSV, XLSX for sharing meeting notes with stakeholders.
• Dashboard with favorites, drafts, recovery for interrupted recordings, and cross-device sync.
• YouTube transcript workspace (paste a link to pull captions, summaries, and AI Chat without rewatching the video).
WHO BENEFITS
Founders, product leaders, customer success, researchers, students, interviewers, journalists, and hybrid/remote teams that need trustworthy notes without manual typing.
CREDITS & SUBSCRIPTIONS
Credits are only consumed when you process audio (1 credit = 5 minutes). Subscriptions remove usage friction, unlock unlimited AI Chat, and keep your workflow moving.
PRIVACY FIRST
Recordings stay encrypted and under your control. VoiceTrack never sells audio or transcripts.
GET STARTED FREE
Download VoiceTrack, transcribe your next meeting, and experience how AI saves hours every week.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Payment is charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or disable auto-renewal in Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
Support: support@voicetrack.app
Terms of Use: https://landing.voicetrack.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://landing.voicetrack.app/privacy

• Daily health insights, fitness videos, recipes, and wellness tips.

• Set up alerts
• Locate a nearby Shared Branch or ATM

• Money Management: Budgeting tools and account aggregation

• Apple Watch integration
• Apply for a new loan or account, add a joint owner or add documents to an application
For more information, visit our website at christianfinancialcu.org/mobilebanking.
Federally insured by NCUA. Equal Housing Opportunity. Message and data rates may apply from your mobile carrier.

bluejetty:00021913:ios.description:
Zenkit To Do is a super-simple task management app to help you work productively and collaborate with anyone.
It lets you organize your tasks, shopping lists, meetings, events, trips, ideas, notes, places, and whatever else is important to you.
You can create lists and share tasks with your team members, family, and friends.
To Do synchronizes everything between all your devices so you can access your lists wherever you are, even offline.
----------
Zenkit To Do is part of the Zenkit product family. Zenkit has won several awards and is celebrated in Lifehacker, TechCrunch, CNET, and The Next Web, to name but a few.
----------
Organize
• Create any lists you need and use them on your phone, tablet, and computer simultaneously.
• Add images, PDFs, presentations, photos, links, and other documents to your tasks.
• Set reminders so you never miss an important date.
• Use folders to help you organize your lists.
Collaboration
• Share lists with team members, friends, and family.
• Or share whole folders to make sure everyone has the lists they need.
• Comment on tasks to keep your chats in context.
• @mention other users to contact them directly.
• Assign tasks so everyone knows what they need to do.
• See everything you need to work on in the “Assigned to Me” list.
Use Anywhere, Safely
• All content is automatically synchronized across all of your devices.
• All content is available offline, so you can continue working without the internet.
• Your content belongs to YOU.
• Data privacy and protection is central to us.
• 2FA login protects your account.
• Our servers are located in Germany.
The Zenkit Universe
• To Do works seamlessly with the original Zenkit app and other Zenkit products. This means you can also access your tasks on a Kanban board, Gantt chart, or with a mind map. Stay tuned!
• Additional custom fields and references to other objects such as customers etc. are possible through the Zenkit app.
Our privacy policy: https://zenkit.com/privacy/
Our terms of use: https://zenkit.com/terms/
For more information, go to https://zenkit.com/todo/

bluejetty:00084204:ios.summary:
Senses is a collection of romantic stories where you control the destiny of your character.
Explore various plots, choose your own paths, and make decisions that can change the course of the story. Each novella is a unique romance universe
bluejetty:00084204:ios.description:
Senses is a collection of romantic stories where you control the destiny of your character.
Explore various plots, choose your own paths, and make decisions that can change the course of the story. Each novella is a unique romance universe with its own environment and characters.
In our game, you will gain a new experience of interactive story progression:
- Choose a genre to your liking: in Senses you will find stories for every taste - from mystical thrillers to sweet romantic tales.
- You are given a wide choice of outfits and hairstyles to create a unique image of your heroine. You determine what she will look like and what her style will be.
- Choose your favorites and build relationships with the characters you like the most. Your heroine can make friends, fall in love, and even start romantic relationships with any character of your choice.
- Your choices directly affect the development of the plot. You decide what actions your heroine takes, which ultimately determines the outcome of your story.
Experiment with the wardrobe and choices - become the star of your own plot and make all the characters of the virtual world fall in love with you!
Explore various plots, choose your own paths, and make decisions that can change the course of the story. Each novella is a unique universe with its characters and plots.
Are you ready to dive into one of them?
THE SANDS OF TIME: THE KEY TO ETERNITY
A regular trip to the museum turns into a real-time travel. The heroine gets entangled in a web of intrigue that unfolds several millennia before her birth. Can she return home?
SHADES OF MORALITY
Jazz time, mafia, and prohibition. A time when some are rapidly rising and others are sinking to the very bottom. Who will the young girl become, caught in the dangerous whirlpool of events? Will she be able to choose a side and not make a mistake?
SUIT OF SWORDS
To put an end to the past, the main heroine goes to a mysterious mansion and enters a deadly game. Each guest has their own secrets and reasons to hide their story.
THE SCARLET LINE
A young girl arrives at the Vampires Monastery hoping to earn money, but she gets trapped in a prison. Will she be able to escape and meet the Lord of the castle, and what secret lies in her past?
FRAMED MURDER
A heroine famous for a comic about serial killers never suspected she'd become the target of a real one. Can she survive the deadly game he's devised and remain true to herself?
THE VOICES OF DANSFURTH
In Dansfurth, nightmares bleed into waking life, and every shadow seems to whisper a hidden truth. Can a young newcomer, forced to call this place home, unravel the town's dark secrets and those of her own family or will she be consumed by the encroaching madness?
REVELATION OF WITCHES
Everything in the world has a price, and magic is no exception. To reclaim what she's lost, a witch of the Nightingale lineage must strike an uneven bargain and become entangled in an investigation into missing persons. But how can she conduct a search in a city where nothing is as it seems? And how can she avoid losing herself in the dark woods along the way?
THE PRICE OF REPUTATION
She's a copywriter, not a spy, but Miss Hunt's mission is to find one. However, this dangerous game could push things too far, revealing a truth she's unprepared for.
DRAGON'S HEART
Dragon Kaylar has a dark reputation. All his previous wives vanished without a trace. But the new bride is different from the others. She is ready to fight not only for her life, but for power and influence. Even if she must unravel the secrets of dragons to succeed – this heroine will go all the way, without doubt or regret.
The stories are regularly updated and supplemented according to the feedback of our players!
We invite you to the world of Senses, where you will become the main character! Your decisions determine how your romantic story unfolds. Fall in love, get inspired, and dream with us!

bluejetty:00090268:ios.summary: In 1963, Dar Al Shifa Hospital (DASH) was established as the first private hospital in the State of Kuwait. Originally, it was a maternity hospital located in Sharq, Kuwait city. Since that time, the hospital became a leading health care or
bluejetty:00090268:ios.description:
In 1963, Dar Al Shifa Hospital (DASH) was established as the first private hospital in the State of Kuwait. Originally, it was a maternity hospital located in Sharq, Kuwait city. Since that time, the hospital became a leading health care organization in the region.
In 1992, DASH went through a notable expansion under the ownership of Mr. Ali Jeraq who had a visionary goal to make healthcare services accessible to every individual in the community. As a result, DASH developed into a fully-fledged general hospital that included a wide scope of services.
Over the last few years, DASH has proved itself as a trustworthy organization in which patient/family-centered care is provided through a competent and diverse team of health care professionals utilizing the latest technology and applying evidence-based practices. Another significant achievement of DASH is attaining recognized international accreditation and awards from Accreditation Canada and American College of Radiology.
Today, DASH is continuously growing and evolving as a distinguished health care organization with a focus on providing comprehensive and specialized services to meet the needs of the community. DASH dedication towards development and growth is reflected in the ongoing expansion which will make it the largest private hospital in Kuwait.
في عام 1963، تم تأسيس مستشفى دار الشفاء كأول مستشفى خاص في دولة الكويت. وقد كان بالأساس مستشفى متخصص للنساء والولادة يقع في منطقة شرق، بمدينة الكويت. ومنذ ذلك الوقت، أصبح المستشفى مؤسسة رعاية صحية رائدة في المنطقة.
في عام 1992، مر مستشفى دار الشفاء بمرحلة توسعات تحت إشراف المالك السيد/ علي جراق والذي كان يمتلك رؤية وهدفاً في تمكين كل فرد في المجتمع من الحصول على خدمات الرعاية الصحية. ونتيجة لذلك، حقق مستشفى دار الشفاء تطوراً كبيراً وأصبح مستشفى عام متكامل يتضمن مجموعة واسعه من الخدمات.
وعلى مدى السنوات الأخيرة، برهن مستشفى دار الشفاء عن أصالته وأنه مؤسسة موثوقة حيث يكون المريض وعائلته هم مركز الإهتمام والرعاية، ويتم تقديم الخدمات من قبل فريق متنوع ومختص من مقدمي الرعاية الصحية بإستخدام أحدث التقنيات وتطبيق الممارسات الصحية الموصى بها عالمياً. ومن الإنجازات الهامة والبارزة التي حققها المستشفى أيضاً حصوله على شهادات اعتماد عالمية معتمدة من مجلس اعتماد الجودة الكندي والكلية الأمريكية للأشعة.
واليوم، يعتبر مستشفى دار الشفاء مؤسسة بارزة ومستمرة التطور في مجال الرعاية الصحية والتي تُركز على تقديم الخدمات المتخصصة والشاملة لمواكبة احتياجات المجتمع. إن تكريس مستشفى دار الشفاء لجهوده نحو النمو والتطور ينعكس من خلال التوسع المستمر والذي يجعل منه أكبر المستشفيات الخاصة في دولة الكويت.

listings.name: Dar Al Shifa
listings.description:
In 1963, Dar Al Shifa Hospital (DASH) was established as the first private hospital in the State of Kuwait. Originally, it was a maternity hospital located in Sharq, Kuwait city. Since that time, the hospital became a leading health care organization in the region.

In 1992, DASH went through a notable expansion under the ownership of Mr. Ali Jeraq who had a visionary goal to make healthcare services accessible to every individual in the community. As a result, DASH developed into a fully-fledged general hospital that included a wide scope of services.

Over the last few years, DASH has proved itself as a trustworthy organization in which patient/family-centered care is provided through a competent and diverse team of health care professionals utilizing the latest technology and applying evidence-based practices. Another significant achievement of DASH is attaining recognized international accreditation and awards from Accreditation Canada and American College of Radiology.

Today, DASH is continuously growing and evolving as a distinguished health care organization with a focus on providing comprehensive and specialized services to meet the needs of the community. DASH dedication towards development and growth is reflected in the ongoing expansion which will make it the largest private hospital in Kuwait.

bluejetty:00063306:ios.description:
Effectrix is a professional multi-effect sequencer for the iPad.
The game-changing tool for creative and effective music production is now available on the App Store: scatter 14 intelligent effects across a sequencer matrix and create unheard-of sound patterns and cheeky loop collages.
A playful workflow, refined algorithms and carefully parameterised effects lead to outstanding results - fast! The effects, each exceeding conventional wisdom, cover a wide spectrum from classy standards to scandalising splatter sprees.
This iOS port faithfully recreates the desktop engine, today's de-facto standard of finest audio manipulation.
INSTANT INSPIRATION
- quickly create variations and mutations for productive sound design
- 20 fine audio samples installed
- 230 factory presets (100 global, ca. 9 per effect)
- 14 high-quality effects
- redesigned GUI for a smooth iOS workflow
DIG DEEP
- manipulate each individual effect with up to eight parameters
- two modulator tracks per effect
- Seamless iOS integration: Audio Unit v3, full MIDI support, Host Automation & MIDI Learn 
- save your own presets & use them on your desktop version of Effectrix via Preset iCloud Sync
- upload your recordings to Dropbox and other supported apps
- share your recordings with other apps
- sync Effectrix with Ableton Live via Ableton Link
PRAISE:
Diplo
"I never thought I'd use Effectrix on a Beyonce song. Sugar Bytes help to inspire me with limitlessness of sound."
Armin van Buuren
"A three-band EQ, sometimes the Effectrix... and a whole tube of glue, that's all I needed to put together ASOT."
Music Radar
"It's hard to wrench yourself from it, and when you do, you'll probably come away with a head full of new ideas."
iOS WORKFLOW
You name it: Audio Unit v3, Ableton Link, Full MIDI Support (Virtual, Netzwerk, Extern, Bluetooth), MIDI Learn & Host Automation. Integrated Audio Player and Recorder (AudioShare, Music Library, Factory Loops).

bluejetty:00148475:ios.description:
Live Mosque helps you stay closely connected with your local mosque through real-time updates, prayer times, events, and live broadcasts.
Events
The Imam can create and publish mosque events directly from the system. Any events created by the mosque are shown in the app in real time, including the event date, time, and full details. Users receive timely notifications so they never miss important activities.
Salat Times
Prayer times for each Salat are displayed based on your subscribed local mosque. Any changes made by the mosque are reflected instantly in the app, ensuring you always have accurate and up-to-date Salat timings.
Messages
Messages sent by the Imam or mosque administration are delivered directly to the application. This allows users to stay informed and connected with important announcements at all times.
Live Azan & Sermon
The Imam can broadcast the Azan and sermons live through the app. Users receive notifications and can choose to listen in real time while the broadcast is ongoing, no matter where they are.
Live Mosque is designed to strengthen the connection between mosques and their communities through reliable, real-time communication.
Subscription & Billing
If you subscribe to Live Mosque via iTunes:
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period.
You can manage or turn off auto-renewal at any time from your iTunes Account Settings.
Privacy & Terms
Privacy Policy:https://sites.google.com/view/livemosqueprivacypolicy/home
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/livemosquetermsandconditions/home

Welcome to BoBo World: Shopping Mall – Where Fashion Dreams Come Alive!
Dive into a bustling marketplace at BoBo World: Shopping Mall! From chic apparel to the latest beauty products, discover a diverse selection of items to fulfill all your shopping desires. Indulge in the excitement of makeup and dressing up in an open-world environment free from rules. Live the life of a shopping spree and realize your fashion aspirations!

Start your day with a relaxing full-body massage at our Spa, then update your look with a new hairstyle at our Hair Salon. Shop for the latest fashion trends at the Clothing Store, and accessorize to perfection. Savor an enjoyable afternoon tea at our Creative Cafe, where you can exchange shopping tips with friends and enjoy quality time.
Unleash Your Creativity: With the newly introduced character creation system, personalize your avatar in the Creative Cafe. Mix and match facial features, hair colors, and fashion ensembles to craft your unique persona. With an extensive range of clothing and accessories at your disposal, express your style and design one-of-a-kind characters.
Key Features:
Exclusive Character Creation: Tailor your unique look with endless customization options.
Coloring Fun: Revamp the shopping mall décor by changing furniture colors with a simple click. Look for hidden pigments to bring your artistic visions to life.
Interactive Environment: Engage with numerous interactive items and props for an immersive experience.
Freedom to Explore: No rules, just endless fun and creativity.
High-Quality Graphics and Sound: Enjoy beautiful visuals and vibrant audio as you explore.
Multi-Touch Gameplay: Experience the joy of shopping with friends!
Join us at BoBo World: Shopping Mall, where you can shop, design, and create to your heart's content. It’s more than just shopping—it’s a way to live your dream!

bluejetty:00086943:ios.name: 07000 Taxi
bluejetty:00086943:ios.summary:
Taxi with one click!
If you want a taxi where you are now right away, just press the book taxi button. The rest goes automatically. Have a nice trip!
How does it work?
07000 Taxi has a number of useful features for quick and easy taxi book
bluejetty:00086943:ios.description:
Taxi with one click!
If you want a taxi where you are now right away, just press the book taxi button. The rest goes automatically. Have a nice trip!
How does it work?
07000 Taxi has a number of useful features for quick and easy taxi booking:
- You will automatically get the address where you are.
- An advanced address search gives you an easy opportunity to search other addresses.
- You can easily save frequently used addresses as favorites for even faster booking.
- You can choose the time for when you will be picked up, now or later.
- The app automatically find which taxi companies that can pick you up.
- If you enter the address of where you are going, you will automatically receive a price offer that is the maximum that the taxi can charge for the trip.
- You get continuous information about where the taxi is and you can follow it on the map until the trip is over.
- You can save your debit cards for faster payment. When the trip is over you can just leave the car, your card will be deducted for the taximeter price.
- It is possible to register to receive a receipt by e-mail. Then you will also receive a receipt for trips you have paid for with a card terminal in the cars.
- We have a bonus system that gives you points for all trips that are paid for with a card. You can see your bonus balance and bonus benefits in the app.
- You are invited to give all trips your rating, and your rating is used by the taxi companies to improve their services.
Where can you reach us?
Visit our website at http://07000.no or send an e-mail to post@svippr.no to give tips for new features or improvements.
Taxi companies available in the app
- Asker og Bærum Taxi
- Nedre Romerike Taxi
- TrønderTaxi
- 07000 Bergen Taxi
- Drammen Taxi
- Taxisentralen i Fredrikstad og Sarpsborg
- 07000 Agder Taxi
- 07000 Arendal og Grimstad Taxi
- 07000 Hardanger Taxi
- 07000 Mandal Taxi
- 07000 Osterøy Taxi
- 07000 Sandnes Taxi
- 07000 Stord Taxi
- 07000 Vennesla Taxi
- Follo Taxi
- Hammerfest Taxi
- Hurum & Røyken Taxi
- Hønefoss Taxi
- Ski Taxi
- Østfold Taxitjenester
Who's behind 07000 Taxi?
ITF AS is a leading Norwegian supplier of taxi systems. With our own resources, we develop a complete portfolio of systems for taxi operations with ordering solutions, traffic systems, planning solutions, financial systems and solutions for government reporting. In addition, we are a dealer of MID-approved taximeters.
The company was established in 2001 and is today owned by some of the largest and most serious taxi companies in Norway. We are located at Lysaker in Bærum.

bluejetty:00151690:ios.name: Repaint House Paint Visualizer
bluejetty:00151690:ios.summary: Easily preview your exact interior and exterior paint colors before making them permanent. Repaint combines ultra-realistic AI generation with manufacturer-accurate colors so you can try before you buy. The app automatically distinguishes b
bluejetty:00151690:ios.description:
Easily preview your exact interior and exterior paint colors before making them permanent. Repaint combines ultra-realistic AI generation with manufacturer-accurate colors so you can try before you buy. The app automatically distinguishes between siding, trim, shutters, cabinets, and more to give you a complete view of your project. Featuring top brands including Behr, Benjamin Moore, Sherwin Williams, PPG, Glidden, Dunn-Edwards, Valspar, and Farrow and Ball.
Key Features at a Glance
Snap & Visualize: Users can take a photo directly from the app or upload one from their gallery. The AI analyzes the image, distinguishing among surfaces like siding, shutters, and trim without manual editing.
Brand-Accurate Library: The app features a comprehensive library of real paint colors from top manufacturers including Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore, Behr, Valspar, PPG, and Farrow and Ball matched to official specifications.
True-to-Life Lighting: Unlike basic overlay tools, Repaint’s AI engine accounts for lighting conditions, showing how colors behave in bright sunlight, shadows, or warm indoor lighting.
Cross-Platform Sync: Projects sync seamlessly between the web and mobile app. A user can start a project on their desktop at home and refine it on their phone at the hardware store.
One-Tap Application: Colors are applied with a single tap, delivering high-resolution results that can be easily shared with family or clients.
Organizing and Sharing: Customers can keep track of their chosen colors and combine their images into albums with shareable links.
We’ve distilled the complex process of painting into four simple steps:
Snap: Upload a photo of any room or your home’s exterior. Our AI automatically identifies walls, trim, and ceilings and more with precision.
Pick: Choose from a comprehensive library of manufacturer-accurate colors. We use real-world color data from the brands you trust—like Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore—to ensure the digital color you see matches the can you buy.
Apply: Experience the "pixel-perfect" difference. Apply colors with a single tap. Our engine respects natural lighting, textures, and shadows, giving you a realistic representation of how light interacts with the pigment at different times of day.
Share: Home improvement is better together. Instantly export high-resolution visualizations to share with family, friends, or your professional contractor to ensure everyone is on the same page before the first brushstroke.
Eliminate the "Oops" Factor
A gallon of premium paint is an investment; a professional paint job is an even bigger one. Don't risk a costly mistake. With Repaint, you can explore bold accent walls, trendy exterior neutrals, or timeless interior classics with confidence.
Color Accuracy: Digital color representations may vary from actual paint colors due to differences in screen brightness, resolution, and display technology (e.g., True Tone or Night Shift settings). While Repaint utilizes manufacturer-provided color data, these visualizations are intended as a guide only. We strongly recommend purchasing a physical paint sample or swatch to test in your home’s unique lighting conditions before making a final purchase.
Trademarks: All product names, logos, and brands mentioned (including Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore, Behr, Dunn-Edwards, Farrow and Ball, and PPG/Glidden) are the property of their respective owners. Use of these names, trademarks, and brands is for identification and nominative purposes only and does not imply any affiliation with, endorsement by, or sponsorship from the brand owners. Repaint is an independent visualization tool.

bluejetty:00026384:ios.description:
WaterDo is an aesthetically pleasing to-do app created by the team of Forest: Stay Focused, the #1 productivity app with over 40 million users. It helps you stay on track and organise your daily list of jobs in the most intriguing way imaginable!
You cannot avoid the tedious chores in life, but you can choose to make them fun! In addition to the soothing interface and fun mechanism, WaterDo is equipped with reminders and a calendar that make your life more efficient! Here, your schedule becomes a list of bouncy water balls. Pop them after you've completed your tasks and enjoy the wonderful sensation of watching them burst.
*Warning! The burst is extremely satisfying. Enjoy yourself!
What WaterDo has to offer:
- Visualise your to-do list by turning tasks into water balls.
- Add notes anytime, anywhere as things pop into your head.
- Use the 'Water ball of the day' feature to prioritise the most important task.
- Daily task review helps you go over your progress and take control of your life.
- Schedule your tasks with ease, be the master of time management.
- Set reminders, unwind and snooze. We've got y'all procrastinators covered!
- Complete tasks to unlock treasure chests. Your dedication deserves to be rewarded.
- Explore various theme islands and begin your magical journey!
SUBSCRIPTIONS & BILLING
WaterDo offers free features for use, and welcomes you to experience the premium version through a free trial.
After the trial period, if offered, your subscription automatically renews unless turned off 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple account settings. Removing the app doesn't cancel the subscription.
Gamification brings motivation and motivation boosts productivity. 
Download WaterDo right now and turn boring to-dos into motivations!
Terms of Service: https://waterdo.seekrtech.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://waterdo.seekrtech.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00179265:ios.description:
Meet My Scanner – your intelligent all-in-one document and productivity companion. Whether you're scanning receipts, editing PDFs, or creating content with AI, My Scanner transforms your device into a powerhouse for getting things done—faster, smarter, and paper-free.
SCAN. EDIT. WRITE. SOLVE. ALL IN ONE PLACE.
Designed for professionals, students, and everyday users alike, My Scanner delivers the tools you need to take control of your documents and solve your office and educational tasks - all from your iPhone or iPad. 
ULTRA-FAST PDF SCANNER
• Scan documents, books, notes, or whiteboards in seconds
• Smart edge detection & auto-enhancement for crystal-clear quality
• Export as high-resolution PDFs or JPGs
ADVANCED PDF EDITOR
• Add text, highlight, underline, or draw directly on your PDFs
• Fill out forms, add e-signatures, or annotate effortlessly
• Rearrange, merge, split, and organize pages with drag-and-drop simplicity
BUILT-IN AI WRITING ASSISTANT
• Write smarter with your personal AI writing companion
• Draft emails, create essays, brainstorm ideas, summarize text & more
• Rewrite, correct grammar, and even generate content tailored to your style
• Available 24/7—no typing limits, no creative blocks
SECURE & PRIVATE
• Keep your documents safe with Face ID, Touch ID, or passcode protection
• Offline scanning and editing to protect your privacy
MORE SMART TOOLS & UTILITIES
- AR Ruler: Instantly measure objects or distances using augmented reality
- Object Counter: Use your camera to count multiple items in real time
- ID Photo Maker: Create compliant ID photos in seconds—passport, visa & more
- Math & Science Solver: Scan handwritten or printed equations and get instant solutions
- Invoice Creator: Generate professional invoices on the go
- Tax Form Filler: Easily complete and export tax documents
- Text Extractor (OCR): Pull editable text from any image or scanned page
- E-Sign Documents: Sign contracts and official documents digitally and securely
- PDF Converter: Quickly convert PDFs to and from various formats including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images, and more — all without leaving the app
WHY USERS LOVE MY SCANNER
• Combines powerful scanning with intelligent AI writing
• Replaces multiple apps with one seamless productivity tool
• Works offline for scanning & editing, with full privacy control
• Sleek, intuitive interface that gets out of your way
Whether you're in the office, classroom, or on the go, My Scanner is your trusted partner for document management and writing assistance.
Download now and experience the freedom of smart productivity.
Your documents, your words—enhanced by AI.
Created with passion by Dream App Studio team.
The app contains the following subscription options:
Weekly subscription
Monthly subscription
Quarterly subscription
Annual subscription
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost of renewal is equal to the value that “Apple’s App Store Matrix” determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: 
http://dreamappstudio.com/privacy_policy.html
Terms of Service:

bluejetty:00200213:ios.description:
Your whole game call library, in your pocket, loaded onto your caller in seconds.
HowlVault keeps every sound you own organized on your phone and puts them on your electronic game caller without a computer. Plug in, pick the sounds, hunt.
LOAD YOUR CALLER FROM YOUR PHONE
Plug a FoxPro caller into your phone with its USB cable, or put a Lucky Duck or ICOtec SD card in a USB-C card reader. HowlVault handles each caller's file names, folders and formats for you, and tells you before loading if something won't fit or won't play.
A VAULT THAT WORKS IN THE FIELD
Your sounds live on your phone, so everything works with no signal. Search, sort into folders, mark favorites, and see at a glance which sounds are already on your caller.
LISTEN BEFORE YOU LOAD
Preview any sound right in the app, so the one you load is the one you wanted.
SEQUENCES
Build and edit FoxPilot hunts for X360 and X48, and sequences for other FoxPro callers, then save them to the caller.
SAVE WHAT'S ON YOUR CALLER
Copy sounds from a caller into your vault so they're safe even if the card isn't.
IPAD
On iPad, HowlVault works like the desktop app: your vault and your caller side by side, drag and drop to load.
BUILT FOR THE STAND
Red and green night vision themes keep your eyes adjusted in the dark.
OPTIONAL CLOUD
Log into the free HowlVault cloud (3 GB) to back up your vault and use it on HowlVault Desktop too. More space is available on howlvault.com.
WORKS WITH
FoxPro (including X360 and X48), Lucky Duck and ICOtec (including Plus Series) callers with user-loadable sounds. HowlVault is not affiliated with or endorsed by FoxPro, Lucky Duck or ICOtec.
iPhone with a USB-C port required to connect a caller (Lightning iPhones can't connect).

apple-macos:6806870676.name: Trending Weather
apple-macos:6806870676.description:
Trending Weather presents the data from your WeatherFlow Tempest weather station in a clean, modern interface showing where the weather is right now, where it is heading, and how it compares to the past.
NOW
Live conditions update about once a minute straight from your station. See at a glance whether it is warming or cooling, and quickly see how it compares to yesterday. You can easily drill down into multiple measures.
FORECAST
See WeatherFlow's forecast for your station's exact location, in the same units and style as everything else. Choose your own units for temperature, wind, pressure, rainfall and distance.
CHARTS
Day, week, month and year views with presets for temperature, atmosphere on a dual axis, a wind band with direction arrows, rain and sun. Overlay the previous period to see how this week compares with last week or this year with the one before. Minimum and maximum markers are annotated, and you can scrub across any chart to read exact values.
HISTORY
A continuously scrolling temperature calendar that reads like a heat map, one cell per day, stretching back as far as your station has been reporting. Rain and gust annotations mark interesting weather days. All-time and per-year records are computed on your device from your own data: highest and lowest temperatures, strongest gust, wettest day, highest UV and the most lightning in a day.
PRIVATE
The app contains no analytics, advertising or tracking. This is just a simple app that only does what it needs to do, talking to WeatherFlow's servers, and everything it stores stays on your device. Sign out and erase removes all of it.
REQUIREMENTS
Trending Weather requires a WeatherFlow Tempest weather station and a Tempest account. It is an independent app, all Trending Weather does is present their data in a different way, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WeatherFlow.

flathub:io.github.aevahonin.Nemesis.summary: Lossless music player. Fast, beautiful and lightweight
flathub:io.github.aevahonin.Nemesis.description:
Nemesis is a music player designed for lossless audio playback. It supports FLAC, MP3, Opus,
 and AAC (M4A) formats, as well as CUE files, and offers convenient library browsing by album, artist,
 track, folder, and playlist. It features a native mode setting that sends audio data to the DAC
 at the original sample rate and bit depth, bypassing any processing.
 The app also supports gapless playback, crossfading, and ReplayGain.
 Additional features include lyrics search, downloading, and synchronized display.
 It is optimized for instant track searching within the collection and supports system integration
 via MPRIS media keys, even when minimized.
